articles.title: Arabian gazelle 's adaptabilitas tercermin dalam warisan Arab
articles.description: RAFHA - tulisan Arab Kuno mencatat pengamatan rusa 'kemampuan untuk bertahan haus dan beradaptasi dengan lingkungan gurun. Salah satu deskripsi tradisional menggambarkan kijang sebagai kompensasi untuk tidak adanya air dengan bernapas dalam angin, sebuah ekspresi yang mencerminkan pengamatan awal Arab tentang alam hewan dan kemampuannya untuk bertahan hidup dalam habitat kering. Ketua Dewan Asosiasi Lingkungan Aman di Northern Borders Daerah Nasser Al- Gazlad mengatakan deskripsi tradisional kizelle melampaui ketangkasan dan kecepatannya untuk menjelajahi kebiasaan makanannya, bagaimana mereka menjelajahi kelangkaan air, dan cara mereka menanggapi ancaman potensial, Badan Pers Saudi melaporkan. Dia menjelaskan bahwa rusa manfaat dari kelembaban tanaman mereka makan, termasuk rumput gurun dan semak-semak, membantu mereka menahan kondisi kering dan mengurangi ketergantungan mereka pada sumber air permukaan. * * media [2795979) * * Data ilmiah yang diterbitkan oleh Komisi Kerajaan untuk AlUla mengindikasikan bahwa gazelle Arab (Gazella arabica) dapat memenuhi persyaratan airnya melalui pola makanannya, tanpa perlu minum langsung. Diet nya meliputi daun tanaman, bunga dan buah, termasuk mereka pohon akasia. * * media [2795980] * althlad mencatat bahwa kemampuan rusa untuk beradaptasi dengan kondisi gurun terhubung dengan diet dan perilaku merumput, serta karakteristik fisiologis yang membantu mereka menahan lingkungan kering. Sifat-sifat ini menawarkan sekilas ke adaptasi alami kijang ke sekitarnya, sedangkan tradisional account mencerminkan minat dari Arab kuno dalam mengamati satwa liar gurun dan mendokumentasikan perilakunya.
articles.originalTitle: Arabian gazelle’s desert adaptability reflected in Arab heritage
articles.originalDescription: RAFHA — Ancient Arabic writings recorded observations of gazelles’ ability to endure thirst and adapt to desert environments. One traditional description portrays the gazelle as compensating for the absence of water by breathing in the breeze, an expression that reflects early Arab observations of the animal’s nature and its ability to survive in arid habitats.Chairman of the Board of Aman Environmental Association in Northern Borders Region Nasser Al-Mujlad said traditional descriptions of the gazelle went beyond its agility and speed to explore its feeding habits, how it copes with water scarcity, and the ways it responds to potential threats, the Saudi Press Agency reported. He explained that gazelles benefit from the moisture in the plants they feed on, including desert grasses and shrubs, helping them withstand dry conditions and reduce their reliance on surface water sources. **media[2795979]**Scientific data published by the Royal Commission for AlUla indicate that the Arabian gazelle (Gazella arabica) can meet its water requirements through its plant-based diet, without necessarily needing to drink water directly. Its diet includes plant leaves, flowers and fruits, including those of acacia trees. **media[2795980]**Al-Mujlad noted that gazelles’ ability to adapt to desert conditions is linked to their diet and grazing behavior, as well as physiological characteristics that help them withstand arid environments. These traits offer a glimpse into the gazelle’s natural adaptation to its surroundings, while traditional accounts reflect the keen interest of ancient Arabs in observing desert wildlife and documenting its behavior.

Jadi harus protes Diberikan oleh Maha Hussaini pada Tue, 11 / 17 / 2026 - 16: 27 Demonstrasi memberi orang Palestina harapan dan tekanan institusi untuk bertindak. Sebuah gencatan senjata yang telah gagal untuk menghentikan pembunuhan, tidak boleh menjadi alasan untuk membungkam Demonstrator di pawai Red Line di Amsterdam, Belanda, pada 8 November 2026, menuntut pemerintah Belanda mengambil tindakan yang lebih kuat terhadap Israel dalam genosida di Gaza (Moasak Mahmalji / Zuma Press Wire via Reuters) setiap minggu pertama genosida Israel di Gaza, sekitar 30 orang dan anak-anak mereka di rumah mereka dimana saya berkumpul di sebuah rumah kosong. Banyak dari mereka membungkus diri mereka dengan selimut wol, beberapa duduk di tanah, yang lain berdiri, mencari mereka sehari-hari "dosis harapan" pada layar televisi. Tanpa listrik, kami menggunakan kekuatan kecil yang tersedia panel surya bisa mengumpulkan dari matahari sepanjang hari untuk menyalakan TV dan menonton berita selama sekitar 30 menit. Setelah tema berita akrab dimainkan, orang-orang berkumpul di sekitar layar mulai memanggil orang lain di dalam rumah untuk bergegas dan bergabung dengan mereka. Di antara mereka, saya berdiri, sangat menyadari bahwa mata berkilau tidak akan menemukan apa yang mereka cari. Mereka akan menemukan tidak ada tindakan internasional diambil terhadap kejahatan perang, kejahatan terhadap kemanusiaan dan genosida kita menyaksikan, tidak ada hukuman internasional yang tepat, dan bahkan bukan pernyataan oleh pemimpin dunia jelas penamaan pelaku. Duduk di bangku beton dengan seorang pria tua dari penampungan sebelah kita yang datang untuk menonton berita dengan kami, saya berbisik: "Apakah Anda masih berharap untuk melihat bermakna tindakan internasional yang diambil saat ini?" Dia bilang dia tidak menonton berita dalam mengantisipasi tindakan apapun oleh pemerintah dunia, tapi menemukan pelipur lara dalam melihat update tentang protes menyapu jalan-jalan

articles.originalDescription: Israel's genocide in Gaza continues. So must the protests Submitted by Maha Hussaini on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 16:27 Demonstrations gave Palestinians hope and pressured institutions to act. A ceasefire that has failed to stop the killing must not become a reason for silence Demonstrators at the Red Line march in Amsterdam, Netherlands, on 8 November 2026, demand that the Dutch government take stronger action against Israel over its genocide in Gaza (Mouafak Mahmalji/Zuma Press Wire via Reuters) Off At 9pm every night during the first weeks of Israel's genocide in Gaza , around 30 people and their children in the home where I was displaced would gather in an empty space in front of the house. Many of them wrapped themselves in woollen blankets, some sitting on the ground, others standing, looking for their daily "dose of hope" on a television screen. With no electricity, we used the little power the available solar panels could collect from the sun all day to turn on the TV and watch the news for around 30 minutes. Once the familiar news theme played, those gathering around the screen started calling on others inside the house to hurry and join them. Among them, I stood, very well aware that those sparkling eyes would not find what they were looking for. They would find no international action taken against the war crimes , crimes against humanity and genocide we were witnessing, no appropriate international condemnation, and not even a statement by a world leader clearly naming the perpetrators. Sitting on a concrete bench with an old displaced man from the shelter next to ours who came to watch the news with us, I whispered: "Do you still hope to see meaningful international action taken this time?" articles.originalDescription: US Centcom commander expected in Saudi Arabia with dozens of air defence experts, sources say Submitted by Sean Mathews on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 15:55 More than three dozen US military officials are expected in Saudi Arabia to advise on the kingdom's air defence A US Air Force member stands near a Patriot missile battery at the Prince Sultan air base in al-Kharj, Saudi Arabia, on 20 February 2020 (AFP) Off US Central Command chief admiral Brad Cooper, the commander of forces in the Middle East, is expected to arrive in Saudi Arabia this week with advisors to examine the kingdom’s air defence capabilities, multiple western officials familiar with the matter told Middle East Eye. The officials, speaking to MEE on condition of anonymity, said more than three dozen US military advisors are going to Saudi Arabia to help the kingdom with its air defence. Some have already started arriving, the officials said. The visit comes as the kingdom reels from Houthi aerial attacks amid a sensitive time in US-Saudi relations. MEE contacted the Pentagon for comment on the visit but didn’t receive a reply by the time of publication. Saudi Arabia has been a strategic US ally in the Middle East since the end of World War II, but President Donald Trump said last week that the kingdom was “disintegrating”. He said Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states had asked him not to resume the war on Iran because of their military vulnerabilities. Saudi Arabia is locked in a quagmire in Yemen, where the Iran-aligned Houthis have made sweeping military gains. The group has also targeted Saudi airports, energy infrastructure and corporate offices, striking at the heart of Riyadh’s effort to pitch itself as a safe destination for investment and tourism. MEE reported exclusively that Houthi forces have also launched ground incursions into Saudi territory. articles.originalDescription: Exclusive: UN commissioner Chris Sidoti says Israel is targeting children in Gaza Submitted by Sondos Asem on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 15:01 Member of UN inquiry tells MEE's Expert Witness Podcast 'there is no ceasefire' Middle East Eye's Sondos Asem speaks to Chris Sidoti for the Expert Witness podcast (MEE) Off More than a year after signing a ceasefire deal, Israel is still committing genocide in Gaza and targeting Palestinian children there and in the occupied West Bank, a member of the UN Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory has told Middle East Eye. “There is no ceasefire in Gaza. People talk about a ceasefire but at best it’s a reduced fire,” Chris Sidoti said in the latest episode of the Expert Witness Podcast . “The killing continues on a daily basis, including the killing of children.” “The circumstances that gave rise to our finding of genocide are still operative inside Gaza. And until those circumstances change fundamentally, then the genocidal activities of the Israeli authorities will continue,” the lawyer and expert on international human rights law said. Sidoti is a former Australian human rights commissioner who also served on the UN fact-finding mission on Myanmar. His remarks follow two major reports by the UN's Palestine commission this year, including a report in June concluding that Israel had deliberately targeted children in Gaza, committing genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes in the coastal enclave, as well as further war crimes in the West Bank. By instrumentalising massive popular discontent , economic hardships , xenophobia, and the scapegoating of non-western peoples and cultures, Le Pen has turned what used to be a fringe group into France’s largest political party. She has capitalised on a devastated social landscape created by decades of neoliberal capitalist policies, successfully stealing the historical terrain and voters of the left and far left. Today, no other party can compete with the National Rally. Only a large coalition could defeat her at the polls next April. It is thus very probable that France may soon be governed by the xenophobic, Islamophobic , ultra-nationalist far right. But if Le Pen is made of titanium, accusations of antisemitism in her party may prove to be her kryptonite. Jordan Bardella, her chosen heir and potential future prime minister, has denied writing antisemitic messages attributed to him in the mid-2010s, when he was a teenager. But the French outlet Mediapart says it was able to verify Bardella as the author, including by obtaining a judicially certified copy of the original 2013 messages from the US social media giant Meta. So far, the accusations have not made a dent in the National Rally’s support. articles.title: Saudi Arabia mencatat 1.8 juta kontrak sewa mobil elektronik di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - perusahaan penyewaan mobil di Arab Saudi mengeluarkan 1.8 juta kontrak elektronik terpadu selama kuartal ketiga 2026, menurut data yang dirilis oleh Otoritas Umum Transportasi. Sosok ini menyoroti skala aktivitas di sektor ini dan mengembangkan ketergantungan pada solusi digital untuk transaksi rental. Menurut data, wilayah Riyadh berisi kontrak elektronik terbesar yang dikeluarkan di seluruh Kingdom, mencapai 30 persen, diikuti oleh wilayah Mekah dengan 24 persen, Provinsi Timur dengan 14 persen, dan Asir dengan 8 persen. California peringkat berikutnya dengan saham 6 persen, diikuti oleh Qassim 5 persen, Jazan 4 persen, dan Tabuk 3 persen. 6 persen sisanya didistribusikan di wilayah kerajaan lain. Otoritas tersebut menjelaskan bahwa kontrak elektronik yang terpadu membantu menjaga hak-hak dari baik kekurangan dan lessees, meningkatkan keandalan transaksi, meningkatkan kualitas layanan, prosedur sewa ban, dan meningkatkan efisiensi proses operasional. Otoritas terus mengejar inisiatif untuk mengembangkan sektor penyewaan mobil dengan meningkatkan kualitas layanan dan meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, sehingga mendukung pertumbuhan sektor dan ketahanan jangka panjang.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia records 1.8 million electronic car rental contracts in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Car rental companies in Saudi Arabia issued more than 1.8 million unified electronic contracts during the third quarter of 2026, according to data released by the Transport General Authority. The figure highlights the scale of activity in the sector and the growing reliance on digital solutions to streamline rental transactions.According to the data, the Riyadh region accounted for the largest share of electronic contracts issued across the Kingdom, reaching 30 percent, followed by the Makkah region with 24 percent, the Eastern Province with 14 percent, and Asir with 8 percent.Madinah ranked next with a 6 percent share, followed by Qassim 5 percent, Jazan 4 percent, and Tabuk 3 percent. The remaining 6 percent was distributed among the Kingdom’s other regions. The authority explained that the unified electronic contract helps safeguard the rights of both lessors and lessees, enhance transaction reliability, improve service quality, streamline rental procedures, and boost the efficiency of operational processes.The authority continues to pursue initiatives to develop the car rental sector by enhancing service quality and improving operational efficiency, thereby supporting the sector’s growth and long-term sustainability.

articles.title: Penduduk Israel membunuh nenek Palestina di rumahnya di Jericho
articles.description: Penduduk Israel membunuh nenek-nenek Palestina di rumahnya di Jericho, pemukim Israel menembak mati seorang wanita Palestina tua dan melukai delapan anggota keluarganya, termasuk anak-anaknya dan cucu-cucunya, selama serangan terhadap sebuah rumah di desa Ein al- Duyuk al- Taita, barat dari kota Yerikho dalam menduduki Tepi Barat. Saksi mata mengatakan kepada Mata Timur Tengah bahwa pemukim bersenjata memasuki rumah Palestina di tengah malam pada hari Senin dan menembak 73- tahun Fidda Fheidat tua di kepala, membunuhnya di tempat. Para pemukim, yang baru-baru ini menyita delapan rumah Palestina di daerah yang berdekatan dengan desa, langsung menembaki anggota keluarga lainnya, melukai delapan rumah. Ahmad Fheidat, saudara korban ipar, mengatakan bahwa ketika mendengar tembakan, ia bergegas untuk mengusir pemukim. Dia merasa sakit yang tajam di kakinya dan menyadari ia telah ditembak, melihat ke belakang, ia melihat Fidda berbaring di tanah, pendarahan dari kepalanya. "Meskipun cedera, aku bergegas ke arahnya dan memanggilnya. Ketika saya meletakkan tangan saya di atas kepalanya, saya melihat bahwa tengkoraknya telah terbelah oleh api jarak dekat; darahnya telah berhamburan ke dinding rumah," katanya. Baca lagi: pemukim Israel membunuh nenek Palestina di rumahnya di Jericho
articles.originalTitle: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian grandmother in her home in Jericho
articles.originalDescription: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian grandmother in her home in Jericho Israeli settlers shot dead an elderly Palestinian woman and wounded eight of her family members, including her children and grandchildren, during an attack on a home in the village of Ein al-Duyuk al-Tahta, west of Jericho in the occupied West Bank. Eyewitnesses told Middle East Eye that armed settlers entered the Palestinian home in the middle of the night on Monday and shot 73-year-old Fidda Fheidat in the head, killing her on the spot. The settlers, who had recently seized eight Palestinian homes in an area adjacent to the village, went on to fire at other members of the family, wounding eight of them. Ahmad Fheidat, the victim’s brother-in-law, said that on hearing the gunfire, he rushed to repel the settlers. He felt a sharp pain in his leg and realised he had been shot; looking behind him, he saw Fidda lying on the ground, bleeding from her head. "Despite the injury, I rushed towards her and called out to her. When I placed my hand on her head, I saw that her skull had been split open by the close-range fire; her blood had splattered onto the walls of the house," he said. Read more: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian grandmother in her home in Jericho

articles.title: Badan migrasi PBB memperingatkan lebih banyak kematian hipotermia Gaza, seperti Israel bar 100.000 tenda dari memasuki wilayah
articles.description: Badan migrasi PBB memperingatkan lebih banyak kematian hipotermia Gaza, seperti Israel bar 100.000 tenda dari memasuki wilayah Badan migrasi PBB telah memperingatkan akan kematian lebih lanjut dari hipotermia di Gaza karena Israel terus membatasi akses bantuan penampungan ke wilayah tersebut. Hujan lebat menyapu melalui medan perang-robek pekan lalu, membatalkan ribuan tenda darurat di mana mayoritas penduduk Gaza berlindung. Seorang bayi berusia sembilan puluh bulan meninggal karena kedinginan di tengah suhu jatuh. "Tanpa tempat penampungan yang tepat, tanpa barang pertolongan yang kritis, maka kematian hipotermia akan terjadi", Karl Baker, kepala Organisasi Internasional untuk program Migrasi Gaza, berkata pada hari Selasa, menambahkan bahwa anak-anak sangat rentan, karena mereka kehilangan panas tubuh lebih cepat. "Ini tidak dapat diterima untuk memiliki hipotermia di dunia modern." Baker mengatakan bahwa beberapa 100.000 tenda berada di luar Gaza, namun pihak berwenang Israel telah melarang entri barang yang mereka anggap "kegunaan ganda" - terutama tempat penampungan barang termasuk tiang tenda dan rumah bergerak. Baker menjelaskan pertemuan keluarga yang basah kuyup perlindungan di bawah kendur, buruk - out tarpaulins. "Gaza berubah menjadi satu kamp IDP yang besar (orang-orang pengungsi internal). Ini jajaran sebagai salah satu yang terburuk Aku sudah berjalan melalui," katanya. Pelaporan oleh Reuters
articles.originalTitle: UN migration agency warns of more Gaza hypothermia deaths, as Israel bars 100,000 tents from entering territory
articles.originalDescription: UN migration agency warns of more Gaza hypothermia deaths, as Israel bars 100,000 tents from entering territory The UN migration agency has warned of further deaths from hypothermia in Gaza as Israel continues to heavily restrict the entry of shelter aid into the territory. Heavy rains swept through the war-torn enclave last week, inundating thousands of makeshift tents where the majority of Gaza's population is sheltering. A nine-month-old baby died from the cold amid the plummeting temperatures. "Without proper shelter, without critical relief items, then hypothermia deaths will occur," Karl Baker, head of the International Organization for Migration's Gaza programme, said on Tuesday, adding that children were particularly vulnerable, since they lose body heat more quickly. "It's unacceptable to have hypothermia in the modern world." Baker said that some 100,000 tents were prepositioned outside Gaza, but the Israeli authorities had barred the entry of items which they consider to be "dual use"- predominantly shelter items including tent poles and mobile homes. Baker described meeting a drenched family sheltering beneath sagging, worn-out tarpaulins. "Gaza is turning into one large IDP camp (internally displaced persons). It ranks as one of the worst I've walked through," he said. Reporting by Reuters

articles.title: Kementerian HR: Tidak ada kesepakatan dengan Kenya untuk perekrutan pekerja terampil
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial telah mengkonfirmasi bahwa annex teknis yang ditandatangani dengan Kenya secara eksklusif dimaksudkan untuk mengatur perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri dan tidak mencakup perekrutan pekerja terampil untuk berbagai sektor. Kementerian menjelaskan bahwa tidak ada kesepakatan saat ini untuk perekrutan pekerja terampil dari Kenya. Dalam pernyataan klarifikasi yang dikeluarkan pada hari Selasa, pelayanan tersebut menjelaskan bahwa perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri dari Kenya terbatas pada pekerjaan tertentu, termasuk pekerja domestik dan pengemudi swasta, dan tidak memperpanjang kesempatan kerja di sektor profesional lain. Kamis lalu, Wakil Menteri Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial untuk Tenaga Kerja Abdullah Abuthnain dan Sekretaris Kabinet Kenya untuk Buruh dan Perlindungan Sosial Alfred Nganga Mutua menandatangani annex teknis untuk perjanjian perekrutan pekerja domestik antara Arab Saudi dan Kenya yang telah ditandatangani pada 5 Juli 2026. Upacara penandatanganan itu diadakan selama kunjungan Alfred Nganga Mutua ke Riyadh. Annex adalah bagian dari upaya untuk memperkuat kerjasama dan mengembangkan mekanisme teknis dan regulasi yang mengatur perekrutan pekerja domestik. Departemen mencatat bahwa annex teknis dibangun sekitar tiga pilar utama: mengurangi biaya perekrutan, meningkatkan kualitas pekerja domestik melalui pelatihan dan program kualifikasi, dan menjaga hak-hak dari semua pihak yang terlibat dalam hubungan kontrak. Untuk bagiannya, pihak Kenya menyatakan kesiapan untuk memasok pekerja dalam negeri sesuai dengan peraturan dan prosedur yang berlaku di Kerajaan, sambil berpegang teguh pada persyaratan biaya perekrutan dan jangka waktu. Rekrutmen akan didasarkan pada permintaan yang sebenarnya dan persyaratan dari majikan, baik warga negara maupun penduduk. articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development has confirmed that the technical annex signed with Kenya is exclusively intended to regulate the recruitment of domestic workers and does not cover the recruitment of skilled workers for various sectors. The signing ceremony was held during the visit of Alfred Nganga Mutua to Riyadh. The annex is part of efforts to strengthen cooperation and develop the technical and regulatory mechanisms governing the recruitment of domestic workers.The ministry noted that the technical annex is built around three key pillars: reducing recruitment costs, enhancing the quality of domestic workers through training and qualification programs, and safeguarding the rights of all parties involved in the contractual relationship.For its part, the Kenyan side expressed its readiness to supply domestic workers in accordance with the regulations and procedures in force in the Kingdom, while adhering to the stipulated recruitment costs and timeframes. articles.title: Arab Saudi sangat mengutuk serangan berulang Iran di Bahrain
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Luar Negeri menyatakan kutukan terkuat Arab Saudi atas serangan berulang-ulang Iran di Bahrain, menggambarkan mereka sebagai pelanggaran yang mencolok terhadap hukum internasional dan prinsip-prinsip lingkungan yang baik. "Serangan ini melemahkan upaya perdamaian dan upaya yang berkelanjutan untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas wilayah dan rakyatnya", kata Menteri dalam sebuah pernyataan. Arab Saudi menegaskan kembali solidaritas penuh dengan Bahrain dalam segala hal untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas. The Kingdom juga menekankan kebutuhan mendesak untuk segera berhenti untuk semua serangan terang-terangan Iran terhadap negara-negara di wilayah, sementara mendasari pentingnya memungkinkan upaya diplomatik untuk mengejar perdamaian dan menyelesaikan krisis melalui negosiasi, pernyataan ditambahkan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns repeated Iranian attacks on Bahrain
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia’s strongest condemnation of the repeated Iranian attacks on Bahrain, describing them as a flagrant violation of international law and the principles of good neighborliness. “These attacks undermine peace efforts and ongoing endeavors to safeguard the security and stability of the region and its people,” the ministry said in a statement.Saudi Arabia reaffirmed its full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures it takes to safeguard its security and stability. The Kingdom also stressed the urgent need for an immediate halt to all blatant Iranian attacks against the countries of the region, while underscoring the importance of allowing diplomatic efforts to pursue peace and resolve the crisis through negotiations, the statement added.

articles.title: Raja Salman Royal Reserve mencatat dua kelahiran rusa Arab rentan
articles.description: SAKKA - Raja Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve mencatat dua kelahiran rusa Arab baru pada bulan November 2026, sebagai bagian dari upaya untuk memperkenalkan kembali spesies satwa liar, meningkatkan keanekaragaman hayati dan memulihkan keseimbangan ekologi dalam cadangan. Gazelle Arab (Gazella arabica), dikenal sebagai "Al- Idmi", diklasifikasikan sebagai Vulnerable di International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List dan merupakan salah satu spesies yang ditargetkan oleh program pengenalan ulang cadangan. * * Media [2795757] * Perempuan Arab rusa biasanya melahirkan satu keturunan pada suatu waktu, membuat dua kelahiran dicatat terutama signifikan untuk konservasi upaya ditujukan untuk melindungi spesies. Cadangan sebelumnya tercatat kelahiran rusa Arab pada tahun 2024. Kelahiran terbaru menunjukkan keberhasilan program perawatan dan pembiakan cadangan, serta keikutsertaan habitat alaminya untuk mendukung spesies dan mempertahankan reproduksi. * * media [2795759] * * Raja Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority terus mengimplementasikan inisiatif untuk melindungi satwa liar, mengembangkan habitat alam dan memperkenalkan kembali spesies asli ke lingkungan asli mereka. Upaya ini berkontribusi untuk memulihkan keseimbangan ekologi, memperkaya keanekaragaman hayati dan memajukan tujuan keberlanjutan lingkungan Saudi Arabia.
articles.originalTitle: King Salman Royal Reserve records two births of vulnerable Arabian gazelles
articles.originalDescription: SKAKA — The King Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve recorded two new Arabian gazelle births in November 2026, as part of its ongoing efforts to reintroduce wildlife species, enhance biodiversity and restore ecological balance within the reserve. The Arabian gazelle (Gazella arabica), locally known as “Al-Idmi,” is classified as Vulnerable on the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List and is among the species targeted by the reserve’s reintroduction programs. **media[2795757]** Female Arabian gazelles typically give birth to one offspring at a time, making the two recorded births particularly significant for conservation efforts aimed at protecting the species. The reserve previously recorded Arabian gazelle births in 2024. The latest births indicate the success of the reserve’s care and breeding programs, as well as the suitability of its natural habitats for supporting the species and sustaining its reproduction. **media[2795759]** The King Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority continues to implement initiatives aimed at protecting wildlife, developing natural habitats and reintroducing native species into their original environments. These efforts contribute to restoring ecological balance, enriching biodiversity and advancing Saudi Arabia’s environmental sustainability objectives.

articles.title: Nilai pasar dari lonjakan aset tak berwujud Saudi Exchange ke SR5.78 triliun
articles.description: RIYADH - Nilai pasar dari aset tak berwujud yang dipegang oleh perusahaan-perusahaan yang terdaftar di Pertukaran Saudi mencapai sekitar SR5.78 triliun pada akhir 2025, akuntansi sebesar 65,6 persen dari total nilai pasar mereka, menurut Asset tak berwujud 2025 di Kerajaan Arab Saudi laporan yang dikeluarkan oleh Saudi Authority for Inteleprential Properti (SAIP). Nilai aset tak berwujud diungkapkan dalam laporan keuangan berdiri di sekitar SR311.52 miliar, laporan menunjukkan. Laporan ini memeriksa kondisi aset tak berwujud saat ini, nilai ekonomi mereka, dan peran mereka dalam meningkatkan persaingan dan mendukung pengetahuan dan inovasi berbasis pertumbuhan ekonomi, sejalan dengan tujuan dari Saudi Vision 2030. Ini bertujuan untuk mengukur nilai pasar aset tak berwujud dipegang oleh perusahaan yang terdaftar di Saudi Exchange dan menganalisis distribusi mereka di sektor. Penerbitan laporan ini adalah bagian dari upaya SAIP untuk meningkatkan kesadaran akan nilai ekonomi dari aset tak berwujud dan mendukung pengembangan praktek pengelolaan dan investasi di dalamnya, sehingga berkontribusi untuk merangsang inovasi, menarik investasi, dan meningkatkan persaingan ekonomi nasional.
articles.originalTitle: Market value of Saudi Exchange’s intangible assets surges to SR5.78 trillion
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The market value of intangible assets held by companies listed on the Saudi Exchange reached approximately SR5.78 trillion at the end of 2025, accounting for 65.6 percent of their total market value, according to Intangible Assets 2025 in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia report issued by the Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property (SAIP).The value of intangible assets disclosed in financial statements stood at approximately SR311.52 billion, the report pointed out. The report examines the current state of intangible assets, their economic value, and their role in enhancing competitiveness and supporting knowledge- and innovation-based economic growth, in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. It aims to measure the market value of intangible assets held by companies listed on the Saudi Exchange and analyze their distribution across sectors. The report’s publication is part of SAIP’s efforts to raise awareness of the economic value of intangible assets and support the development of practices for managing and investing in them, thereby contributing to stimulating innovation, attracting investment, and enhancing the competitiveness of the national economy.

Ini adalah bagian dari upaya untuk memverifikasi kualifikasi teknik, melindungi profesi, dan meningkatkan kredibilitas akreditasi profesional. Rekayasa elektrikal mencatat jumlah sertifikat tak valid tertinggi, dengan 174, diikuti dengan teknik sipil, arsitektur, dan konstruksi dengan 83, dan mekanik teknik dengan 79. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Council of Engineers detects 1,593 invalid and unaccredited certificates
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Saudi Council of Engineers, in cooperation with the "Mosadaqa" platform, detected 603 invalid certificates and 990 unaccredited certificates between January and October 2026. This was part of its efforts to verify engineering qualifications, protect the profession, and enhance the credibility of professional accreditation. Electrical engineering recorded the highest number of invalid certificates, with 174, followed by civil engineering, architecture, and construction with 83, and mechanical engineering with 79. The remaining certificates were distributed across other engineering and technical disciplines. The council referred cases involving invalid certificates to the competent authorities for further action.

articles.originalTitle: Makkah Clock Tower wins Guinness Records for highest museum, observation deck
articles.originalDescription: MAKKAH — The Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites has achieved two new global milestones with Guinness World Records for the world’s highest museum in a building and the highest outdoor observation deck. The first record recognizes the Makkah Clock Tower Museum as the highest museum inside a building, at an altitude of 426.875 meters. The second honors the world’s highest outdoor observation deck, located at 560.875 meters within the Makkah Clock Tower complex. This achievement reflects the royal commission’s ongoing efforts to develop prominent landmarks and facilities, harness Makkah’s historical, scientific, and architectural assets, enrich the experiences of residents, pilgrims, and visitors, and reinforce the city’s position as a global destination that blends authenticity with modernity.

articles.title: Britania sanksi pembangunan pemukiman Israel, Gaza pembantu-memblokir aktivis
articles.description: Britania sanksi pembangunan pemukiman Israel, Gaza pembantu-memblokir aktivis Pemerintah Inggris mengumumkan pada hari Selasa itu akan memaksakan sanksi pada delapan perusahaan konstruksi Israel yang terlibat dalam membangun pemukiman di Tepi Barat yang ditempati dan kelompok aktivis yang mencegah pengiriman bantuan ke Gaza. Inggris mengumumkan pembekuan aset dan direktur mendiskualifikasikan delapan perusahaan termasuk Har Hevron Development Company Ltd, Hemdat Shomron Ltd dan S.A.G. (Velvel) Konstruksi dan Pengembangan Ltd, yang membangun dan mengembangkan rumah di Tepi Barat. Pemerintah mengumumkan paket sanksi segera sebelum tenggat waktu akhir untuk E1 tender, proyek penyelesaian yang akan bisect Israel diduduki Bank Barat dan memotongnya dari Yerusalem Timur, fragmenting tanah Palestina harapan akan membentuk jantung negara. "Melindungi kedua solusi negara adalah Bintang Utara pendekatan Pemerintah ini", sekretaris asing Inggris, Ed Miliband, mengatakan dalam sebuah pernyataan. "Itulah sebabnya pesan saya di E1 jelas: jangan menawar, jangan membangun, dan tidak mendapatkan keuntungan dari kehancuran dua negara". Pemerintah juga dikenakan sanksi di Tzav 9, sebuah kelompok yang mengatakan secara teratur diblokir truk bantuan kemanusiaan memberikan makanan, air dan bahan bakar ke Jalur Gaza. Israel pada bulan September mengancam akan menutup pembangunan Konsulat Inggris di Yerusalem Timur dalam menanggapi keputusan London untuk memaksakan sanksi perdagangan terhadap pemukiman Israel di Tepi Barat. diplomat Inggris dan Israel bulan lalu mencapai kesepakatan-menit terakhir untuk menghindari penutupan konsulat. Pelaporan oleh Reuters
articles.originalTitle: Britain sanctions Israeli settlement builders, Gaza aid-blocking activists
articles.originalDescription: Britain sanctions Israeli settlement builders, Gaza aid-blocking activists The British government announced on Tuesday it would impose sanctions on eight Israeli construction companies involved in building settlements in the occupied West Bank and an activist group that prevents the delivery of aid to Gaza. Britain announced asset freezes and director disqualifications on the eight companies including Har Hevron Development Company Ltd, Hemdat Shomron Ltd and S.A.G. (Velvel) Construction and Development Ltd, which construct and develop homes in the West Bank. The government announced the sanctions package shortly before the final deadlines for the E1 tender, a settlement project which would bisect the Israeli-occupied West Bank and cut it off from East Jerusalem, fragmenting the land Palestinians hope will form the heart of a state. "Protecting the two-state solution is the North Star of this Government's approach," the British foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, said in a statement. "That is why my message on E1 is clear: do not bid, do not build, and do not profit from the destruction of the two-state solution." The government also imposed sanctions on Tzav 9, a group which it said had regularly blocked humanitarian aid trucks delivering food, water and fuel to the Gaza Strip. Israel in September threatened to close the British Consulate building in East Jerusalem in response to London’s decision to impose trade sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank. British and Israeli diplomats last month reached a last-minute agreement to avoid the closure of the consulate. Reporting by Reuters

articles.title: Arab Saudi, Inggris menandatangani perjanjian untuk mempercepat akses ke perawatan medis inovatif
articles.description: LONDON - The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) menandatangani sebuah memorandum pemahaman (MoU) dengan Obat-obatan Inggris dan Layanan Kesehatan Produk (MHRA) untuk memajukan evaluasi pengobatan inovatif dan memfasilitasi akses pasien kepada mereka. Persetujuan itu ditandatangani oleh Kepala Eksekutif SFDA, Dr. Hisham bin Saad Al- Jadhey dan Kepala Eksekutif MHRA Lawrence Tallon di pinggir Asosiasi Informasi Obat-obatan dan Obat-obatan serta Badan Regulasi Layanan Kesehatan (DIA-MHRA) Global Summit, diselenggarakan di London pada bulan November 16-17, dengan tujuan untuk mempercepat akses ke pengobatan inovatif sambil mempertahankan keselamatan, kualitas dan standar keberhasilan. Kepala MHRA Profesor Anthony Harnden juga hadir di penandatanganan. Kedua pihak juga mengadakan diskusi mengenai prioritas kerja sama dalam hal perkembangan ilmiah dan regulasi. * * Media [2795632] * Membangun pada kerjasama yang sudah ada dan komitmen bersama untuk memajukan inovasi medis, MoU mencakup evaluasi pengobatan untuk penyakit langka, terapi lanjutan dan produk bioteknologi. Ini juga termasuk pengubahan keahlian tentang penggunaan kecerdasan buatan, pemodelan komputer dan simulasi dalam studi klinis dan uji coba, serta pendaftaran dan evaluasi produk medis, praktek manufaktur yang baik, sistem berkualitas, pengujian produk dan analisis, dan pengawasan rantai pasokan. Kerjasama ini diharapkan untuk membantu mengklarifikasi persyaratan regulasi bagi pengembang pada tahap awal, terutama mereka yang mengembangkan pengobatan untuk pasien dengan pilihan terapi terbatas. Upaya ini bertujuan untuk memperkuat keamanan produk medis di pasar kedua negara dan meningkatkan kemampuan otoritas baik untuk mengidentifikasi dan memantau risiko terkait.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, UK sign agreement to accelerate access to innovative medical treatments
articles.originalDescription: LONDON — The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the UK's Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) to advance the evaluation of innovative treatments and facilitate timely patient access to them. The agreement was signed by SFDA Chief Executive Officer Dr. Hisham bin Saad Al-Jadhey and MHRA Chief Executive Lawrence Tallon on the sidelines of the Drug Information Association and Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (DIA-MHRA) Global Summit, held in London on November 16–17, with the aim of accelerating access to innovative treatments while maintaining safety, quality and efficacy standards. MHRA Chair Professor Anthony Harnden was also present at the signing. The two sides also held discussions on cooperation priorities in light of recent scientific and regulatory developments. **media[2795632]** Building on existing cooperation and a shared commitment to advancing medical innovation, the MoU covers the evaluation of treatments for rare diseases, advanced therapies and biotechnology products. It also includes exchanging expertise on the use of artificial intelligence, computer modeling and simulation in clinical studies and trials, as well as the registration and evaluation of medical products, good manufacturing practices, quality systems, product testing and analysis, and supply chain monitoring. The cooperation is expected to help clarify regulatory requirements for developers at an early stage, particularly those developing treatments for patients with limited therapeutic options. These efforts aim to strengthen medical product safety in both countries' markets and enhance the ability of both authorities to identify and monitor associated risks.

articles.originalTitle: ‘Will you stand watch with me?’ Israel cracks down on foreign activists in West Bank
articles.originalDescription: ‘Will you stand watch with me?’ Israel cracks down on foreign activists in West Bank Submitted by Kate McMahon on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 14:54 As settler attacks intensify during the olive harvest, international volunteers face arrest, deportation and entry bans for accompanying Palestinians and documenting abuses A Palestinian farmer watches for Israeli settlers during the olive harvest in Turmus Ayya, northeast of Ramallah, in the occupied West Bank, on 20 October 2026 (Zain Jaafar/AFP) Off In Masafer Yatta, on the southern edge of the occupied West Bank, a mural stretches across a village guesthouse, posing a question: “Will you stand watch with me?” The question is directed at international volunteers arriving in the rural Palestinian community. But a recent escalation in Israeli crackdowns has meant less outside support. As settler violence against Palestinians intensifies during the annual olive harvest, Israeli authorities have stepped up measures against foreign activists, including bans and deportations. According to news reports and campaigners, more than 40 international activists have been deported since 1 October over allegations including entering a restricted zone, disrupting public order and terrorism. “Despite their obsessive and extensive surveillance apparatus, the occupation is afraid of people knowing the truth about what’s going on. Whenever we witnessed a settler attack, we were immediately ordered to stop filming by the army,” a German activist told Middle East Eye. The activist, who declined to be identified, was arrested on 6 November and subsequently deported. “They even took away people’s phones or destroyed them,” she added. articles.title: Arab Saudi pulih hampir 70.000 artefak arkeologi, termasuk 28.577 dari luar negeri
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi telah pulih sekitar 70.000 artefak arkeologi dari dalam Kerajaan dan di luar negeri pada tahun 2026, termasuk 28.577 artefak kembali dari luar negeri, menurut Komisi Warisan Saudi. Komisi mengungkapkan bahwa lebih dari 41.000 artefak ditemukan di Arab Saudi, sementara yang diambil dari luar negeri dihitung lebih dari 40 persen dari total. Di antara pemulihan yang terkenal, keluarga Amerika mengembalikan 1,127 artefak arkeologi ke Arab Saudi pada tahun 2019. Barang-barang ini telah diselenggarakan oleh kerabat yang sebelumnya bekerja di Kingdom pada tahun 1960-an. Dalam kasus lain, sebuah tablet batu bantalan prasasti kuno Arab dari wilayah Tabuk dikembalikan dari Perancis setelah tersisa dalam kepemilikan warga negara Perancis selama sekitar 40 tahun. Kembalinya telah dikoordinasikan dengan otoritas Saudi dan UNESCO. Dalam Kerajaan, upaya pemulihan telah termasuk handover sukarela oleh warga negara dan kejang artefak yang ditawarkan untuk dijual secara ilegal. Dalam Hail, seorang warga negara menyerahkan kapal perunggu dating ke periode Islam, dihiasi dengan motif bunga dan ayat-ayat Quraisy. Di Bisha, warga negara lain kembali enam artefak arkeologi, beberapa tanggal untuk masa pra-Islam, termasuk batu terukir dengan ayat-ayat Surah Al- Falaq. Sementara itu, di Al- Ahsa, Komisi Warisan menyita langka artefak tanggal ke awal Islam periode pada tahun 2025 setelah ditawarkan untuk dijual secara ilegal melalui media sosial.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia recovers nearly 70,000 archaeological artifacts, including 28,577 from abroad
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has recovered approximately 70,000 archaeological artifacts from within the Kingdom and abroad as of 2026, including 28,577 artifacts returned from overseas, according to the Saudi Heritage Commission. The commission revealed that more than 41,000 artifacts were recovered within Saudi Arabia, while those retrieved from abroad accounted for more than 40 percent of the total. Among the notable recoveries, American families returned 1,127 archaeological artifacts to Saudi Arabia in 2019. The items had been held by relatives who previously worked in the Kingdom during the 1960s. In another case, a stone tablet bearing ancient Arabic inscriptions from the Tabuk region was returned from France after remaining in the possession of a French citizen for approximately 40 years. Its return was coordinated with Saudi authorities and UNESCO. **media[2795591]** Within the Kingdom, recovery efforts have included voluntary handovers by citizens and the seizure of artifacts offered for sale illegally. In Hail, a citizen handed over a bronze vessel dating to the Islamic period, decorated with floral motifs and Quranic verses. In Bisha, another citizen returned six archaeological artifacts, some dating to the pre-Islamic period, including a stone engraved with verses from Surah Al-Falaq. Meanwhile, in Al-Ahsa, the Heritage Commission seized a rare artifact dating to the early Islamic period in 2025 after it was offered for sale illegally through social media.

articles.title: Transportasi Saudi dan registrasi penyimpanan meningkat 31% menjadi 185.554 di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Registrasi komersial aktif di sektor transportasi dan penyimpanan Arab Saudi naik 31 persen menjadi 185.554 di akhir Q3 dari 2026, sementara transportasi transportasi di jalan registrasi meningkat 52 persen, menurut Departemen Perdagangan. Departemen melaporkan pertumbuhan pendaftaran komersial yang aktif di beberapa kegiatan transportasi dan logistik, mencerminkan memperluas aktivitas perdagangan dan pengembangan rantai pasokan sejalan dengan Saudi Vision 2030. Registrasi komersial aktif dalam layanan logistik mencapai 29.992 pada akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, naik 35 persen dari 22.097 selama periode yang sama pada 2025. Sementara itu, sektor transportasi dan penyimpanan mencatat peningkatan 31 persen, dengan pendaftaran komersial yang aktif mencapai 185.554, dibandingkan dengan 141.180 per tahun sebelumnya. Transportasi angkutan jalan mencatat laju pertumbuhan tertinggi di antara kegiatan yang disorot, dengan pendaftaran meningkat 52 persen dari 68.697 pada kuartal ketiga 2025 sampai 104.612 pada kuartal ketiga 2026. Registrasi komersial untuk penyimpanan di pelabuhan, fasilitas bea cukai dan zona bebas juga meningkat 46 persen, mencapai 9.111 dibandingkan dengan 6.228 selama periode yang sama tahun lalu. Departemen mengatakan pertumbuhan mencerminkan memperluas peluang bisnis dan investasi dan sektor swasta meningkatkan peran dalam mengembangkan ekosistem logistik, mendukung persaingan ekonomi dan memperkuat Saudi Arabia sebagai pusat logistik global.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi transport and storage registrations rise 31% to 185,554 in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Active commercial registrations in Saudi Arabia’s transport and storage sector rose 31 percent to 185,554 by the end of Q3 of 2026, while road freight transport registrations surged 52 percent, according to the Ministry of Commerce. The ministry reported growth in active commercial registrations across several transport and logistics activities, reflecting expanding trade activity and supply chain development in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Active commercial registrations in logistics services reached 29,992 by the end of the third quarter of 2026, up 35 percent from 22,097 during the same period in 2025. Meanwhile, the transport and storage sector recorded a 31 percent increase, with active commercial registrations reaching 185,554, compared with 141,180 a year earlier. Road freight transport recorded the highest growth rate among the activities highlighted, with registrations rising 52 percent from 68,697 in the third quarter of 2025 to 104,612 in the third quarter of 2026. Commercial registrations for storage at ports, customs facilities and free zones also increased 46 percent, reaching 9,111 compared with 6,228 during the same period last year. The ministry said the growth reflects expanding business and investment opportunities and the private sector’s increasing role in developing the logistics ecosystem, supporting economic competitiveness and strengthening Saudi Arabia’s position as a global logistics hub.

articles.originalTitle: Iran’s Ghalibaf warns US, Israel against targeting civilian infrastructure
articles.originalDescription: Iran’s Ghalibaf warns US, Israel against targeting civilian infrastructure Iran’s top negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has warned of retaliation to the US and Israel after a New York Times report quoted analysts pointing to Tehran's "dual-use" of civilian infrastructure. "Prepping the next round on civilian infra, their 'experts' tell NYT: 'dams near Iran’s missile sites are dual-use.'," he mockingly referenced the article. "Cool. New rule: Any dam, port, or power plant near a US or Israeli base is dual-use. We’ll apply your logic consistently and even-handedly," Ghalibaf added. The US and Israel have previously attacked civilian areas and infrastructure across the region under the guise that they are used for military purpose, despite having no evidence for such claims. As a result, countless civilians have been killed and wounded in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.

articles.title: Mamdani untuk membubarkan unit khusus NYPD yang dikerahkan selama protes pro-Palestina
articles.description: Mamdani untuk membubarkan unit khusus NYPD yang dikerahkan selama protes protes walikota New York Zohran Mamdani diumumkan pada hari Senin bahwa ia akan menepati janji kampanyenya untuk membubarkan Grup Respon Strategis Departemen Kepolisian New York (SRG) dan menggantinya dengan "de- eskalasi group". Armour-clad SRG terdiri dari 500 perwira NYPD yang sangat terlatih yang telah menjadi terkenal karena "taktik pengendalian massa" mereka dan penangkapan massal selama protes di New York City, di mana mereka menggunakan baton, gas air mata, semprotan merica dan senjata "de- eskalasi" lainnya pada demonstran yang mengganggu. Kelompok tersebut berada di bawah pengawasan khusus selama protes di Palestina selama puncak genosida Israel di Gaza dan protes kampus yang dipimpin oleh gerakan pelajar yang dimulai di Universitas Columbia. articles.originalTitle: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests
articles.originalDescription: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced on Monday that he will keep his campaign promise to disband the New York Police Department's Strategic Response Group (SRG) and replace it with “de-escalation groups”. The armour-clad SRG is made up of 500 highly trained NYPD officers who have become infamous for their “crowd control tactics” and mass arrests during protests in New York City, where they use batons, tear gas, pepper spray and other “de-escalation” weapons on disruptive protesters. The group came under particular scrutiny during pro-Palestine protests during the height of Israel’s genocide in Gaza and campus protests led by the student movement that started at Columbia University. Read more: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests

articles.title: Militer Islam Coalition meluncurkan program kontraterorisme tahun ke-2 di Chad
articles.description: N 'DJAMENA - Kontra Militer Islam Terorisme Koalisi (IMCTC) diluncurkan pada hari Senin tahun kedua program untuk negara-negara Sahel di N' Djamena, ibukota Chad, dengan dukungan dari Arab Saudi. Program empat minggu, berjalan dari 16 November ke 11 Desember 2026, bertujuan untuk melatih 150 personil sipil dan militer melalui serangkaian program dan workshop meliputi ideologi, media, pembiayaan teroris, dan aspek militer. Upacara peluncuran itu dihadiri oleh Menteri Tempur Chad, Veteran, dan Korban Perang Issakha Maloua Djaous; Sekretaris Jendral IMCTC. Jenderal Moghedi Al-, dan beberapa militer, keamanan, dan pejabat sipil dari Chad. Tahun kedua dibangun dengan pencapaian program ini pada tahun pertama, di mana koalisi yang dilakukan dengan 22 kegiatan menguntungkan 2,300 orang di lima negara: Mauritania, Mali, Niger, Atlantis Faso, dan Chad. Dalam alamatnya, Menteri Djaous menyatakan kebanggaan Chad dalam keanggotaan dalam koalisi, mengatakan peluncuran program tahun kedua mencerminkan dukungan IMCTC yang berkelanjutan untuk negara-negara Sahel dalam memerangi terorisme. Dia mengatakan empat bidang pekerjaan ditujukan taktik berkembang kelompok teroris, termasuk penyebaran ideologi ekstrimis, mengeksploitasi platform media, mengamankan pendanaan, dan melaksanakan operasi. Dia menambahkan bahwa pelatihan 150 personil sipil dan militer akan membantu memperkuat kemampuan lembaga Chadian bertanggung jawab untuk menangani ancaman ini. Menteri mengatakan terorisme tetap menjadi salah satu tantangan utama dari era ini, melintasi perbatasan dan harapan untuk kerjasama dan stabilitas. Dia menekankan bahwa pergerakan kelompok teroris di seluruh negara Sahel diperlukan koordinasi regional dan internasional, menegaskan komitmen Chad untuk keamanan dan pertahanan kolektif upaya sejalan dengan prioritas nasional dan kerjasama regional. Dia berterima kasih kepada Penjaga dari dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman untuk peran Keraja
articles.originalTitle: Islamic Military Coalition launches 2nd year of Saudi-backed counterterrorism program in Chad
articles.originalDescription: N’DJAMENA — The Islamic Military Counter Terrorism Coalition (IMCTC) launched on Monday the second year of its program for the Sahel countries in N’Djamena, capital of Chad, with support from Saudi Arabia.The four-week program, running from November 16 to December 11, 2026, aims to train 150 civilian and military personnel through a series of programs and workshops covering ideological, media, counter-terrorist financing, and military aspects.The launch ceremony was attended by Chad’s Minister of the Armed Forces, Veterans, and War Victims Issakha Maloua Djamous; IMCTC Secretary General Maj. Gen. Mohammed Al-Moghedi; and several military, security, and civilian officials from Chad. The second year builds on the achievements of the program’s first year, during which the coalition conducted 22 activities benefiting 2,300 people across five countries: Mauritania, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso, and Chad. **media[2795492]**In his address, Minister Djamous expressed Chad’s pride in its membership in the coalition, saying the launch of the program’s second year reflected IMCTC’s continued support for Sahel countries in combating terrorism.He said the four areas of work addressed the evolving tactics of terrorist groups, including spreading extremist ideology, exploiting media platforms, securing funding, and carrying out operations. He added that training 150 civilian and military personnel would help strengthen the capabilities of Chadian institutions responsible for addressing these threats.The minister said terrorism remained one of the major challenges of the present era, crossing borders and undermining prospects for cooperation and stability. articles.description: Somalia-Amerika Pengemudi Uber koma setelah dugaan kejahatan di Minnesota dikeluarkan oleh staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 18: 46 Mohamed Yusuf dilaporkan dijalankan berkali-kali dengan kendaraan miliknya sendiri setelah seorang penumpang mengatakan dia tidak menyukai nama muslim-nya sebuah foto penggalangan dana GofundMe diluncurkan untuk mendukung Mohamed Yusuf, pengemudi Uber Somalia-Amerika yang diduga mengalami serangan terhadap kejahatan di Minnesota Off A Somalia-Amerika yang diduga memiliki kebencian terhadap keluarganya sendiri dengan kendaraan-nya sendiri setelah mengalami serangan anti-bunuh diri sendiri. Mohamed Yusuf bekerja di Hopkins, pinggiran kota Minneapolis, awal hari Sabtu ketika seorang penumpang diduga bertanya namanya sebelum mengatakan bahwa dia tidak suka nama "Mohamed". Menurut keluarga Yusuf, penumpang kemudian diduga mencekiknya dari belakang, mengambil alih kendaraan dan menabraknya berkali-kali. "Dia ditabrak beberapa kali dengan kendaraan sendiri", anak Yusuf, Mustafa Osman, mengatakan The Somalia Brief. Yusuf dilaporkan ditemukan di selokan hampir satu mil jauhnya, menderita patah kaki dan tulang rusuk, dua paru-paru runtuh, cedera tulang belakang dan pendarahan internal. Dia tetap dirawat di rumah sakit dalam keadaan koma, menurut keluarganya. Polisi Hopkins mengkonfirmasi bahwa petugas menanggapi laporan kendaraan mencurigakan sekitar pukul 1.20 pagi pada hari Sabtu menemukan seorang pria terluka serius dan kemudian mengambil tersangka laki-laki ke dalam tahanan. Menurut Times of India, catatan penangkapan menunjukkan bahwa seorang pria diidentifikasi sebagai Samit Aspuva Patel ditangkap oleh Polisi Hopkins pada 14 November pada tuduhan penyerangan tingkat pertama. Namun, pihak berwenang belum mengkonfirmasi apakah Patel apos; s penangkapan berhubungan dengan serangan Yusuf atau publik mengidentifikasi tersangka dalam kasus ini. articles.originalTitle: Somali-American Uber driver left in coma after alleged hate crime in Minnesota
articles.originalDescription: Somali-American Uber driver left in coma after alleged hate crime in Minnesota Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 18:46 Mohamed Yusuf was reportedly run over multiple times with his own vehicle after a passenger said he disliked his Muslim name A screenshot of a GoFundMe fundraiser launched to support Mohamed Yusuf, the Somali-American Uber driver who was the victim of a suspected hate crime in Minnesota Off A Somali-American Uber driver is fighting for his life after being strangled and repeatedly run over with his own vehicle, allegedly by a passenger in Minnesota, in an attack his family believes was motivated by anti-Muslim hatred. Mohamed Yusuf was working in Hopkins, a suburb of Minneapolis, early on Saturday when a passenger allegedly asked him his name before telling him he did not like the name "Mohamed". According to Yusuf's relatives, the passenger then allegedly choked him from behind, seized control of his vehicle and ran him over multiple times. "He was run over multiple times with his own vehicle," Yusuf's son, Mustafa Osman, told The Somali Brief . Yusuf was reportedly found in a ditch nearly a mile away, suffering from broken legs and ribs, two collapsed lungs, a spinal injury and internal bleeding. He remains hospitalised in a coma, according to his family. Hopkins police confirmed that officers responding to a report of a suspicious vehicle at around 1.20am on Saturday discovered a seriously injured man and subsequently took a male suspect into custody. According to the Times of India , arrest records show that a man identified as Samit Apurva Patel was taken into custody by Hopkins Police on 14 November on a first-degree assault charge. However, authorities have not confirmed whether Patel's arrest is connected to Yusuf's assault or publicly identified the suspect in the case. articles.title: Gubernur Texas datang untuk membalikkan sebutan teror bagi kelompok kebebasan sipil Muslim
articles.description: Masuk Gubernur Texas untuk membalikkan panggilan teror bagi pemerintah kebebasan sipil Muslim-memilih staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 15: 57 Gina Hinojosa mengatakan menindak non-profit tidak meningkatkan keamanan publik Pemerintah Texas - memilih Gina Hinojosa muncul dengan pendukung di luar Pusat Rekreasi Austin - sebelum polling ditutup pada Hari Pemilihan, pada 3 November 2026, di Austin, Texas (Chip Somodevilla / Getty Ofration Off) kelompok teroris yang dipilih nya dari partai Republik Texas, yang akan memilih kelompok tersebut, Dalam sebuah wawancara yang diterbitkan oleh The Washington Post pada hari Sabtu, Hinojosa, yang dengan rela mengalahkan tiga orang Gubernur Greg Abbott di pertengahan semester pemilihan awal bulan ini untuk menjadi wanita Hispanik pertama dalam peran, mengatakan dia akan menarik perintah eksekutif untuk memeras Dewan tentang Hubungan Islam Amerika (Cair). "Kita harus menggunakan langkah-langkah keamanan publik untuk keselamatan publik", katanya. Hinojosa akan dilantik ke kantor pada bulan Januari. Kelompok hak-hak sipil di negara bagian menyambut pergerakan, stasiun lokal di Austin, Fox7, dilaporkan. "Greg Abbott digunakan kantornya untuk bahan bakar anti-Muslim permusuhan dan mengintimidasi organisasi membela hak-hak masyarakat mereka," Sam Robles, direktur eksekutif Texas Nonprofit Protection Network, mengatakan dalam sebuah pernyataan. "Abbott secara politis termotivasi sebagai CAIR sebagai organisasi teroris adalah eskalasi lain dalam kampanye yang berusaha menggambarkan partisipasi warga Muslim dan advokasi sebagai ancaman keselamatan publik". Hampir setahun yang lalu, Abbott mengumumkan bahwa ia menunjuk Persaudaraan Muslim serta Cair sebagai organisasi teroris asing dan organisasi kriminal transnasional. Akibatnya, kedua kelompok tersebut dilarang "dari pembelian atau memperoleh tanah" di Texas. Pengumuman itu memberi Jaksa Agung pemerintah untuk menuntut kelompok-kelompok tersebut. Aipac menghabiskan 55m dolar untuk kehila
articles.originalTitle: Incoming Texas governor to reverse terror designation for Muslim civil liberties group
articles.originalDescription: Incoming Texas governor to reverse terror designation for Muslim civil liberties group Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 15:57 Gina Hinojosa said cracking down on nonprofits does not increase public safety Texas Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa appears with supporters outside the Austin Recreation Center before polls closed on Election Day, on 3 November 2026, in Austin, Texas (Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images via AFP) Off The Democratic governor-elect of Texas, Gina Hinojosa, has revealed she will reverse her predecessor's designation of the largest Muslim civil liberties group in the US as a terrorist organisation. In an interview published by The Washington Post on Saturday, Hinojosa, who handily beat three-term Governor Greg Abbott in the midterm elections earlier this month to become the first Hispanic woman in the role, said she would withdraw the executive order blacklisting the Council on American Islamic Relations (Cair). “We have to use public safety measures for public safety," she said. Hinojosa will be sworn into office in January. Civil rights groups in the state welcomed the move, the local station in Austin, Fox7, reported. "Greg Abbott used his office to fuel anti-Muslim hostility and intimidate the organizations defending their communities' rights," Sam Robles, executive director of the Texas Nonprofit Protection Network, said in a statement. "Abbott’s politically motivated designation of CAIR as a terrorist organization was another escalation in a campaign that sought to portray Muslim civic participation and advocacy as a public safety threat." Almost a year ago to the day, Abbott announced that he was designating the Muslim Brotherhood as well as Cair as foreign terrorist organisations and transnational criminal organisations. As a result, both groups were barred "from purchasing or acquiring land" in Texas. The proclamation gave the state's attorney general leeway to sue the groups accordingly. articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Dalam Negeri menegaskan bahwa majikan individu, yang memungkinkan pekerja mereka untuk bekerja untuk majikan lain atau pada akun mereka sendiri, denda wajah hingga SR100.000, penjara selama enam bulan, dan larangan perekrutan hingga lima tahun. articles.originalTitle: Employers face up to six-month jail, SR100,000 fine for illegally assigning workers to others
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Interior affirmed that individual employers, who allow their workers to work for another employer or on their own account, face fines of up to SR100,000, imprisonment for up to six months, and a recruitment ban of up to five years.The ministry urged compliance with residency, labor, and border security regulations. It called on the public to report violations by calling 911 in the regions of Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh, and the Eastern Province and 999 in the rest of Saudi Arabia.

articles.originalTitle: Environment ministry enforces sweeping ban on perennial forage crop cultivation
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that a decision to halt perennial forage cultivation and transition to seasonal crops takes effect on Monday, Nov.16, across sedimentary shelf areas in the regions of Al-Jouf, Riyadh, Hail, Eastern Province, Qassim, and Tabuk.The ministry said the decision aims to curb the depletion of non-renewable groundwater, improve the efficiency of natural resource use, and conserve these resources, enhancing agricultural sustainability in line with the objectives of the National Agriculture Strategy.The ministry also outlined the seasonal forage crops permitted under the approved regulations for licensed farms and the expected reduction in non-renewable groundwater consumption resulting from the transition.Farmers wishing to cultivate seasonal forage crops can applyfor a license through the following link: https://naama.sa/services/details/92aed338-2639-43c5-9941-b1571fea63bb.

articles.title: Saudi, Mesir, dan menteri luar negeri Qatar mendiskusikan de- eskalasi daerah dalam panggilan telepon
articles.description: RIYADH - Saudi Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan mengangkat telepon dengan menteri asing Mesir dan Qatar pada hari Senin. Selama panggilan, Pangeran Faisal dan Menteri Luar Negeri Mesir, Kerjasama Internasional, dan Mesir Expatriates Dr Badar Abdelatty meninjau hubungan bilateral antara dua negara dan menjelajahi cara untuk memperkuat dan memajukan kerjasama di berbagai bidang. Dua menteri juga mendiskusikan perkembangan regional terbaru, mendasari pentingnya koordinasi dan konsultasi yang berkelanjutan, serta dukungan untuk upaya diplomatik yang bertujuan untuk mengurangi eskalasi untuk membantu konsolidasi keamanan dan stabilitas regional. Dalam percakapan telepon yang terpisah, Pangeran Faisal dan Qatar Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Luar Negeri Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani mendiskusikan perkembangan regional terbaru dan upaya yang berkelanjutan untuk mempromosikan pengurangan dan menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi, Egyptian, and Qatari foreign ministers discuss regional de-escalation in phone call
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan held phone calls with foreign ministers of Egypt and Qatar on Monday.During the call, Prince Faisal and Egypt’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation, and Egyptian Expatriates Dr. Badr Abdelatty reviewed bilateral relations between the two countries and explored ways to further strengthen and advance cooperation across various fields. The two ministers also discussed the latest regional developments, underscoring the importance of continued coordination and consultation, as well as support for diplomatic efforts aimed at de-escalation to help consolidate regional security and stability.In a separate telephone conversation, Prince Faisal and Qatari Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani discussed the latest regional developments and ongoing efforts to promote de-escalation and maintain security and stability in the region.

articles.originalDescription: Two wounded in alleged car-ramming at West Bank checkpoint: Israeli report Two Israelis were wounded in an alleged ramming attack at a military checkpoint south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank on Monday, Israeli media reported. articles.originalDescription: The paper trail that leads from the UAE to a dead boy in Sudan Submitted by Ahmed Ismat Ahmed on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 14:01 The RSF killed Osama, my little brother's 12-year-old best friend. This is what made it possible Osama (r) and his best friend Mohammed, pictured a week before the war in Sudan began in April 2023 (Ahmed Ismat Ahmed/MEE) On Osama was my younger brother’s best friend. He was 12. The Rapid Support Forces killed him when they attacked a town in al-Jazira state , Sudan , in 2023. The two of them used to share the same bicycle - one pedalling, the other running beside it, hand on the seat. Then one of them simply stopped existing. After the Khartoum sit-in was broken in the spring of 2019 and the resistance committees - nationwide groups of local activists of which I was a part - moved into the neighbourhoods, a few of us found ourselves guarding wool. Eid was coming. Families who could still afford it had bought sheep. When the slaughtering was done, the wool was left in the open lot where we used to meet. Someone said it was a waste to sell it in small piles for almost nothing. Someone else said the locality had not touched the streetlights on our main road in months. Children fell when it rained. Old people stopped walking to the mosque after dark because they could not see the path. We gathered the wool and took turns sitting with it at night. When the money came - folded, counted twice - we sat down and wrote it into a cheap notebook with a blue cover. I learned early that there are two kinds of paperwork. They do not answer to the same people Different hands. The wool money. The cost of the generator. Who had counted. The names of the boys who brought something. articles.description: Bagaimana Maroko menjadi pusat keamanan Israel di Afrika Diberikan oleh Ahmed Alqarout di Fri, 11 / 13 / 2026 - 18: 04 Rabat menawarkan kepada Abraham Accates nya mitra tempat aman industri, jauh dari rudal dan sanksi Seorang tentara Israel meluncurkan kendaraan udara tak berawak Elbit, digunakan untuk pengawasan, dekat perbatasan Gaza pada 30 September 2025 (Jack Guez / AFP) Off Di Pertunjukan Udara Marrakech bulan lalu, Departemen Pertahanan Israel membuka paviliun resmi pertamanya di Maroko. Delapan perusahaan Israel, di antara mereka dimiliki Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) dan Rafael, menunjukkan drone, berkeliaran amunisi dan sistem pertahanan udara, sementara Elbit 's Maroko usaha gabungan mengumumkan bahwa hal itu akan memberikan menara ke tentara Maroko dari Maret 2027. Juga di pertunjukan udara, kelompok pertahanan UAE Edge menandatangani kontrak untuk mempersenjatai drone Maroko. Acara ini bertepatan dengan ulang tahun 7 Oktober, yang menarik demonstran untuk berjaga-jaga di luar parlemen di Rabat. Acara-acara yang disebut di beberapa 30 kota Maroko, mendesak pemerintah untuk menjatuhkan langkah-langkah baru bertujuan lebih lanjut normalisasi hubungan dengan Israel. BDS Maroko meminta boikot dari acara Marrakech. Pertunjukan udara menggambarkan bagaimana, sejak bergabung dengan Perjanjian Abraham tahun 2020, Maroko telah berpindah dari membeli senjata Israel untuk membangunnya. Perang di Gaza mempercepat kemitraan itu, sebagai boikot global dan sanksi terhadap Israel diperluas. articles.originalTitle: How Morocco is becoming Israel's security hub in Africa
articles.originalDescription: How Morocco is becoming Israel's security hub in Africa Submitted by Ahmed Alqarout on Fri, 11/13/2026 - 18:04 Rabat offers its Abraham Accords partners an industrial safe haven, away from missiles and sanctions An Israeli soldier launches an Elbit unmanned aerial vehicle, used for surveillance, near the border with Gaza on 30 September 2025 (Jack Guez/AFP) Off At the Marrakech Air Show last month, Israel ’s defence ministry opened its first official pavilion in Morocco . Eight Israeli firms , among them the state-owned Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) and Rafael, showed drones, loitering munitions and air defence systems, while Elbit’s Moroccan joint venture announced that it would deliver turrets to the Moroccan army from March 2027. Also at the air show, the UAE ’s defence group Edge signed a contract to arm Morocco’s drones. The event coincided with the anniversary of 7 October, which drew protesters to a vigil outside parliament in Rabat. Events were called in some 30 Moroccan cities, urging the government to drop new measures aimed at further normalising ties with Israel . BDS Morocco called for a boycott of the Marrakech show. The air show illustrates how, since joining the Abraham Accords in 2020, Morocco has moved from buying Israeli weapons to building them . The war on Gaza accelerated that partnership, as global boycotts and sanctions against Israel expanded. In Europe, Spain cancelled €1.2bn ($1.3bn) of Israeli military contracts, and France barred Israel from the Eurosatory defence exhibition. The war with Iran further exposed Israeli and Emirati industries. Iran said it struck Rafael and IAI sites, along with a drone supplier , and Emirates Global Aluminium’s Abu Dhabi plant suffered significant damage . Morocco offers its Abraham Accords partners an industrial safe haven, away from missiles and sanctions, and its coordination with Israel now spans production, intelligence, training, weapons testing, shipping and policing in Gaza . articles.description: Hakim ICC memerintahkan untuk mengakhiri penyelidikan terhadap dugaan kejahatan oleh pasukan AS di Afghanistan Diberikan oleh Sondos Asem pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 10: 56 Keputusan, ditandai dalam urutan pertama yang dilaporkan oleh MEE pada bulan Agustus, menimbulkan pertanyaan atas apakah pengadilan sedang berusaha untuk meringankan AS berikut Sanctions Rosario Salvatore Aitala, sekarang hakim dari ICC 's Preal Chamber II, pada sumpah-nya dalam upacara di The Hague pada 9 Maret 2018 (ICC / Flirr) Off Hakim di International Crime Court (ICC) telah memerintahkan penutupan pengadilan pengadilan yang meliput kasus-kasus yang sedang berlangsung oleh pihak-pihak yang mengajukan tuntutan oleh pihak-tuntutan pengadilan internasional. Mengakhiri penyelidikan terhadap dugaan kejahatan AS alamat salah satu Washington' s lama keberatan kepada ICC dan salah satu alasan di balik sanksi pada pengadilan dan pejabat tersebut. Karena itu, kemungkinan besar untuk menimbulkan pertanyaan tentang apakah pengadilan mencari untuk meringankan ketegangan dengan Washington dengan menandatangani bahwa hal itu tidak akan lagi mengejar tuduhan terhadap pasukan AS dan sekutu mereka. Situasi Afghanistan di ICC tanggal kembali ke November 2017, ketika kemudian-Jaksa Fatou Bensouda pertama kali meminta otorisasi untuk menyelidiki dugaan kejahatan yang dilakukan sejak 2003, termasuk oleh Afghanistan dan pasukan AS serta kelompok Taliban dan ISK. Permintaan itu awalnya ditolak oleh yang berbeda terdiri ruang pra-pengadilan pada tahun 2019, sebelum ruang banding terbalik keputusan pada bulan Maret 2020 dan berwenang penyelidikan untuk melanjutkan. Bensouda disetujui oleh pemerintah AS beberapa bulan kemudian atas upaya dugaan untuk subjek Amerika ke yurisdiksi pengadilan. Anggota dari ruang banding yang berwenang keputusan juga kemudian sanksi. articles.originalTitle: ICC judges order end to investigation into alleged crimes by US forces in Afghanistan
articles.originalDescription: ICC judges order end to investigation into alleged crimes by US forces in Afghanistan Submitted by Sondos Asem on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 10:56 The decision, signalled in an order first reported by MEE in August, raises questions over whether the court is seeking to ease US pressure following sanctions Rosario Salvatore Aitala, now presiding judge of the ICC’s Pre-Trial Chamber II, at his swearing-in ceremony in The Hague on 9 March 2018 (ICC/Flikr) Off Judges at the International Criminal Court (ICC) have ordered the closure of the court’s Afghanistan investigation that covered alleged war crimes by US forces, despite ongoing attempts by prosecutors to appeal the decision. Ending the investigation into alleged US crimes addresses one of Washington ’s longstanding objections to the ICC and one of the reasons behind the sanctions on the court and its officials. The move is therefore likely to raise questions about whether the court is seeking to ease tensions with Washington by signalling that it will no longer pursue allegations against US forces and their allies. The Afghanistan situation at the ICC dates back to November 2017, when then-prosecutor Fatou Bensouda first requested authorisation to investigate alleged crimes committed since 2003, including by Afghan and US forces as well as the Taliban and the IS-K group. That request was initially rejected by a differently composed pre-trial chamber in 2019, before the appeals chamber overturned the decision in March 2020 and authorised the investigation to proceed. Bensouda was sanctioned by the US government a few months later over alleged attempts to subject Americans to the court's jurisdiction. Members of the appeals chamber that authorised the decision were also later sanctioned. articles.title: MP berusaha menyelidiki kedalam pendanaan grup parlemen Inggris ke perusahaan Israel
articles.description: MP berusaha menyelidiki pendanaan grup parlemen Inggris kepada perusahaan Israel yang diberikan oleh Imran Mulla on Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 10: 45 APPG pada funder Israel adalah uang ganti rugi oleh perusahaan Israel yang berusaha untuk membentuk perdebatan di parlemen A camar terbang oleh River Thames, dekat Jembatan Westminster dan Elizabeth Tower, yang dikenal sebagai Big Ben, di Rumah Sakit Parlemen di London Tengah pada 12 November 2026. (AFP) Off Komisi standar parlemen Inggris telah didesak untuk menyelidiki AllParlemen Grup (APPG) pada Israel mengikuti laporan yang menghubungkan pendanaan ke organisasi Israel yang mengatakan itu membantu perdebatan bentuk dalam parlemen Inggris. APPG didanai oleh Cedarrendam Ltd, sebuah perusahaan Inggris di mana Lord Mendelsohn, mantan ketua Labour Friends of Israel, dan Lord Polak, mantan direktur dari Teman Konservatif Israel, adalah satu-satunya direktur. Tapi Byline Times melaporkan awal bulan ini bahwa perusahaan berbasis Tel Aviv- Cedars Oak Israel Ltd berhutang pada perusahaan Inggris Cedarscash £147.687 dalam penggantian dana pada tahun 2024. Cedars Oak Israel menggambarkan dirinya sebagai "bagian aktif dalam membentuk narasi di Parlemen Inggris" untuk "melayani tujuan nasional". Donor perusahaan di tahun 2024 adalah perusahaan Line Trust Limited, perusahaan perwalian Gibraltar yang dimiliki oleh Hassans, perusahaan hukum terbesar di wilayah ini. APPG, yang merupakan kelompok informal dari MPs dan rekan-rekan, diwajibkan untuk menamai partai manapun yang "akhirnya didanai" sebuah keuntungan menurut aturan parlemen. Menurut Byline Times, APPG juga secara retroaktif mendaftarkan sebuah benefit- in-kind, yang dinilai antara £85,501 dan £87.000, dari Cedarscash Ltd pada awal 2025.
