articles.originalTitle: MP seeks probe into UK parliamentary group’s funding links to Israeli firm
articles.originalDescription: MP seeks probe into UK parliamentary group’s funding links to Israeli firm Submitted by Imran Mulla on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 10:45 APPG on Israel’s UK funder was owed reimbursements by an Israeli firm seeking to shape debate in parliament A gull flies by the River Thames, near Westminster Bridge and the Elizabeth Tower, commonly known as Big Ben, at the Houses of Parliament in central London on 12 November 2026. (AFP) Off The UK parliament’s standards commissioner has been urged to investigate the All-Party Parliamentary Group (APPG) on Israel following reports linking its funding to an Israeli organisation that says it helps shape debate in the British parliament. The APPG is funded by Cedarsoak Ltd, a British company in which Lord Mendelsohn, the former chair of Labour Friends of Israel, and Lord Polak, the former director of the Conservative Friends of Israel, are the sole directors . But Byline Times reported earlier this month that the Tel Aviv-based firm Cedars Oak Israel Ltd owed the UK firm Cedarsoak £147,687 in reimbursements in 2024. Cedars Oak Israel describes itself as taking "an active part in shaping the narrative in the British Parliament" to "serve national objectives". Its 2024 report to the Israeli charity registrar said it worked to influence British opinion and policy on Hamas, antisemitism, sanctions, Iran and other issues. The firm's donor in 2024 was Line Trust Corporation Limited, a Gibraltar-based trust company owned by Hassans, the territory's biggest law firm. APPGs, which are informal groups of MPs and peers, are required to name any party that "ultimately funded" a benefit according to parliamentary rules. According to Byline Times, the APPG also retroactively registered a benefit-in-kind, valued at between £85,501 and £87,000, from Cedarsoak Ltd in early 2025. articles.title: Saudi-pasukan mundur dari Bab al- Mandab sebagai tanah galian Houthis
articles.description: Saudi- pasukan mundur dari Bab al- Mandab sebagai Houthis tanah gain Dikirimkan oleh staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 12: 09 Angkatan Bersenjata Selatan mengatakan bahwa tindakan ini dimaksudkan untuk memperkuat Aden, sementara klaim Houthis mereka mendorong pasukan dari posisi yang menghadap ke arah laut strategis di Yaman Yang berwenang berkumpul selama protes terhadap Saudi Intervention di Sanaa, 9 Oktober 2026 (Mohammed Huwais / AFP) Off Saudi - didukung pasukan di Yaman telah ditarik dari posisi yang menghadap Bab al- Mandab Selat strategis, meninggalkan Houthis dengan pengaruh yang lebih besar di pintu masuk selatan ke Laut Merah. Angkatan Bersenjata Selatan, yang didukung oleh Arab Saudi dan berjuang bersama pemerintah Yaman yang diakui internasional, berkata pada hari Minggu mereka mengerahkan pasukan dari bandara Dhubab dan daerah Bab al- Mandab untuk memperkuat pertahanan di sekitar ibukota internal Aden. "Langkah ini diambil berdasarkan prioritas mengamankan ibukota, Aden, dan pemerintah tetangga, serta memperkuat garis depan dan mengatasi ancaman yang sudah ada", kata kelompok dalam sebuah pernyataan. Perumahan, secara resmi dikenal sebagai Ansar Allah, menawarkan rekening yang berbeda. Seorang sumber militer dikutip oleh agen berita Houthi- run Saba mengatakan bahwa mereka telah memaksa Saudi-didukung pasukan keluar dari posisi sekitar Dhubab dan Bab al- Mandab setelah memisahkan rute pasokan belakang mereka, memaksa mereka untuk bergerak menuju Aden. The Houthi- run outlet juga melaporkan bahwa pasukan kelompok telah melakukan operasi mengapit di lebih dari 60km daerah pegunungan dari Taiz dan Lahij, memaksa pasukan musuh untuk mundur dari posisi di sekitar bandara Dhubab, pinggiran Kahbub dan daerah sekitar Bab al- Mandab. Perkembangan terbaru memberikan Houthis pengaruh lebih atas bagaimana Bab Al- Mandab, salah satu titik yang paling kritis dari lalu lintas jalur air di dunia, dikendalikan. Selat duduk di rute maritim antara Laut Merah dan Teluk
articles.originalTitle: Saudi-backed forces retreat from Bab al-Mandab as Houthis gain ground
articles.originalDescription: Saudi-backed forces retreat from Bab al-Mandab as Houthis gain ground Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 12:09 The Southern Armed Forces say the move is intended to reinforce Aden, while the Houthis claim they drove troops from positions overlooking the strategic waterway Supporters of Yemen’s Houthi authorities gather during a protest against Saudi intervention in Sanaa, 9 October 2026 (Mohammed Huwais/AFP) Off Saudi-backed forces in Yemen have withdrawn from positions overlooking the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait, leaving the Houthis with greater leverage over the southern entrance to the Red Sea after weeks of fighting. The Southern Armed Forces, who are backed by Saudi Arabia and fighting alongside the internationally recognised Yemeni government, said on Sunday they had "redeployed" troops from Dhubab airport and surrounding regions of Bab al-Mandab to strengthen defences around the interim capital Aden. “This step is taken based on the priority of securing the capital, Aden, and the neighbouring governorates, as well as strengthening the front lines and addressing existing threats,” the group said in a statement. The Houthis, officially known as Ansar Allah, offered a different account. A military source quoted by the Houthi-run Saba news agency said that they had forced Saudi-backed forces out of positions around Dhubab and Bab al-Mandab after severing their rear supply routes, forcing them to move towards Aden. The Houthi-run outlet also reported that the group's forces had carried out a flanking operation across more than 60km of the mountainous regions of Taiz and Lahij, forcing enemy troops to retreat from positions around Dhubab airport, the outskirts of Kahbub and areas around Bab al-Mandab. The latest developments give the Houthis more leverage over how Bab al-Mandab, one of the most critical points of waterway traffic in the world, is controlled. articles.title: Bus angkutan umum Saudi mengangkut lebih dari 25,5 juta penumpang di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Otoritas Umum Transportasi (TGA) mengumumkan bahwa transportasi umum bus di kota-kota di Arab Saudi membawa lebih dari 25,5 juta penumpang di kuartal ketiga 2026, peningkatan 3.6 persen dibandingkan dengan periode yang sama pada tahun 2025. Hal ini mencerminkan peningkatan ketergantungan pada transportasi umum dan tingkat penggunaan yang lebih tinggi di seluruh kota-kota Kerajaan. Riyadh topped daftar kota dengan jumlah tertinggi penumpang bus publik, merekam lebih dari 19.29 juta, diikuti dengan lebih dari 2.89 juta dan Jeddah dengan lebih dari 1.19 juta. Nomor penumpang di daerah Metropolitan Dammam dan pemerintah Qatif melebihi 789.000, sedangkan Madinah merekam lebih dari 568.000. Angka-angka ini mencerminkan upaya TGA untuk memperluas layanan transportasi publik di dalam kota-kota dan menyediakan pilihan transportasi yang efisien dan berkelanjutan yang meningkatkan mobilitas, sejalan dengan tujuan Transportasi Nasional dan Strategi Logistik.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi public transport buses carry over 25.5 million passengers in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Transport General Authority (TGA) announced that public transport buses in cities across Saudi Arabia carried more than 25.5 million passengers in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 3.6 percent compared with the same period in 2025. This reflects growing reliance on public transport and higher usage rates across the Kingdom's cities. Riyadh topped the list of cities with the highest number of public bus passengers, recording more than 19.29 million, followed by Makkah with more than 2.89 million and Jeddah with more than 1.19 million. Passenger numbers in the Dammam Metropolitan Area and Qatif governorate exceeded 789,000, while Madinah recorded more than 568,000. These figures reflect TGA's efforts to expand public transport services within cities and provide efficient, sustainable transport options that improve mobility, in line with the objectives of the National Transport and Logistics Strategy.

articles.originalTitle: Home Office pressured council to cancel event featuring pro-Palestine activist, disclosures suggest
articles.originalDescription: Home Office pressured council to cancel event featuring pro-Palestine activist, disclosures suggest Submitted by Katherine Hearst on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 12:35 Home Office warned Hackney officials that Tribune event could breach counter-terror laws despite an initial assessment finding Andreas Malm was 'unlikely to meet the threshold for disruption' Andreas Malm attends the "How To Blow Up A Pipeline" premiere during the 2022 Toronto International Film Festival on 10 September 2022 in Toronto, Ontario (Jeremy Chan/Getty Images/AFP ) Off The UK Home Office pushed Hackney Council to cancel an event featuring Swedish climate scholar Andreas Malm and Palestine Action co-founder Huda Ammori, despite the Home Office's own assessment which found the event "did not meet the threshold for disruption," disclosures suggest. In October, Malm was barred from entering the UK by the Home Office, and instead was set to appear by video link at the event for the magazine Tribune on 4 November at a venue owned by Hackney Council. The event coincided with a legal challenge against the UK government’s controversial ban against Palestine Action which Ammori is fighting in the Supreme Court. Freedom of Information and Subject Access Request documents released to Tribune appear to show that in the run-up to the event, the Home Office tried to pressure Hackney Council officials into cancelling it by warning them that it could breach the Terrorism Act 2000 due to Ammori’s participation. The disclosures reveal that an initial Home Office assessment found that the event was “unlikely to meet the threshold for disruption”. Despite this, the Home Office contacted the Prevent and Hate Crime coordinator of Hackney Council, warning them that the event would feature “two speakers of concern” and sharing with them an intelligence summary used to bar Malm from entering the UK, which described him “legitimis[ing] and encoura[ing] attacks on energy infrastructure and terrorism”. articles.description: Militer Israel mengatakan itu tidak akan mengusir pemukim yang menempati rumah-rumah Palestina di Jericho Dipersembahkan oleh Nadav Rapaport pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 11: 53 Awal bulan ini, keluarga-keluarga Israel menyerbu sebuah lingkungan Tepi Barat dan mengambil alih 8 rumah Palestina Badui anak-anak Palestina, yang rumahnya dekat dengan kota Tepi Barat yang diduduki Jericho diambil alih oleh pemukim Israel minggu lalu, bermain di sebuah lokasi baru dekat perbatasan kota pada 9 November 2026 (AFP) Off The Israel militer Israel telah memutuskan untuk tidak mengevakuasi 13 keluarga pemukim pemukim yang menyerbu rumah-rumah orang Palestina di sebuah kota di Jericho Timur yang menempati Bank Barat, sebagai pejabat militer takut akan menjadi bawella, situs Israel pada hari Senin. Awal bulan ini, sumber-sumber keamanan Palestina mengatakan penduduk Israel, disertai dengan keluarga mereka, menyerbu delapan rumah Palestina di al- Duyuk al- Taita, barat dari Yerikho. Rumah-rumah itu kosong pada saat itu, dan pemukim menghancurkan pintu mereka sebelum menempati properti, sumber keamanan mengatakan agen berita Wafa. Kelompok hak-hak Israel, Peace, mengatakan bahwa sekitar 30 pendatang datang untuk mengambil alih rumah-rumah, dan seperti yang mereka lakukan, mereka menyerang dan merampok dua aktivis Israel dan menembak seorang Palestina di kaki. Walla melaporkan bahwa serangan melanggar peraturan tentara dan dilakukan tanpa persetujuan militer sebelumnya. Namun, Avi Bluth, komandan tentara Israel di Tepi Barat, telah memutuskan untuk mengusir pemukim. Dengan pemerintahan Israel berikutnya masih sedang diputuskan, Bluth ingin menghindari kontroversial gerakan, laporan mengatakan, termasuk evakuasi keluarga pemukim. Bluth, yang dibesarkan di pemukiman Israel, memiliki kebijakan yang berlebihan untuk memperluas pos-pos pemukim di seluruh Tepi Barat selama masa jabatannya, memerintahkan tentara untuk memblokir jalan pemukim 'menuju Area A, yang berada di bawah kekuasaan Otorit
articles.originalTitle: Israeli military says it will not evict settlers occupying Palestinian homes in Jericho

Earlier this month, Palestinian security sources said Israeli settlers, accompanied by their families, stormed eight Palestinian homes in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, west of Jericho. The homes were empty at the time, and the settlers smashed their doors before occupying the properties, the security sources told the Wafa news agency. Israeli rights group Peace Now said that around 30 settlers came to take over the houses, and as they did, "they assaulted and robbed two Israeli activists and shot a Palestinian man in the leg". Walla reported that the raid violated army regulations and was carried out without prior military approval. However, Avi Bluth, the commander of the Israeli army in the West Bank, has decided against evicting the settlers. With Israel's next government still being decided, Bluth wants to avoid controversial moves, the report said, including the evacuation of the settler families. Bluth, who grew up in an Israeli settlement, has overseen policies to expand settler outposts across the West Bank during his tenure, ordered the army to block the settlers' road leading to Area A, which is under Palestinian Authority control and where Israeli law prohibits Israelis from entering. articles.title: Arab Saudi meluncurkan kampanye nasional untuk mengembalikan keseimbangan lingkungan
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup, Air dan Pertanian, melalui Inisiatif Kesadaran Lingkungan, diluncurkan pada hari Senin Kampanye Keseimbangan Lingkungan 2026 di bawah slogan "Keseimbangan Kami". Kampanye ini berjalan selama 15 hari, dari Nov 15 sampai 29, dengan partisipasi dari berbagai lembaga dan pusat dalam sistem lingkungan, serta pemerintah, swasta, dan sektor nirlaba, dan anggota masyarakat dari semua daerah di Kingdom. Kampanye ini didasarkan pada visi nasional yang menekankan bahwa perlindungan lingkungan adalah tanggung jawab dari sistem yang saling berhubungan, di mana peran dari pelayanan dan pusat-pusat spesialnya saling melengkapi. Upaya mereka bersatu untuk melindungi sumber daya alam dan mempertahankan keseimbangan sistem ekologi, penyatuan pesan kesadaran dan mencapai tujuan dari Saudi Vision 2030 dan Strategi Lingkungan Nasional dalam mempertahankan sumber daya alam dan mengurangi semua bentuk polusi. Kampanye ini mempromosikan praktek-praktek lingkungan yang bertanggung jawab dan perlindungan alam, alam, padang gurun, dan daerah pesisir, menyoroti interketergantungan dari unsur-unsur lingkungan melalui isu-isu kunci seperti memancing satwa liar dan berkelanjutan; perlindungan vegetasi dan pemulihan habitat; lingkungan laut, terumbu karang, dan penyu laut; dampak infrastruktur dan pelayanan lingkungan; limbah dan ekonomi lingkaran; cuaca dan pemantauan iklim; dan memungkinkan solusi dan pembiayaan lingkungan. Kementrian menyerukan semua lembaga pemerintah, lembaga pendidikan, sektor swasta dan organisasi nirlaba, dan masyarakat umum untuk terlibat dengan kampanye melalui platform digital dan inisiatif-ground. Hal ini didasarkan pada prinsip yang mempertahankan keseimbangan lingkungan adalah tanggung jawab bersama yang menyatukan individu, organisasi, dan bisnis dalam mendukung tujuan lingkungan dan memastikan keberlanjutan sumber daya alam Kerajaan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia launches nationwide campaign to restore environmental balance
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through the Environmental Awareness Initiative, launched on Monday the 2026 Environmental Balance Campaign under the slogan “Balance Connects Us.” The campaign runs for 15 days, from Nov. 15 to 29, with participation from various agencies and centers within the environmental system, as well as government, private, and nonprofit sectors, and members of the public from all regions of the Kingdom. The campaign is based on a national vision that emphasizes that environmental protection is the responsibility of an interconnected system, in which the roles of the ministry and its specialized centers complement one another. Their efforts are united to safeguard natural resources and maintain the balance of ecological systems, unifying awareness messages and achieving the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Environment Strategy in preserving natural resources and reducing all forms of pollution. The campaign promotes responsible environmental practices and the protection of natural, wilderness, and coastal areas, highlighting the interdependence of environmental elements through key issues such as wildlife and sustainable fishing; vegetation cover and habitat restoration; the marine environment, coral reefs, and sea turtles; infrastructure impact and environmental stewardship; waste and the circular economy; weather and climate monitoring; and enabling solutions and environmental financing. The ministry called on all government agencies, educational institutions, private-sector and nonprofit organizations, and the general public to engage with the campaign through digital platforms and on-the-ground initiatives. This is based on the principle that preserving environmental balance is a shared responsibility that unites individuals, organizations, and businesses in supporting environmental goals and ensuring the sustainability of the Kingdom’s natural resources.

articles.title: Britania definisi 'anti- Muslim permusuhan' melindungi negara, bukan mereka yang menjadi target
articles.description: Definisi Inggris dari 'anti- Muslim permusuhan' melindungi negara, bukan mereka yang sedang ditargetkan oleh Karsen Trull pada Thu, 11 / 12 / 2026 - 14: 09 Laporan baru dari Cage International menunjukkan bagaimana kebijakan Inggris meninggalkan mekanisme pusat postingan -9 / 11 Islammophobia tidak tersentuh - dan meminjamkan secara resmi menutupi definisi Inggris anti- permusuhan Muslim 'bukanlah upaya gagal untuk melindungi umat Islam. Ini adalah upaya sukses untuk melindungi negara' (Reuters) Off Tahun ini ditandai seperempat abad sejak awal "perang terhadap teror", dan pada saat itu, Inggris telah membangun salah satu yang paling luas countermisme sistem di dunia. Juga tahun ini, Inggris diproduksi - untuk pertama kalinya - definisi resmi dari apa yang disebut "anti- Muslim permusuhan". Akan lebih mudah untuk menganggap ini sebagai kisah yang terpisah, satu tentang keamanan dan lainnya tentang hubungan masyarakat - tapi laporan baru dari Cage International berpendapat bahwa mereka tidak. Definisi telah dibentuk begitu tepat di sekitar negara keamanan yang, membaca dekat, berfungsi kurang sebagai perlindungan bagi umat Islam daripada sebagai perlindungan bagi lembaga yang telah menghabiskan dua dekade memperlakukan mereka sebagai tersangka. Kuncinya, saat laporan ditetapkan, terletak pada satu kata yang berjalan melalui setiap bagian dari definisi: maksud. Permusuhan anti- Muslim, seperti pemerintah mendefinisikan itu, berarti sengaja terlibat dalam tindakan kriminal terhadap Muslim, atau stereotip mereka "dengan maksud mendorong kebencian". Ini berarti diskriminasi di mana perilaku "dimaksudkan untuk merugikan umat Muslim dalam kehidupan publik dan ekonomi". Diskriminasi jarang mengumumkan sendiri dengan cara ini. Unit Respon Islammophobia, sebuah badan amal yang menangani kasus diskriminasi, telah memperingatkan bahwa ambang batas tidak termasuk kasus yang dilihatnya: bias, hambatan institusi, dan perekrutan proses yang diam-diam menyaring pelamar dengan nama M
articles.originalTitle: Britain's definition of 'anti-Muslim hostility' protects the state, not those being targeted
articles.originalDescription: Britain's definition of 'anti-Muslim hostility' protects the state, not those being targeted Submitted by Karsen Trull on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 14:09 New report from Cage International shows how UK policy leaves the central mechanism of post-9/11 Islamophobia untouched - and lends it official cover Britain's definition of anti-Muslim hostility 'is not a failed attempt to protect Muslims. It is a successful attempt to protect the state' (Reuters) Off This year marked a quarter of a century since the beginning of the “war on terror”, and in that time, the British state has built one of the most extensive counter-extremism systems in the world. Also this year, Britain produced - for the first time - an official definition of what it calls “anti-Muslim hostility” . It would be easy to treat these as separate stories, one about security and the other about community relations - but a new report from Cage International argues that they are not. The definition has been shaped so precisely around the security state that, read closely, it functions less as a protection for Muslims than as a protection for the institutions that have spent two decades treating them as suspects. The key, as the report sets out, lies in a single word that runs through every part of the definition: intent. Anti-Muslim hostility, as the government defines it, means intentionally engaging in criminal acts against Muslims, or stereotyping them “with the intention of encouraging hatred.” It means discrimination where the conduct “is intended to disadvantage Muslims in public and economic life”. Discrimination rarely announces itself this way. The Islamophobia Response Unit, a charity that handles discrimination casework, has warned that the threshold excludes most of the cases it sees: bias, institutional barriers, and recruitment processes that quietly filter out applicants with Muslim names. articles.title: Saudi Arabia terpilih menjadi Dewan ITU untuk 2027- 2030
articles.description: DOHA - Arab Saudi telah terpilih untuk Dewan Internasional Telekomunikasi Uni (ITU) untuk 2027- 2030 istilah, bergabung dengan 47 negara lain pada dewan anggota 48, yang mendukung kegiatan serikat antara konferensi besar. Pemilu berlangsung selama Konferensi Plenipotentiary ITU (PP-26), saat ini sedang diadakan di Doha, Qatar, dengan dewan yang terdiri dari 48 negara terpilih dari negara-negara anggota serikat 194. Pemilihan ini mencerminkan berdiri internasional Kingdom dan kontribusi untuk mengembangkan komunikasi, sektor ruang dan teknologi, sambil memperkuat perannya dalam membentuk arah strategis ITU dan membangun konsensus pada prioritas internasional. Hal ini juga memperkuat upaya Arab Saudi untuk menjembatani kesenjangan digital, memperkuat konektivitas dan memperluas akses ke teknologi dan kecerdasan buatan, sementara memanfaatkan energi dan kemampuan komputasi untuk mendukung masa depan digital yang lebih inklusif. Menteri Komunikasi dan Teknologi Informasi dan Ketua Komunikasi, Space and Technology Commission (CST), Eng. Al- Swaha mengatakan pemilu Kingdom mencerminkan masyarakat internasional pengakuan dan kepercayaan diri dalam kepemimpinan dan kontribusi untuk mengembangkan komunikasi, sektor ruang dan teknologi dan memperkuat kemitraan internasional. Dia menekankan bahwa Arab Saudi mengukur nilai kemajuan teknologi dengan pengaruhnya pada kehidupan masyarakat dan bekerja dengan mitra internasional untuk memperluas akses ke teknologi dan membantu negara-negara mengembangkan kemampuan digital mereka. Gubernur CST Eng. "Arab Saudi memainkan peran penting dalam pekerjaan ITU dengan berkontribusi dalam pengembangan kebijakan dan strateginya, membangun konsensus di antara anggota negara dan pertukaran keahlian yang mendukung kemajuan komunikasi, sektor ruang dan teknologi", kata Al- Ohaly. Dia menambahkan bahwa Arab Saudi akan bekerja dengan rekannya selama jangka waktu mendatang untuk memperkuat infrastruktur digital, mengembangkan kemampuan dan mendukung
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia elected to ITU Council for 2027–2030 term
articles.originalDescription: DOHA — Saudi Arabia has been elected to the Council of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) for the 2027–2030 term, joining 47 other countries on the 48-member council, which oversees the union’s activities between major conferences. The election took place during the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference (PP-26), currently being held in Doha, Qatar, with the council comprising 48 countries elected from the union’s 194 member states. The election reflects the Kingdom’s international standing and its contributions to developing the communications, space and technology sectors, while strengthening its role in shaping the ITU’s strategic direction and building consensus on international priorities. It also reinforces Saudi Arabia’s efforts to bridge the digital divide, strengthen connectivity and expand access to technology and artificial intelligence, while leveraging its energy and computing capabilities to support a more inclusive digital future. Minister of Communications and Information Technology and Chairman of the Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST), Eng. Abdullah Al-Swaha, congratulated Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman on the occasion. Al-Swaha said the Kingdom’s election reflects the international community’s recognition of and confidence in its leadership and contributions to developing the communications, space and technology sectors and strengthening international partnerships. He stressed that Saudi Arabia measures the value of technological progress by its impact on people’s lives and works with international partners to expand access to technology and help countries develop their digital capabilities. articles.title: Undang-undang Perlindungan Konsumen baru Saudi memberikan denda maksimum kepada SR8 juta
articles.description: RIYADH - Hukum Perlindungan Konsumen Arab Saudi yang baru memperkenalkan pelanggaran stricter, menaikkan denda maksimum ke SR8 juta dari langit-langit SR2 juta sebelumnya diatur di bawah Hukum Penipuan Anti- Komersial, menurut Departemen Perdagangan. Disetujui oleh Dewan Menteri pada 10 November 2026, Hukum Perlindungan Konsumen pertama di Kingdom menetapkan kerangka kerja yang terpadu mengatur hak konsumen dalam produk dan jasa. Ini menggantikan pendekatan sebelumnya dari mendistribusikan ketentuan perlindungan konsumen ke beberapa undang-undang, dengan lebih dari 20 entitas pemerintah yang terlibat dalam implementasi tersebut. Hukum juga memperkuat perlindungan konsumen dalam transaksi layanan dan memperkenalkan langkah-langkah terhadap kenaikan harga yang tidak dibenarkan selama krisis dan pandemi, termasuk kemungkinan pengaturan harga dan memaksakan batas keuntungan maksimum. Ini memungkinkan periklanan komparatif dalam kondisi yang membutuhkan akurasi dan melarang praktek menyesatkan atau merugikan pesaing, sementara melarang ulasan palsu, memanipulasi peringkat dan praktek komersial penipuan lainnya. ketentuan khusus melindungi anak-anak, dewasa dan orang-orang dengan cacat, termasuk pembatasan pada iklan ditujukan pada anak-anak yang bisa membahayakan hidup mereka atau keselamatan. Undang-undang juga memungkinkan asosiasi konsumen untuk mengajukan tuntutan hukum atas nama konsumen dan memperkenalkan alternatif yang lebih cepat untuk menyelesaikan perselisihan di luar pengadilan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s new Consumer Protection Law raises maximum fines to SR8 million
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s new Consumer Protection Law introduces stricter penalties for violations, raising maximum fines to SR8 million from the SR2 million ceiling previously set under the Anti-Commercial Fraud Law, according to the Ministry of Commerce. Approved by the Council of Ministers on November 10, 2026, the Kingdom’s first comprehensive Consumer Protection Law establishes a unified framework governing consumer rights in products and services. It replaces the previous approach of distributing consumer protection provisions across several laws, with more than 20 government entities involved in its implementation. The law also strengthens consumer protections in service transactions and introduces measures against unjustified price increases during crises and pandemics, including the possibility of setting prices and imposing maximum profit margins. It permits comparative advertising under conditions requiring accuracy and prohibiting misleading practices or harm to competitors, while banning fake reviews, manipulated ratings and other fraudulent commercial practices. Special provisions protect children, older adults and people with disabilities, including restrictions on advertisements directed at children that could harm their lives or safety. The legislation also allows consumer associations to file lawsuits on behalf of consumers and introduces faster alternatives for resolving disputes outside the courts.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s R&D spending rises 17% to SR34.51 billion in 2025
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s expenditure on research and development (R&D) rose 17 percent year-on-year to approximately SR34.51 billion in 2025, while employment in the sector increased by 20 percent to 67,691, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The authority’s Research and Development Statistics 2025 report also showed that the number of researchers increased by 19 percent compared with 2024, reaching 49,383. The business sector accounted for the largest share of R&D expenditure at 44.8 percent, equivalent to SR15.47 billion, followed by the government sector at 37.5 percent, or SR12.95 billion, and higher education at 17.7 percent, totaling SR6.10 billion. Meanwhile, the government sector provided the largest share of R&D funding at SR16.27 billion, representing 47.1 percent of the total, followed by the business sector at SR15.40 billion, or 44.6 percent, and higher education at SR2.84 billion, accounting for 8.2 percent. The report also revealed that large entities accounted for 97.9 percent of total R&D expenditure, amounting to SR33.79 billion, while micro, small and medium-sized entities contributed SR0.73 billion, representing 2.1 percent. **media[2795079]** R&D expenditure as a proportion of the Kingdom’s gross domestic product (GDP) reached 0.72 percent in 2025. In terms of employment, the higher education sector accounted for the largest share of R&D personnel at 65.7 percent, with 44,469 employees, followed by the business sector with 18,354 employees, or 27.1 percent, and the government sector with 4,868 employees, representing 7.2 percent. articles.title: NCM mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk hujan lebat di Mekah sebagai badai petir mengancam daerah Saudi lainnya
articles.description: JEDDAH - Pusat Nasional Meteorologi (NCM) telah mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk hujan deras di Ibukota Suci pada hari Senin, sementara moderat untuk badai petir berat juga diperkirakan di seluruh daerah Jazan, Asir dan Al- Baha daerah. Peringatan merah untuk Mekah akan tetap berlaku dari 02: 00 sampai 09: 00, dengan hujan lebat diharapkan disertai dengan angin kuat, dekat- nol visibilitas, hujan es, banjir kilat dan petir. Dalam cuaca nasional cuaca cuaca, yang mengatakan moderat untuk badai petir berat mampu memicu banjir kilat diharapkan di seluruh bagian Jazan, Asir, Al- Baha dan Mekah daerah, disertai dengan hujan dan angin aktif. Kabut mungkin juga terbentuk di beberapa daerah yang terkena. Di Mekah, suhu diperkirakan berkisar dari 23 ° C sampai 35 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 85 persen, sementara Al- Baha diharapkan untuk merekam suhu antara 12 ° C dan 20 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen. Abha diperkirakan mengalami suhu berkisar dari 11 ° C sampai 21 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen, sementara Jazan diharapkan untuk merekam suhu antara 26 ° C dan 33 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Keempat lokasi diperkirakan akan mengalami badai besar dan angin kencang. Sementara itu, Riyadh diharapkan untuk mengalami kondisi berawan, dengan suhu berkisar dari 11 ° C sampai 25 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 70 persen. Jeddah diperkirakan mengalami kondisi berawan sebagian dan kabut, dengan suhu antara 25 ° C dan 34 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Dammam diharapkan untuk mengalami angin aktif, dengan suhu berkisar dari 15 ° C ke 26 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 65 persen. Ramalan lainnya termasuk beberapa kondisi berawan di Madinah, dengan suhu antara 20 ° C dan 32 ° C, dan berawan pada kondisi berawan di Tabuk, Buraydah, Hail dan Najran. Arar dan Sakaka diramalkan untuk mengalami kondisi awan, dengan suhu berkisar dari 12 ° C sampai 26 ° C dan 11 ° C sampai 25 ° C, hormat.
articles.originalTitle: NCM issues red alert for heavy rainfall in Makkah as thunderstorms threaten other Saudi regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued a red alert for heavy rainfall in the Holy Capital on Monday, while moderate to heavy thunderstorms are also forecast across parts of Jazan, Asir and Al-Baha regions. The red alert for Makkah will remain in effect from 2 p.m. to 9 p.m., with heavy rainfall expected to be accompanied by strong winds, near-zero visibility, hail, flash floods and lightning. In its nationwide daily weather forecast, the NCM said moderate to heavy thunderstorms capable of triggering flash floods are expected across parts of Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha and Makkah regions, accompanied by hail and active winds. Fog may also form in some affected areas. In Makkah, temperatures are forecast to range from 23°C to 35°C, with humidity reaching 85 percent, while Al-Baha is expected to record temperatures between 12°C and 20°C, with humidity reaching 95 percent. Abha is forecast to experience temperatures ranging from 11°C to 21°C, with humidity reaching 95 percent, while Jazan is expected to record temperatures between 26°C and 33°C, with humidity reaching 90 percent. All four locations are forecast to experience moderate to heavy thunderstorms and active winds. Meanwhile, Riyadh is expected to experience cloudy conditions, with temperatures ranging from 11°C to 25°C and humidity reaching 70 percent. Jeddah is forecast to experience partly cloudy conditions and fog, with temperatures between 25°C and 34°C and humidity reaching 90 percent. Dammam is expected to experience active winds, with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 26°C and humidity reaching 65 percent. Other forecasts include partly cloudy conditions in Madinah, with temperatures between 20°C and 32°C, and cloudy to partly cloudy conditions in Tabuk, Buraydah, Hail and Najran. Arar and Sakaka are forecast to experience cloudy conditions, with temperatures ranging from 12°C to 26°C and 11°C to 25°C, respectively.

articles.title: Harga produsen Arab Saudi naik 6,6% pada bulan September, didorong oleh pertumbuhan manufaktur
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi Producer Price Index (PPI) naik 6,6 persen tahun -pada September 2026, didorong oleh peningkatan 7 persen dalam harga produksi, menurut Authority Umum untuk Statistik (GASTAT). Peningkatan juga didukung dengan kenaikan 3,4 persen harga untuk persediaan air, sewerage dan aktivitas pengelolaan limbah, bersama peningkatan listrik 2,2 persen, gas, uap dan harga penyediaan udara. Dalam produksi, mengenakan pakaian tercatat peningkatan harga tahunan tertinggi pada 12.3 persen, diikuti dengan bahan kimia dan produk kimia pada 12,2 persen dan logam dasar pada 9.5 persen. Harga untuk produk minyak halus naik 8.4 persen, sementara harga pangan meningkat 6.1 persen. Sebaliknya, harga untuk produk logam buatan, tanpa mesin dan peralatan, menurun 3 persen, sedangkan kegiatan ekonomi lainnya mencatat penurunan 3,7 persen. * * Media [2795063] * Secara bulanan, PPI meningkatkan 1,7 persen pada bulan September dibandingkan dengan Agustus 2026, didorong terutama oleh kenaikan 3.7 persen dalam harga pabrik minyak halus dan 2,9 persen peningkatan bahan kimia dan produk kimia. Harga produksi pangan juga naik 0,7 persen bulan, sementara aktivitas ekonomi lainnya meningkat 0,2 persen. Sementara itu, harga produksi tekstil menurun sebesar 4,3 persen, diikuti dengan penurunan 2,6 persen dari harga pembuatan peralatan listrik. Harga listrik, gas, uap, dan sektor pendingin udara tetap tidak berubah selama sebulan, sementara pasokan air, sewerage dan kegiatan pengelolaan limbah merekam peningkatan 0,1 persen. The Producer Price Index mengukur perubahan dalam harga produsen domestik di seluruh manufaktur, listrik, gas, uap dan penyediaan udara, dan pasokan air, sewerage dan sampah kegiatan manajemen.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s producer prices rise 6.6% in September, driven by manufacturing growth
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s Producer Price Index (PPI) rose 6.6 percent year-on-year in September 2026, driven by a 7 percent increase in manufacturing prices, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The increase was also supported by a 3.4 percent rise in prices for water supply, sewerage and waste management activities, alongside a 2.2 percent increase in electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply prices. Within manufacturing, wearing apparel recorded the highest annual price increase at 12.3 percent, followed by chemicals and chemical products at 12.2 percent and basic metals at 9.5 percent. Prices for refined petroleum products rose 8.4 percent, while food manufacturing prices increased 6.1 percent. In contrast, prices for fabricated metal products, excluding machinery and equipment, declined by 3 percent, while other economic activities recorded a 3.7 percent decrease. **media[2795063]** On a monthly basis, the PPI increased by 1.7 percent in September compared with August 2026, driven primarily by a 3.7 percent rise in refined petroleum product manufacturing prices and a 2.9 percent increase in chemicals and chemical products. Food manufacturing prices also rose 0.7 percent month-on-month, while other economic activities increased by 0.2 percent. Meanwhile, textile manufacturing prices declined by 4.3 percent, followed by a 2.6 percent decrease in electrical equipment manufacturing prices. Prices in the electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply sector remained unchanged during the month, while water supply, sewerage and waste management activities recorded a 0.1 percent increase. The Producer Price Index measures changes in domestic producer prices across manufacturing, electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply, and water supply, sewerage and waste management activities.

articles.title: Rumah sakit Yaman menghadapi risiko shutdown karena sege di Taiz
articles.description: Rumah sakit Yaman menghadapi risiko mati karena menyegel di Taiz Sebuah rumah sakit di kota Yaman Taiz telah terdengar alarm atas obat dan kekurangan bahan bakar, peringatan bahwa menghadapi risiko shutdown jika akses ke bantuan dan persediaan tidak dipulihkan. "Selama dua bulan kami telah menelepon dan menarik bagi masyarakat internasional, organisasi kemanusiaan: menyelamatkan Taiz, menyelamatkan kesehatan di Taiz, menyelamatkan rumah sakit Yaman-Swedia. Tidak ada bahan bakar. Kami berada di napas terakhir kami", kata direktur rumah sakit Sami Al- Sharabi. Houthis telah mengepung Taiz selama lebih dari sebulan karena mereka mencoba untuk masuk ke wilayah yang diselenggarakan oleh Saudi - didukung pasukan pemerintah Yaman. Sejak pertempuran dinyalakan kembali di musim panas, hampir 330.000 orang telah dipindahkan. "Selamatkan Taiz, simpan kesehatan di Taiz, selamatkan rumah sakit Yaman-Swedia. Tidak ada bahan bakar. Kami berada di napas terakhir kami." Sebuah rumah sakit di kota Yaman Taiz telah terdengar alarm atas obat dan kekurangan bahan bakar disebabkan oleh pengepungan oleh Houthis yang telah berlangsung selama lebih dari sebulan. https: / / t.co / vUoimztr5h - Middle East Eye (@ MiddleEastEye) November 15, 2026
articles.originalTitle: Yemen hospital faces shutdown risk due to sege on Taiz
articles.originalDescription: Yemen hospital faces shutdown risk due to sege on Taiz A hospital in the Yemeni city of Taiz has sounded the alarm over medicine and fuel shortages, warning that it is facing the risk of a shutdown if access to aid and supplies is not restored. "For two months we have been calling and appealing to the international community, the humanitarian organisations: save Taiz, save health in Taiz, save the Yemeni-Swedish hospital. There is no fuel. We are at our last breath," said the hospital director Sami Al-Sharabi. The Houthis have besieged Taiz for more than a month as they try to break into territory held by the Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces. Since fighting reignited in the summer, nearly 330,000 people have been displaced. "Save Taiz, save health in Taiz, save the Yemeni-Swedish hospital. There is no fuel. We are at our last breath." A hospital in the Yemeni city of Taiz has sounded the alarm over medicine and fuel shortages caused by a siege by the Houthis that has lasted for more than a month. https://t.co/vUoimztr5h — Middle East Eye (@MiddleEastEye) November 15, 2026

articles.title: Raja Salman memerintahkan promosi dan janji 167 hakim di Departemen Kehakiman
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman telah mengeluarkan perintah kerajaan mempromosikan dan menunjuk 167 hakim di Departemen Kehakiman di berbagai peringkat. Menteri Kehakiman dan Presiden Bertindak Agung Dewan Judisial Walid Al- Samaani mengatakan bahwa perintah mencerminkan raja terus dukungan untuk sektor peradilan, bersama dengan follow- up dan dukungan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman dan komitmen mereka untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan meningkatkan hasilnya. Dia mencatat bahwa promosi dan janji akan berkontribusi terhadap pengembangan sektor tersebut, meningkatkan kinerja peradilan, dan meningkatkan kualitas putusan, sejalan dengan kemajuan sistem peradilan yang sedang berlangsung. Al- Samaani menyatakan rasa terima kasihnya kepada kepemimpinan Kerajaan untuk dukungan sektor peradilan, berdoa untuk keberhasilan para juri dalam melaksanakan tugas mereka dan menegakkan keadilan.

Al-Samaani expressed his gratitude to the Kingdom’s leadership for its support of the judicial sector, praying for the judges’ success in carrying out their duties and upholding justice.

articles.originalTitle: Israel's data shows it allowed half of the promised aid trucks into Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Israel's data shows it allowed half of the promised aid trucks into Gaza Submitted by MEE staff on Sun, 11/15/2026 - 14:15 Israeli military data shows deliveries to Gaza have fallen well short of the 4,200 trucks a week promised under the ceasefire deal in most months A boy eats from a pot as displaced Palestinians gather for hot meals distributed by a charity kitchen in Nuseirat refugee camp in the central Gaza Strip on 12 June 2026 (Eyad Baba/AFP) Off Israel has failed to meet its commitments under the Gaza ceasefire deal, allowing in only around half the agreed volume of humanitarian and commercial goods each month since March, Israeli military data shows. Data obtained by Haaretz newspaper showed a growing shortfall in food deliveries to Gaza, alongside severe shortages of medical supplies, tents and materials to repair damaged infrastructure. Torrential rains have flooded displacement camps, leaving hundreds of thousands of Palestinians in increasingly dire conditions. Under the ceasefire deal, Israel pledged to allow 4,200 vehicles carrying humanitarian and commercial goods into Gaza each week, equivalent to roughly 18,200 a month. Deliveries were to include food, fuel, medical supplies and equipment, shelter materials and equipment to repair essential infrastructure. Data supplied by the Coordinator of Government Activities in the Territories (Cogat) to the US-led International Gaza Support Center (IGSC) show that Israel allowed about 4,700 trucks into Gaza in March, rising to 5,300 in April and more than 9,600 in May. The number increased to more than 12,000 in June before falling to about 10,000 in both July and August. Deliveries peaked at more than 13,000 in September, then dropped sharply to just over 6,500 in October. Cogat disputed the findings, saying that the data presented was "inaccurate” and that Israel was meeting its humanitarian commitments “and beyond them”. articles.description: MakKAH - Otoritas Umum untuk Layanan Urusan Masjid Agung dan Masjid Nabi adalah menyediakan gelang keselamatan untuk pengunjung Masjid Agung untuk memfasilitasi identifikasi dan lokasi anak-anak, orang tua dan orang-orang dengan cacat jika mereka terpisah dari teman-teman mereka. Inisiatif bertujuan untuk meningkatkan keselamatan pengunjung dan memastikan kesejahteraan mereka sementara mereka berada di dalam Masjid Grand dan porseleds nya. Layanan disediakan gratis biaya melalui pusat perawatan tamu. Pewaris diberikan gelang berisi rincian identifikasi, yang memungkinkan staf di tanah untuk mengidentifikasi mereka dan menghubungi keluarga mereka ketika diperlukan. Inisiatif ini mencerminkan komitmen otoritas untuk memprioritaskan keamanan dan kemanusiaan, memastikan lingkungan yang aman dan diakses bagi semua orang yang mengunjungi Masjid, dengan demikian memfasilitasi perjalanan mereka dan memungkinkan mereka untuk melakukan ibadah mereka dengan ketenangan pikiran.
articles.originalTitle: Safety bracelet service enhances care for children and elderly at Makkah Grand Mosque
articles.originalDescription: MAKKAH — The General Authority for the Care of the Affairs of the Grand Mosque and the Prophet’s Mosque is providing safety bracelets to visitors of the Grand Mosque to facilitate the identification and location of children, elderly people and persons with disabilities if they become separated from their companions. The initiative aims to enhance visitor safety and ensure their well-being while they are inside the Grand Mosque and its courtyards. The service is provided free of charge through the guest care centers. Beneficiaries are given bracelets containing identification details, which enable staff on the ground to identify them and contact their families when necessary. This initiative reflects the authority’s commitment to prioritizing safety and humanitarian care, ensuring a secure and accessible environment for all who visit the Grand Mosque, thereby facilitating their journey and allowing them to perform their worship with peace of mind.

Dalam hal pengeluaran konsumen, laporan tersebut mengungkapkan bahwa sewa perumahan yang sebenarnya meningkat sebesar 3,5 persen, sedangkan harga dalam layanan asuransi dan keuangan juga naik sebesar 3,5 persen, didorong oleh kenaikan harga layanan asuransi sebesar 6,5 persen. articles.originalTitle: Inflation in Saudi Arabia reaches 1.7% in October
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Inflation or Consumer Price Index (CPI) in Saudi Arabia registered an annual increase of 1.7 percent in October 2026 compared to the same month last year, according to data released on Sunday by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The authority attributed the rise primarily to a 3.5 percent increase in housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuel prices, alongside a 1.1 percent rise in food and beverage prices and a 2.3 percent increase in transportation prices.In terms of consumer spending, the report revealed that actual housing rents increased by 3.5 percent, while prices in insurance and financial services also rose by 3.5 percent, driven by a 6.5 percent increase in insurance service prices.Prices in the recreation, sports and culture sector climbed by 2.7 percent, reflecting a 4.6 percent increase in holiday package prices. Passenger transportation services recorded a more substantial rise of 9.5 percent. Conversely, prices in the furniture, household appliances and routine home maintenance category declined by 0.5 percent while those in the clothing and footwear category fell by 0.2 percent.The housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels category emerged as the largest contributor to the annual inflation rate, accounting for 0.7 percentage points. This was followed by transportation at 0.3 percentage points, food and beverages at 0.2 percentage points, and personal care, social protection and other goods and services at 0.1 percentage points. The remaining categories collectively contributed 0.4 percentage points.On a month-on-month basis, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased by 0.1 percent in October compared to September 2026. The rise was driven by a 0.2 percent increase in housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuel prices, supported by a 0.4 percent rise in actual housing rents. articles.title: Isu kementrian kota 80.775 izin pembangunan di Saudi Arabia dalam 9 bulan
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Kota dan Perumahan telah mengeluarkan izin pembangunan 80,775 di seluruh Arab Saudi dari Januari sampai akhir September 2026. Ini adalah bagian dari upaya kementerian untuk mengatur kegiatan konstruksi, prosedur perizinan pembangunan yang efisien, dan menjaga kecepatan dengan pertumbuhan perkotaan di kota dan pemerintahan. Menteri mengatakan bahwa meningkatkan layanan lisensi adalah bagian dari upaya untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasi kota, meningkatkan lingkungan perkotaan, dan memfasilitasi akses ke layanan kota untuk individu dan investor, sehingga meningkatkan kualitas pengalaman perkotaan dan mendukung pengembangan kota yang lebih efisien yang lebih memenuhi kebutuhan warga. Departemen mencatat bahwa prosedur yang efisien dan meningkatkan efisiensi layanan digital yang mendukung pembangunan kota dan aktivitas investasi, meningkatkan kualitas proyek di dalam kota, dan menyesuaikan dengan tujuan pelayanan untuk meningkatkan kualitas hidup, meningkatkan kualitas layanan, dan meningkatkan lanskap perkotaan.
articles.originalTitle: Municipalities ministry issues 80,775 building permits across Saudi Arabia in 9 months
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing has issued 80,775 building permits across Saudi Arabia from January through the end of September 2026. This is part of the ministry's efforts to regulate construction activities, streamline building permit procedures, and keep pace with urban growth in cities and governorates. The ministry said that improving licensing services is part of its efforts to enhance the efficiency of city operations, improve the urban environment, and facilitate access to municipal services for individuals and investors, thereby enhancing the quality of the urban experience and supporting the development of more efficient cities that better meet residents' needs. The ministry noted that streamlining procedures and improving the efficiency of digital services support urban development and investment activity, improve the quality of projects within cities, and align with the ministry's objectives of improving quality of life, enhancing service quality, and improving the urban landscape.

articles.title: Riyadh memulai pembangunan 70,000 pasukan meter Expo 2030 Metro
articles.description: RIYADH - Komisi Kerajaan untuk Riyadh City (RCRC) telah mulai bekerja konstruksi di stasiun "Expo" Metro Riyadh, yang akan mencakup sekitar 70.000 meter persegi dan mengakomodasi hingga 19.000 penumpang per jam, bersama pembukaan desain arsitektur. Proyek ini membentuk bagian dari usaha komisi untuk mengembangkan jaringan transportasi modal dan menjaga kecepatan dengan populasi, pertumbuhan perkotaan dan ekonomi. Stasiun ini akan memfasilitasi akses untuk pengunjung Expo melalui sistem transportasi publik dan berfungsi sebagai tambahan permanen untuk jaringan Metro Riyadh sementara terus melayani daerah sekitarnya dan tujuan terdekat setelah pameran selesai. Terletak di Riyadh Metro Yellow Line, yang terhubung ke King Khalid International Airport, stasiun akan memperpanjang lebih dari Raja Salman Road dalam koridor hijau menghubungkan Expo 2030 Riyadh situs ke timur dengan masa depan daerah pengembangan perkotaan ke barat. Desain arsitektur menarik inspirasi dari lanskap alami Riyadh ini, terutama lembah dan pohon akasia. Stasiun akan menampilkan kubah baja pengukuran diameter 134 meter, didukung oleh delapan kolom percabangan menyerupai pohon akasia dan menyediakan bayangan ruang untuk pengunjung. Ini juga akan meliputi sekitar 44.000 meter persegi ruang hijau, bersama sistem energi matahari dirancang untuk mencakup sekitar 25 persen dari konsumsi energi. Komisi ini menerapkan proyek sesuai jadwal yang dikoordinasikan dengan pengembangan situs Expo, memastikan penyelesaian bersama kesiapan situs dan sebelum pameran dimulai. Konstruksi akan mengikuti rencana manajemen lalu lintas yang dikembangkan dalam koordinasi dengan pihak berwenang yang relevan, termasuk rute alternatif untuk meminimalkan gangguan terhadap lalu lintas dan lingkungan sekitar sambil mempertahankan arus lalu lintas halus dan akses ke daerah selama periode konstruksi.
articles.originalTitle: Riyadh begins construction of 70,000-square-meter Expo 2030 Metro station
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Royal Commission for Riyadh City (RCRC) has started construction work on the Riyadh Metro’s “Expo” station, which will cover approximately 70,000 square meters and accommodate up to 19,000 passengers per hour, alongside the unveiling of its architectural design. The project forms part of the commission’s efforts to develop the capital’s transportation network and keep pace with its population, urban and economic growth. The station will facilitate access for Expo visitors through the public transportation system and serve as a permanent addition to the Riyadh Metro network while continuing to serve the surrounding area and nearby destinations after the exhibition concludes. Located on the Riyadh Metro’s Yellow Line, which connects to King Khalid International Airport, the station will extend over King Salman Road within a green corridor linking the Expo 2030 Riyadh site to the east with future urban development areas to the west. Its architectural design draws inspiration from Riyadh’s natural landscape, particularly its valleys and acacia trees. The station will feature a steel dome measuring 134 meters in diameter, supported by eight branching columns resembling acacia trees and providing shaded spaces for visitors. It will also include approximately 44,000 square meters of green spaces, alongside solar energy systems designed to cover around 25 percent of its energy consumption. The commission is implementing the project according to a schedule coordinated with the development of the Expo site, ensuring its completion alongside the site's readiness and before the exhibition begins. Construction will follow a traffic management plan developed in coordination with relevant authorities, including alternative routes to minimize disruption to traffic and surrounding residential neighborhoods while maintaining smooth traffic flow and access to the area throughout the construction period.

articles.title: Tentara Selatan mengumumkan penyebaran dari Bab al- Mandab untuk pertahanan bolster Aden
articles.description: ADEN - Yemen Selatan Angkatan Bersenjata mengumumkan pada hari Minggu penyebaran pasukan mereka dari distrik dan daerah Bab Al- Mandab, barat pemerintah Taiz, sebagai bagian dari upaya untuk memperkuat posisi militer dan memprioritaskan keamanan pemerintah Aden dan tetangga. Dalam pernyataan yang dikeluarkan pada hari Minggu, pasukan mengatakan gerakan berikut perkembangan baru-baru ini di medan perang, termasuk militer buildups dan ancaman menargetkan Aden dan daerah sekitarnya, serta laporan kelompok bersenjata musuh bergerak melalui daerah mengawasi kota. Perbaikan tujuan untuk mengatur posisi militer, memperkuat depan kunci dan memperkuat kehadiran pasukan di daerah dan sepanjang rute yang diperlukan oleh keadaan saat ini. Angkatan Bersenjata Selatan menekankan bahwa mengamankan Aden dan pemerintah tetangga tetap menjadi prioritas, bersama menghadapi ancaman yang sudah ada dan melanjutkan operasi militer melawan milisi Houthi. Mereka menegaskan kembali bahwa konfrontasi mereka dengan Houthis akan terus berlanjut sampai pemberontakan Houthi berakhir, institusi negara dipulihkan, dan keamanan dan stabilitas tercapai. Pasukan-pasukan juga menekankan komitmen mereka untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas di Aden dan menghilangkan ancaman Houthi ke kota, dengan dukungan dan bantuan dari Koalisi untuk mendukung Legitimasi di Yaman, yang dipimpin oleh Arab Saudi. Pernyataan lebih menekankan bahwa tugas nasional dan berbagi tanggung jawab dalam menghadapi ancaman tidak terbatas pada lokasi geografis tertentu, tetapi ditentukan oleh persyaratan operasional dan kepentingan publik. Tentara Selatan memuji upaya dan pengorbanan personil mereka di berbagai medan perang, menggambarkan mereka sebagai sumber kebanggaan dan apresiasi. Mereka memperbaharui komitmen mereka untuk melindungi keamanan dan stabilitas rakyat mereka, menekankan bahwa perubahan keadaan dan perkembangan di tanah tidak akan menghalangi mereka dari memenuhi tugas nasional mereka dan tanggung jawab.
articles.originalTitle: Southern Armed Forces announce redeployment from Bab al-Mandab to bolster Aden’s defenses
articles.originalDescription: ADEN — Yemen’s Southern Armed Forces announced on Sunday the redeployment of their forces from districts and the Bab Al-Mandab area, west of Taiz Governorate, as part of efforts to strengthen military positions and prioritize the security of Aden and neighboring governorates. In a statement issued on Sunday, the forces said the move follows recent developments on the battlefronts, including military buildups and threats targeting Aden and its surrounding area, as well as reports of hostile armed groups moving through areas overlooking the city. The redeployment aims to reorganize military positions, reinforce key fronts and strengthen the forces’ presence in areas and along routes required by the current circumstances. The Southern Armed Forces stressed that securing Aden and neighboring governorates remains a priority, alongside confronting existing threats and continuing military operations against the Houthi militia. They reaffirmed that their confrontation with the Houthis would continue until the Houthi rebellion ends, state institutions are restored, and security and stability are achieved. The forces also emphasized their commitment to maintaining security and stability in Aden and eliminating Houthi threats to the city, with the support and assistance of the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, led by Saudi Arabia. The statement further stressed that national duty and shared responsibility in confronting threats are not confined to any particular geographical location, but are determined by operational requirements and the public interest. The Southern Armed Forces praised the efforts and sacrifices of their personnel across various battlefronts, describing them as a source of pride and appreciation. They renewed their commitment to protecting their people’s security and stability, emphasizing that changing circumstances and developments on the ground would not deter them from fulfilling their national duties and responsibilities.

articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi telah mengutuk dengan keras serangan udara Iran di Bahrain, berikut klaim dari Korps Garda Revolusi Islam Iran (IRGC) bahwa virus tersebut telah meluncurkan enam drone yang menargetkan sistem radar AS di Kingdom. Dalam sebuah pernyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Luar Negeri pada hari Minggu, Arab Saudi menegaskan kembali solidaritasnya dengan Bahrain dalam segala hal yang diambil untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas. Hal ini juga menekankan bahwa serangan Iran merupakan pelanggaran hukum internasional dan prinsip-prinsip lingkungan yang baik. The Kingdom menekankan pentingnya segera menghentikan serangan terang-terangan Iran terhadap negara-negara di wilayah tersebut. Pernyataan ini menyimpulkan dengan Arab Saudi menyerukan langkah-langkah serius untuk mencapai keamanan dan stabilitas bagi negara-negara dan masyarakat wilayah.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia condemns Iranian aerial attacks on Bahrain, calls for immediate halt
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has strongly condemned the Iranian aerial attacks on Bahrain, following a claim by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) that it had launched six drones targeting a US radar system in the Kingdom. In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Sunday, Saudi Arabia reaffirmed its full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures taken to safeguard its security and stability. It also stressed that the Iranian attacks constitute a violation of international law and the principles of good neighborliness. The Kingdom emphasized the importance of immediately halting of blatant Iranian attacks on countries in the region. The statement concluded with Saudi Arabia calling for serious steps toward achieving security and stability for the countries and peoples of the region.

articles.title: 'Melihat pergi tidak pernah pilihan bagi saya': Bagaimana hubungan cinta Hollywood dengan Israel berubah asam
articles.description: 'Melihat pergi tidak pernah pilihan bagi saya': Bagaimana hubungan cinta Hollywood dengan Israel berubah menjadi asam Diganti oleh Fleur Hargreaves pada Mon, 11 / 02 / 2026 - 10: 59 Sejumlah aktor dan pekerja film menantang keterlibatan industri mereka di Israel untuk mengakhiri hubungan beracun antara aktris AS Hannah Einbinder mengenakan pin 'Artists4Creasefire' saat dia menghadiri penghargaan Golden Globe ke-83 di hotel Beverly Hilton di Beverly Hills, California, pada 11 Januari 2026 (Frederic J Brown / AFP) setelah Israel dapat mengandalkan Hollywood untuk memiliki reputasi yang dicurangi, menampilkan peran yang ramah dan kepentingan Barat. Namun, jumlah aktor dan tokoh terkemuka dalam film dan TV yang sedang menghadapi keterlibatan industri dengan pendudukan Israel dan tindakannya di Gaza, yang telah disebut genosida oleh para ahli dan kelompok HAM. Semakin banyak seniman menggunakan platform mereka untuk berbicara tentang nasib warga Palestina dan telah berkontribusi terhadap persetujuan Israel antara penonton Barat. Pada tahun 2025, organisasi berbasis AS Pekerja Film Palestina (FWP), didirikan oleh sekelompok pembuat film tahun lalu, merilis janji untuk mengakhiri keterlibatan dengan genosida di Gaza. Ini mengumpulkan tanda tangan lebih dari 5,500 orang dalam industri, termasuk A-list aktor seperti Josh O 'Connor, Olivia Colman, Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone dan banyak lagi. Terinspirasi oleh pembuat film Bersatu melawan Apartheid, sekelompok seniman yang menolak untuk layar karya mereka di apartheid Afrika Selatan, pertanda berjanji tidak untuk layar film, muncul atau bekerja bersama lembaga film Israel yang terlibat dalam genosida dan apartheid. articles.originalTitle: Trump may not attack Iran as long as it doesn't provoke US, report says
articles.originalDescription: Trump may not attack Iran as long as it doesn't provoke US, report says President Donald Trump has told senior advisers in recent days that he may hold off on attacking Iran if the US faces no new provocations from Tehran or the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen, according to three people familiar with the matter. Trump has alternated between threats of escalating the war with new strikes and winding down hostilities, and current and former officials say he does not appear to have made up his mind about how to resolve the unpopular conflict, which he launched in February with Israel. But in meetings with his national security advisers and after a series of intelligence briefings, Trump said he was considering holding off on strikes, said the people, who, like others interviewed for this story, spoke on condition of anonymity. He has also indicated sympathy for allies in the region who have asked him not to return to a full-fledged war. "I could end it immediately, but at the request of the nations that I am looking to protect, we are doing it a little bit longer way, a bit more civilly," Trump told sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith on Thursday. Trump's private comments build on public remarks playing down the likelihood of major warfare resuming. They said Trump made no commitment either way. articles.title: Komandan Hamas Samir Abu Younis tewas dalam serangan Israel terhadap Khan Younis
articles.description: Komandan Hamas Samir Abu Younis tewas dalam serangan Israel terhadap Khan Younis Hamas 'sayap bersenjata mengatakan pada hari Minggu bahwa seorang komandan senior yang membantu merencanakan dan mengawasi 7 Oktober 2023 serangan terhadap Israel telah tewas dalam serangan udara Israel. Brigade Al- Qassam mengidentifikasi komandan sebagai Samir Abu Younis, 53, komandan brigade Rafah nya, dan mengatakan ia dibunuh pada hari Sabtu. Militer Israel mengatakan pada hari Minggu itu telah memukul seorang komandan senior di Hamas apos; sayap bersenjata tetapi tidak mengidentifikasi dirinya. Dokter mengatakan Abu Younis tewas dan lainnya terluka dalam serangan udara yang ditargetkan dia di jalan di daerah Mawasi Khan Younis di Jalur Gaza selatan. Hamas mengatakan Abu Younis bergabung dengan sayap bersenjata Hamas pada tahun 1991 dan telah mengadakan beberapa peran operasional senior di Rafah sebelum menjadi komandan brigade. Hamas mengatakan pemakamannya akan diadakan pada Minggu sore di Khan Younis. Sebuah gencatan senjata Oktober 2025 dihentikan pertempuran besar tetapi belum berhenti serangan Israel atau dijamin pemusnahan Hamas'. Pihak berwenang kesehatan Gaza mengatakan setidaknya 1.600 warga Palestina telah terbunuh sejak gencatan senjata terjadi. Lima tentara Israel telah terbunuh selama periode yang sama. Pihak berwenang Palestina mengatakan lebih dari 74.000 orang telah tewas dalam kampanye militer Israel melawan Gaza, diluncurkan setelah pejuang Hamas- dipimpin membunuh sekitar 1.200 orang di Israel selatan pada Oktober 2023. Laporan oleh AFP
articles.originalTitle: Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis killed in Israeli strike on Khan Younis
articles.originalDescription: Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis killed in Israeli strike on Khan Younis Hamas' armed wing said on Sunday that a senior commander who helped plan and oversee the 7 October 2023 attack on Israel had been killed in an Israeli airstrike. The Al-Qassam Brigades identified the commander as Samir Abu Younis, 53, the commander of its Rafah brigade, and said he was killed on Saturday. The Israeli military said on Sunday it had struck a senior commander in Hamas' armed wing but did not identify him. Medics said Abu Younis was killed and others were wounded in an airstrike that targeted him in a street in the Mawasi area of Khan Younis in the southern Gaza Strip. Hamas said Abu Younis joined Hamas' armed wing in 1991 and had held several senior operational roles in Rafah before becoming commander of the brigade. Hamas said his funeral would be held on Sunday afternoon in Khan Younis. An October ​2025 ceasefire halted major fighting but has not stopped Israeli attacks or secured Hamas' disarmament. Gaza health authorities say at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the ceasefire went into effect. Five Israeli soldiers have been killed ​during the same period. Palestinian authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed in Israel's military campaign against Gaza, launched after Hamas-led fighters killed about 1,200 people in southern Israel in October 2023. Report by AFP

articles.title: 11.952 pelanggar residensi, tenaga kerja dan hukum keamanan perbatasan ditangkap dalam seminggu
articles.description: RIYADH - Pasukan keamanan Saudi menangkap total penduduk ilegal 11.952 dalam seminggu. Penangkapan dilakukan dalam pemeriksaan bersama, dilakukan dalam kerjasama dengan lembaga pemerintah yang relevan, selama periode antara 5 November dan 11, Kementerian Dalam Negeri diumumkan pada hari Sabtu. Mereka yang ditangkap termasuk 6.163 pelanggar Hukum Residensi, 3,225 pelanggar Hukum Keamanan Perbatasan, dan 2.564 pelanggar Hukum Tenaga Kerja. Jumlah total orang yang ditangkap saat mencoba untuk menyeberangi perbatasan ke Kingdom berjumlah 1,653. Sekitar 29 orang ditangkap saat mencoba meninggalkan Kerajaan secara ilegal. Total penduduk ilegal 11.418 dideportasi sementara 22.451 pelanggar disebut misi diplomatik mereka untuk mendapatkan dokumen perjalanan dan 9.800 pelanggar disebut untuk menyelesaikan pemesanan perjalanan mereka. Lima belas orang, yang terlibat dalam memberikan transportasi, tempat tinggal, dan pekerjaan untuk pelanggar, juga ditangkap. Totalnya 40.762 ekspatriat, termasuk 38.383 pria dan 2.379 wanita, saat ini menjalani prosedur untuk melakukan tindakan hukum untuk pelanggaran mereka. Kementerian Dalam Negeri telah memperingatkan bahwa setiap orang, yang memfasilitasi entri ilegal individu ke Kerajaan, mengangkut mereka di wilayahnya, menyediakan tempat tinggal atau bantuan lain atau jasa, akan dihukum hingga 15 tahun penjara dan denda hingga SR1 juta, dan kendaraan yang digunakan untuk transportasi atau rumah yang digunakan untuk memberikan perlindungan akan disita. Departemen mendesak publik untuk melaporkan setiap kasus pelanggaran dengan memanggil nomor 911 di daerah Mekah, Riyadh, dan Provinsi Timur dan nomor 999 dan 996 di sisa wilayah Kerajaan.
articles.originalTitle: 11,952 violators of residency, labor and border security laws arrested in a week
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi security forces arrested a total of 11,952 illegal residents in a week. The arrests were made in joint inspections, carried out in cooperation with the relevant government agencies, during the period between November 5 and 11, the Ministry of Interior announced on Saturday. Those who were arrested include 6,163 violators of the Residency Law, 3,225 violators of the Border Security Law, and 2,564 violators of the Labor Law. The total number of people who were arrested while trying to cross the border into the Kingdom accounted for 1,653. About 29 people were arrested while attempting to leave the Kingdom illegally.A total of 11,418 illegal residents were deported while 22,451 violators were referred to their diplomatic missions to obtain travel documents and 9,800 violators were referred to complete their travel reservations. Fifteen persons, who were involved in giving transportation, shelter, and employment for violators, were also arrested. A total of 40,762 expatriates, including 38,383 men and 2,379 women, are currently undergoing procedures to enforce legal measures for their violations. The Ministry of Interior has warned that any person, who facilitates the illegal entry of individuals into the Kingdom, transports them on its territory, provides them with shelter or any other assistance or service, will be penalized with up to 15 years in prison and a fine of up to SR1 million, and that the vehicles used for transportation or houses used for giving shelter will be confiscated. The ministry urged the public to report any cases of violation by calling the number 911 in the regions of Makkah, Riyadh, and the Eastern Province and the numbers 999 and 996 in the rest of the Kingdom’s regions.

articles.title: Hamas meminta perbaikan mendesak ke saluran pembuangan dan sistem pembuangan Gaza
articles.description: Hamas panggilan untuk perbaikan mendesak ke pembuangan limbah Gaza dan sistem drainase Hamas biro politik Kepala Khalil al- Hayya telah menyerukan "tindakan mendesak" untuk memperbaiki saluran pembuangan Gaza dan memperbaiki drainase air hujan setelah hujan lebat menghancurkan puluhan ribu tenda. Al- Hayya disebut untuk "tanpa hambatan" akses untuk kelompok bantuan dan mendorong Israel untuk membiarkan lebih banyak makanan dan bahan bakar ke Gaza. Pembatasan bantuan Israel telah menghambat upaya untuk memperbaiki infrastruktur yang rusak parah di Strip. "Apa yang dialami Gaza bukan lagi krisis kemanusiaan darurat atau konsekuensi alami dari perang, namun kenyataan yang kompleks di mana kebijakan kelaparan, kehancuran sistematis, dan pembatasan pengiriman bantuan yang disengaja terkait", kata al- Hayya.
articles.originalTitle: Hamas calls for urgent repairs to Gaza’s sewage and drainage systems
articles.originalDescription: Hamas calls for urgent repairs to Gaza’s sewage and drainage systems Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya has called for “urgent action” to fix Gaza’s sewers and improve rainwater drainage after heavy rains destroyed tens of thousands of tents. Al-Hayya called for “unhindered” access for aid groups and urged Israel to let more food and fuel into Gaza. Israeli restrictions on aid have hampered efforts to repair the Strip’s badly damaged infrastructure. “What Gaza is experiencing is no longer an emergency humanitarian crisis or a natural consequence of war, but a complex reality in which policies of starvation, systematic destruction, and the deliberate restriction of aid deliveries are intertwined,” al-Hayya said.

articles.originalDescription: Saudi Arabia executes former child protester Jawad Qureiris Submitted by MEE staff on Sat, 11/14/2026 - 16:32 Rights groups condemn secret execution of former child protester as a tool of political oppression under Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman This picture shows a poster depicting King Salman bin Abdulaziz (R), and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (L) in Riyadh on May 12, 2025 (AFP) Off Saudi Arabia executed a man who was detained as a child, alongside another Saudi national from the Kingdom’s Shia-majority Eastern Province. In a statement on Saturday, the Saudi Press Agency confirmed that Riyadh had executed Jawad Qureiris. Hailing from a prominent Shia-majority family in the Kingdom’s Eastern Province, Qureiris was a former child defendant who was just 14 to 15 years old during the 2011-12 Arab Spring protests. Qureiris’ family has a documented history of encounters with state security: one of his brothers was killed by security forces, while another was arrested at age 13 and faced capital charges related to alleged offences committed when he was nine years old. Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Interior also announced that Fadel bin Hassan bin Abdullah Al-Safwani was executed on Saturday. The ministry claimed the men were convicted of “terrorist crimes,” alleging they joined a foreign terrorist organisation, opened fire on security personnel and vehicles with weapons and explosives, possessed live ammunition, and provided logistical and financial support for operations within the Kingdom. According to the SPA statement, the cases passed through specialised criminal courts, where the men’s legal responsibility was established before the verdicts were upheld by the Supreme Court and ratified via a royal decree. Qureiris was arrested in December 2020 and charged with offences related to taking part in protests and organising on social media. articles.title: Universitas Pertahanan Nasional dinamai setelah Raja Salman
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman telah menyetujui pergantian nama dari Universitas Pertahanan Nasional ke Universitas Raja Salman untuk Pertahanan Nasional. Menteri Pertahanan Pangeran Khalid bin Salman menyatakan terima kasih kepada Raja Salman dan untuk Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman dalam hal ini. Dia menekankan bahwa penamaan lembaga setelah Raja Salman mencerminkan perhatian dan perhatian sektor pendidikan menerima dari kepemimpinan dan mendasari komitmennya terhadap perkembangan manusia dan mempersiapkan pemimpin - pilar fundamental untuk menjaga keamanan negara dan memperkuat pencapaiannya. Pangeran Khalid mengatakan bahwa penamaan ini berfungsi sebagai insentif bagi universitas untuk terus mengembangkan sistem pendidikan dan penelitian dan mendukung keputusan-keputusan dalam bidang pertahanan nasional dan keamanan. Ini sejalan dengan tujuan untuk pengembangan Kementerian Pertahanan - peta jalan yang dipetakan oleh Putra Mahkota.
articles.originalTitle: National Defense University named after King Salman
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman has approved the renaming of the National Defense University to King Salman University for National Defense. Minister of Defense Prince Khalid bin Salman expressed his gratitude and appreciation to King Salman and to Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman in this regard. He emphasized that naming the institution after King Salman reflects the care and attention the education sector receives from the leadership and underscores its ongoing commitment to human development and preparing leaders—a fundamental pillar for safeguarding the nation's security and strengthening its achievements. Prince Khalid said that this naming serves as an incentive for the university to continue developing its educational and research systems and supporting decision-making in the fields of national defense and security.This is in line with the objectives for the development of the Ministry of Defense—a roadmap for which was charted by the Crown Prince.

articles.title: Tiga orang Israel muncul sebagai pengganti yang mungkin untuk kepala Nvidia Jensen Huang, media lokal mengatakan

Keberangkatan Huang, diumumkan pada 12 November, berlaku segera. Dewan Nvidia menunjuk kepala petugas keuangan Colette Kress sebagai eksekutif sementara sementara mencari pengganti permanen. Perusahaan mengatakan itu akan mempertimbangkan kedua kandidat internal dan eksternal. Media Israel bernama Michael Kagan, Kepala Teknologi Nvidia, Eyal Waldman, pendiri dan mantan kepala eksekutif Israel perusahaan jaringan Mellanux, dan Johny Srouji, Kepala perangkat keras Apple, sebagai pesaing. Kagan mendirikan Mellanox pada tahun 1999 dan bergabung dengan Nvidia setelah mendapatkan perusahaan pada tahun 2020 selama sekitar $6.9bn. apa? Sejak itu dia menjabat sebagai Kepala Teknologi Nvidia, fokus pada teknologi yang memungkinkan ribuan prosesor berkomunikasi dalam pusat data yang besar. Waldman juga mendirikan Mellanex dan menjabat sebagai kepala eksekutif sebelum akuisisi. Tidak seperti Kagan, dia bukan lagi bagian dari manajemen Nvidia. Ynet juga melaporkan bahwa dia dalam diskusi suksesi. Srouji, kepala petugas perangkat keras Apple, adalah salah satu tokoh kunci di belakang pengembangan chip dalam perusahaan. Dia bergabung dengan Apple pada tahun 2008 dan memimpin pengembangan prosesor yang digunakan dalam produknya, termasuk mereka yang mendasari transisi dari processor Intel ke Apple Silicon.
