articles.title: Pro- Palestina kelompok berusaha melarang pada real estate Israel adil di Paris
articles.description: Grup Pro- Palestina berusaha melarang pameran real estate Israel di Paris Pro- Palestina aktivis telah meminta pengadilan Perancis untuk melarang pameran real estate Israel di Paris pemasaran pemukiman Israel di West Bank dan East Jerusalem, AFP melaporkan pada Kamis. Asosiasi NIDAL Franco- Palestina mengajukan mosi darurat dengan pengadilan melawan real estate ke-9 Icube dan salon investasi, menyatakan bahwa adil melanggar hak asasi manusia. Acara ini dijadwalkan hari Minggu di Eropa Pusat untuk Yudaisme di ibukota Perancis. Kota-kota besar lainnya telah melihat kegemparan serupa atas pameran real estate Israel. NIDAL meminta pengadilan untuk baik memesan kepala kepolisian Paris untuk melarang acara langsung atau untuk memastikan bahwa acara tidak menjual properti di West Bank dan Yerusalem Timur, yang pekerjaannya oleh Israel sejak 1967 dianggap ilegal di bawah hukum internasional. Sebelum mengambil tindakan hukum, kelompok mengatakan mereka telah mengirim surat kepada polisi Paris pada 5 November, yang tidak terjawab. Dalam pengajuan ini, terlihat oleh AFP, kelompok hak-hak mengatakan bahwa pemasaran pemukiman Israel di wilayah yang diduduki berkontribusi terhadap pemindahan paksa rakyat Palestina melalui transfer populasi - praktek yang dilarang oleh hukum internasional dan diklasifikasikan sebagai kejahatan perang di bawah kode pidana Perancis. Secara khusus, para aktivis menyoroti bahwa BH Nadlan, sebuah perusahaan yang menetap di Yerusalem Timur dan Tepi Barat, akan hadir di pameran. Mereka juga menunjukkan tawaran resmi sang pemandu dari bonus "keuangan" yang signifikan untuk pendatang baru yang menetap di "Yudea dan Samaria", istilah Israel untuk West Bank yang ditempati.
articles.originalTitle: Pro-Palestinian group seeks ban on Israeli real estate fair in Paris
articles.originalDescription: Pro-Palestinian group seeks ban on Israeli real estate fair in Paris Pro-Palestinian activists have asked a French court to ban an Israeli real estate fair in Paris marketing Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem, AFP reported on Thursday. The Franco-Palestinian NIDAL association filed an emergency motion with a court against the 9th Icube real estate and investment salon, arguing that the fair violates human rights. The event is scheduled for Sunday at the European Centre for Judaism in the French capital. Other major cities have seen similar uproars over Israeli real estate fairs. NIDAL asked the court to either order the head of the Paris police force to ban the event outright or to ensure that the event does not sell property in the West Bank and East Jerusalem, whose occupation by Israel since 1967 is considered illegal under international law. Before taking legal action, the group said they had sent a letter to the Paris police on 5 November, which went unanswered. In the filing, seen by AFP, the rights group says that marketing Israeli settlements in the occupied territories contributes to the forced displacement of the Palestinian people through population transfer - a practice prohibited by international law and classified as a war crime under the French penal code. In particular, the activists highlighted that BH Nadlan, a company that markets settlements in both East Jerusalem and the West Bank on its website, will be present at the fair. They also pointed to the fair's official guide's offer of a "significant" financial "bonus" for newcomers settling in "Judea and Samaria", the Israeli term for the occupied West Bank.

articles.originalTitle: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians
articles.originalDescription: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians Israeli settlers stormed Atara, a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank and injured five people on Thursday, a rights group said. The attacks came after the Israeli military took down two outposts built by settlers without permission in the West Bank. More than 500,000 Israelis live in settlements across the West Bank, all of which are deemed illegal under international law, and some of which, known as outposts, are built without the Israeli government's involvement. "After Israeli military forces left the area, dozens of settlers, armed with clubs, tear gas and stones, stormed the village of Atara," the Israeli rights group Yesh Din said in a statement. "Five residents were injured and hospitalised, one in serious condition with a brain haemorrhage," Yesh Din added. The Palestinian Red Crescent said one of the injured people was 67 years old.

articles.title: Saudi- AS ikatan bisnis mendapatkan momentum dengan perjanjian kerjasama landmark
articles.description: WASHINGTON - Dewan Bisnis AS-Saudi dan Federasi Saudi Chambers telah menandatangani memorandum pemahaman (MoU) untuk memperkuat hubungan antara komunitas bisnis Arab Saudi dan Amerika Serikat. Perjanjian itu ditandatangani oleh Dewan Ketua dan CEO Charles Hallab dan Sekretaris Federasi Jenderal Sultan Al- Musallam. Upacara penandatanganan ini dihadiri oleh Asisten Sekretaris Jenderal untuk Perdagangan Internasional di Federasi Saudi Chambers Majid Al- Mutairi dan Presiden sektor Timur Tengah di Mayer Brown Company Tom Thraya di Washington, D.C. MoU membangun kerangka kerja untuk meningkatkan komunikasi antara perusahaan di dua negara, mengembangkan peluang investasi, dan mengatasi tantangan yang dihadapi bisnis di kedua pasar. Federasi dari Saudi Chambers sedang memainkan peran kunci dalam kemitraan sebagai badan perwakilan sektor swasta Saudi, memastikan bahwa perspektif sektor dan kebutuhan harus dipertimbangkan. Memorandum menetapkan mekanisme praktis untuk kerjasama antara dewan dan federasi, termasuk memfasilitasi kunjungan delegasi perdagangan dan komunikasi antara para pemimpin bisnis, mendukung investasi dan kemitraan strategis, bertukar informasi pasar dan keahlian, dan bekerja melalui saluran yang relevan untuk memfasilitasi perusahaan masuk ke kedua pasar dan mengatasi hambatan yang mereka hadapi. Sebuah kelompok pekerja gabungan akan mengawasi implementasi memorandum dan mengembangkan rencana aksi gabungan. Wakil senior dari kedua belah pihak akan bertemu setiap tiga bulan untuk menilai kemajuan, sektor prioritas dan kegiatan, mengatur jadwal, dan menetapkan tanggung jawab. Berbicara pada kesempatan itu, Hallab mengatakan bahwa Federasi dari Saudi Chambers adalah mitra kunci untuk dewan yang berhubungan dengan dan mendukung sektor swasta Saudi. "Kesepakatan ini memungkinkan Dewan dan Federasi untuk membawa perusahaan bersama-sama, bekerja terhadap tujuan yang sama, dan memperkuat hubungan perdagangan antara kedua negara kita. The Federation of Saudi Chambers is playing a key role in the partnership as the representative body of the Saudi private sector, ensuring that the sector’s perspectives and needs are duly considered. Senior representatives from both sides will meet every three months to assess progress, identify priority sectors and activities, set timelines, and assign responsibilities. articles.description: X menangguhkan rekening kampanye warga Palestina yang sedang berjalan untuk Senat AS, dikeluarkan oleh staf MEE pada Thu, 11 / 12 / 2026 - 18 Gaza- lahir dan Philepphia berbasis Ahmed Moor, meluncurkan tantangannya terhadap prof-Israel John Fetterman minggu ini Ahmed Moor, yang mencalonkan diri untuk kursi Pennsylvania di Senat AS pada tahun 2028, digambarkan dalam foto yang belum tertanggal dari situs kampanyenya (MoorForSente.com) Dari Amerika Palestina yang meluncurkan tawaran untuk kursi senat untuk mewakili Pennsylvania dalam pemilihan tahun 2028 telah membuat akun kampanyenya ditangguhkan oleh media sosial X. Akun tersebut, @ moorforpa, milik Gaza-born, Philepphia- mengangkat Ahmed Moor, yang mengatakan minggu ini ia ingin menggulingkan pro- garis keras Israel Senator John Fetterman ketika dia untuk kembali pemilihan dalam dua tahun. Fetterman belum mengumumkan apakah dia berencana untuk lari lagi. "Teman! Ini resmi! Kami adalah ancaman," Moor menulis di akun X pribadinya pada hari Rabu. "Mereka telah menghentikan rekening kampanye. Bantu kami mempertahankan momentum dengan me-retweet dan pertimbangkan mendonasikan". Akun kampanye memiliki lebih dari 33.000 pengikut dalam 72 jam peluncuran. Mata Timur Tengah telah menghubungi kampanye Moor. X tidak lagi mempertahankan akun email aktif untuk pertanyaan pers. 'Agenda martabat' Banyak dengan cara yang sama progressives berlari kampanye mereka di seluruh negeri dan berhasil membawa distrik mereka dalam pemilu paruh baya pada 3 November, menyebabkan terobosan bersejarah, slogan kampanye Moor adalah "Stop Funding Wars". Mulai Funding Pennsylvania "." Saya berlari untuk mengakhiri perang di Iran dan untuk mempromosikan agenda martabat: layanan kesehatan gratis, layanan anak gratis, dan perumahan terjangkau ", menulis di X pada hari Senin, ketika ia mengumumkan dijalankan. Senator AS Fetterman berjuang untuk mempertahankan dukungan bagi Israel sebagai progresif memenangkan Baca Lebih besar" "" Aku menyerukan untuk aku

articles.originalDescription: X suspends campaign account of Palestinian American running for US Senate Submitted by MEE staff on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 18:00 Gaza-born and Philadelphia-based Ahmed Moor launched his challenge against hardline pro-Israel Senator John Fetterman this week Ahmed Moor, who is running for a Pennsylvania seat in the US Senate in 2028, is pictured in a undated photo from his campaign website (MoorForSenate.com) Off A Palestinian American who launched his bid for a Senate seat to represent Pennsylvania in the 2028 election has had his campaign account suspended by the social media platform X. Help us maintain the momentum by retweeting and please consider donating." The campaign account had over 33,000 followers within some 72 hours of its launch. Middle East Eye has reached out to Moor's campaign. X no longer maintains an active email account for press inquiries. articles.title: Pemimpin Demokrat Amerika Serikat Hakeem Jeffries ingin 'perubahan dramatis' di Timur Tengah
articles.description: Pemimpin Demokrat Amerika Serikat Hakeem Jeffries ingin 'perubahan dramatis' di Rumah Perwakilan Demokrat Timur Tengah AS pemimpin DPR Hakeem Jeffries menyerukan Kamis untuk "perubahan dramatis" di Timur Tengah dan kembali dukungannya untuk dua-negara solusi untuk Israel dan Palestina. Partai Demokrat menyapu kemenangan dalam pemilihan paruh waktu minggu lalu bisa menyebabkan pembengkokan dukungan AS untuk sekutu dekatnya Israel, menempatkan sorotan pada pandangan para pemimpin partai karena mereka bersiap untuk mengambil alih kedua rumah Kongres pada 3 Januari. Jeffries, seorang Demokrat New York, diharapkan menjadi pembicara House berikutnya. "Status quo tidak dapat diterima, dan kita perlu perubahan dramatis. Dan itu terlihat seperti, sejauh yang saya ketahui, memastikan Anda memiliki Israel yang aman dan aman, hidup berdampingan sebagai Yahudi dan negara demokratis dengan negara Palestina independen yang menyediakan martabat dan tekad sendiri untuk Palestina", katanya pada konferensi pers mingguan.
articles.originalTitle: US House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries wants 'dramatic change' in Middle East
articles.originalDescription: US House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries wants 'dramatic change' in Middle East US House of Representatives Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called on Thursday for "dramatic change" in the Middle East and reiterated his support for a two-state solution for Israelis and the Palestinians. The Democrats' sweeping victories in last week's midterm elections could lead to the curbing of US support for its close ally Israel, putting the spotlight on party leaders' views as they prepare to take control of both houses of Congress on 3 January. Jeffries, a New York Democrat, is expected to be the next House speaker. "The status quo is unacceptable, and we need dramatic change. And that looks like, as far as I'm concerned, making sure you have a safe and secure Israel, living side by side as a Jewish and democratic state with an independent Palestinian state that provides dignity and self-determination for the Palestinians," he said at a weekly press conference.

articles.originalDescription: Dutch foreign minister declines to deny talks are under way on curbing ICC powers Submitted by Sondos Asem on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 14:07 MPs asked minister if Netherlands, the host of the ICC, is discussing restrictions that could shield Israeli and US officials from prosecution The Netherlands' Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen at the Nato foreign ministers' meeting in Helsingborg, Sweden on 22 May 2026 (Jonathan Nackstrand/AFP) Off Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen has declined to rule out the suggestion that discussions are taking place over sweeping restrictions on the International Criminal Court (ICC), following a report that the Netherlands is negotiating with Washington over changes that could severely undermine the court's powers. Questioned in parliament on Wednesday, Berendsen said diplomatic discussions were taking place but he would not specify whether proposals to shield heads of state and restrict the court's jurisdiction over nationals of non-member states were under consideration. The exchange followed a report by Dutch rights organisation The Rights Forum , citing anonymous diplomatic sources in New York, that the Netherlands was "negotiating" with the US changes to the court's founding treaty in response to US sanctions on the court and its top officials. Middle East Eye has previously reported similar US demands. In December 2025, MEE exclusively revealed that Washington had pressed for an end to the Palestine and Afghanistan investigations and treaty changes preventing prosecutions of nationals of non-member countries, in return for lifting sanctions. articles.title: Arab Saudi, Kenya menandatangani perjanjian untuk mengatur perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri
articles.description: RIYADH - Wakil Menteri Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial untuk Tenaga Kerja Abdullah Abuthanain menerima Sekretaris Kabinet Kenya untuk Buruh dan Perlindungan Sosial Alfred Nganga Mutua di markas pelayanan di Riyadh pada hari Kamis. Beberapa pejabat menteri Saudi senior dan delegasi Kenyan menemani juga menghadiri pertemuan. Pertemuan ini membahas cara untuk memperkuat kerjasama antara Arab Saudi dan Kenya di bidang kepentingan bersama di sektor kerja paksa, terutama dengan mengembangkan mekanisme kerja sama untuk perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri, meningkatkan efektivitas pelatihan keberangkatan dan program kualifikasi, dan meningkatkan kesadaran hak-hak kontrak dan kewajiban. Upaya ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kesiapan para pekerja domestik, meningkatkan kualitas layanan perekrutan, mempromosikan stabilitas dalam hubungan kontrak, dan melindungi hak-hak semua pihak. Kedua pihak juga mendiskusikan mekanisme penguatan koordinasi teknis, pertukaran keahlian dan praktek terbaik dalam pelatihan dan kualifikasi, dan meningkatkan prosedur yang berkaitan dengan perekrutan pekerja domestik. Langkah-langkah ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi proses perekrutan, meningkatkan hasil mereka, dan melayani kepentingan bersama dari kedua negara. Setelah pertemuan tersebut, Abdullah Abuthnain dan Alfred Nganga Mutua menandatangani annex teknis untuk menyetujui perekrutan pekerja domestik antara Arab Saudi dan Kenya, ditandatangani pada 5 Juli 2026. Annex adalah bagian dari upaya untuk memperkuat kerjasama dan mengembangkan mekanisme teknis dan regulasi yang mengatur perekrutan pekerja domestik. Annex teknis bertujuan untuk prosedur tipis dan mengurangi biaya merekrut pekerja domestik dari Kenya ke Arab Saudi. Hal ini juga berusaha untuk meningkatkan efisiensi mekanisme perekrutan, memastikan kepatuhan dengan peraturan yang disetujui, melindungi hak-hak majikan dan pekerja dalam negeri, dan mengatur hubungan kontrak antara dua partai. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, Kenya sign deal to regulate recruitment of domestic workers
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Deputy Minister of Human Resources and Social Development for Labor Abdullah Abuthnain received Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Labour and Social Protection Alfred Nganga Mutua at the ministry’s headquarters in Riyadh on Thursday. Several senior Saudi ministry officials and the accompanying Kenyan delegation also attended the meeting. The meeting discussed ways to strengthen cooperation between Saudi Arabia and Kenya in areas of mutual interest in the labor sector, particularly by developing cooperation mechanisms for the recruitment of domestic workers, improving the effectiveness of pre-departure training and qualification programs, and raising awareness of contractual rights and obligations. These efforts aimed to enhance the readiness of domestic workers, improve the quality of recruitment services, promote stability in contractual relations, and protect the rights of all parties. The two sides also discussed mechanisms for strengthening technical coordination, exchanging expertise and best practices in training and qualification, and improving procedures related to the recruitment of domestic workers. These measures aimed to enhance the efficiency of recruitment processes, improve their outcomes, and serve the mutual interests of both countries. Following the meeting, Abdullah Abuthnain and Alfred Nganga Mutua signed a technical annex to the agreement on the recruitment of domestic workers between Saudi Arabia and Kenya, signed on July 5, 2026. The annex is part of efforts to strengthen cooperation and develop the technical and regulatory mechanisms governing the recruitment of domestic workers. The technical annex aims to streamline procedures and reduce the costs of recruiting domestic workers from Kenya to Saudi Arabia. It also seeks to improve the efficiency of recruitment mechanisms, ensure compliance with approved regulations, protect the rights of employers and domestic workers, and regulate the contractual relationship between the two parties. articles.title: 10 orang Palestina terbunuh sejak fajar
articles.description: 10 orang Palestina tewas sejak fajar Al Jazeera melaporkan bahwa 10 orang telah terbunuh dalam serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza sejak fajar, termasuk dua serangan terhadap rumah sakit yang menewaskan setidaknya tujuh orang. Sebuah serangan mematikan semalam di Nasser Medical Kompleks di Khan Younis membunuh enam orang, termasuk ahli bedah dan pasien, sementara setidaknya satu kematian dilaporkan setelah serangan terpisah dekat pintu masuk ke Rumah Sakit Gaza City al- Shifa. Al Jazeera mengatakan bahwa beberapa korban juga dilaporkan setelah pesawat tak berawak Israel menabrak kendaraan selatan Deir al- Balah di pusat Gaza. Sementara itu, agen berita Wafa melaporkan tiga kematian setelah enam awal serangan Rumah Sakit Nasser. Menurut laporan, Hossam Ali Saleha tewas dalam serangan menargetkan kendaraan di luar pintu masuk ke Rumah Sakit Alfa di Gaza City. Di Deir al- Balah, sebuah pesawat tak berawak Israel menabrak sebuah kendaraan di selatan kota, membunuh 26 tahun Nashat Fouad Awwad. Di Gaza Utara, orang Palestina lainnya terbunuh dan beberapa lainnya terluka akibat kebakaran Israel yang menargetkan sekelompok orang di dekat Jabalia di pemakaman Nazla.
articles.originalTitle: 10 Palestinians killed since dawn
articles.originalDescription: 10 Palestinians killed since dawn Al Jazeera reports that 10 people have been killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza since dawn, including two strikes on hospitals which killed at least seven people. A deadly overnight strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis killed six people, including surgeons and patients, while at least one death was reported after a separate attack near the entrance to Gaza City's al-Shifa Hospital. Al Jazeera said that multiple casualties were also reported after an Israeli drone struck a vehicle south of Deir al-Balah in central Gaza. Meanwhile, Wafa news agency reports three deaths following the initial six in the Nasser Hospital attack. According to the report, Hossam Ali Saleha was killed in a strike targeting a vehicle outside the entrance to al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City. In Deir al-Balah, an Israeli drone struck a vehicle in the city's south, killing 26-year-old Nashat Fouad Awwad. In northern Gaza, another Palestinian was killed and several others wounded by Israeli fire targeting a group of people near Jabalia al-Nazla Cemetery.

An investigation by the Military Police Criminal Investigation Division was launched following complaints from other soldiers. Investigators suspect the soldier beat the Palestinian and extinguished a cigarette on his body, leaving him injured. The alleged abuse did not end there. According to the investigation, the soldier urinated on the detainee before smearing his own faeces on the man's face and urging him to eat it. Three soldiers were initially questioned, but two were later released, leaving one suspect in custody, Channel 12 reported. articles.title: Sekolah Saudi memulai liburan musim gugur 10 hari di Nov 20
articles.description: RIYADH - Siswa di sekolah-sekolah umum di seluruh Arab Saudi sangat bersemangat mengantisipasi liburan 10 hari mendatang di 1448 AH kalender akademik, terdiri dari liburan musim gugur dan tambahan satu hari libur. Menurut kalender akademik, liburan akan dimulai pada hari Jumat, 20 November 2026, dan berlanjut sampai Minggu, November 29. Istirahat musim gugur akan berjalan dari Nov 20-28, diikuti oleh hari libur tambahan pada Nov 29. Siswa dijadwalkan untuk kembali ke kelas pada hari Senin, Nov 30, 2026, setelah 10 hari istirahat, dan melanjutkan kegiatan akademik mereka selama sisa semester.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi schools to begin 10-day autumn holiday on Nov. 20
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Students in public schools across Saudi Arabia are eagerly anticipating an upcoming 10-day holiday in the 1448 AH academic calendar, comprising the autumn break and an additional one-day holiday. According to the academic calendar, the holiday will begin on Friday, November 20, 2026, and continue through Sunday, Nov. 29. The autumn break will run from Nov. 20 to 28, followed by an additional day off on Nov. 29. Students are scheduled to return to classrooms on Monday, Nov. 30, 2026, following the 10-day break, and resume their academic activities for the remainder of the semester.

Production will initially take place in Tilburg before moving to a larger site in Overijssel, according to Dutch broadcaster Omroep Brabant . articles.title: Warga Saudi ditangkap karena mengangkut 5 pelanggar di Jazan
articles.description: JAZAN - patroli keamanan dari Resimen Keamanan di Al- Aridah pemerintahan di daerah Jazan selatan menangkap seorang warga karena mengangkut lima individu yang melanggar Hukum Keamanan Perbatasan dalam kendaraan yang dia kendarai. Prosedur hukum dimulai terhadap semua orang yang ditangkap, dengan pelanggar yang disebut otoritas yang kompeten dan transporter ke Jaksa Umum. Badan Keamanan Dalam Negeri menyatakan kembali bahwa memfasilitasi pelanggar keamanan perbatasan ke Arab Saudi, mengangkut atau melindungi mereka, atau menyediakan mereka dengan segala bentuk bantuan membawa hukuman hingga 15 tahun penjara dan denda sampai dengan SR1 juta. Hukuman juga termasuk penyitaan kendaraan yang digunakan untuk transportasi dan penamaan publik. Agensi menekankan bahwa kejahatan dianggap sebagai pelanggaran besar. Hal ini mendorong publik untuk melaporkan pelanggaran residensi, tenaga kerja, dan peraturan keamanan perbatasan dengan memanggil 911 di daerah Mekah, Madinah, Riyadh, dan Provinsi Timur, atau 999 dan 996 di semua daerah lain. Semua laporan akan diperlakukan dengan kerahasiaan ketat, dan mereka yang melaporkan pelanggaran tidak akan menanggung kewajiban, lembaga ditambahkan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi citizen arrested for transporting 5 violators in Jazan
articles.originalDescription: JAZAN — Security patrols from the Security Regiments in Al-Aridah governorate in the southern Jazan region arrested a citizen for transporting five individuals who violated the Border Security Law in a vehicle he was driving. Legal procedures were initiated against all the arrested persons, with the violators referred to the competent authority and the transporter to the Public Prosecution. The Ministry of Interior's Agency for Security Regiments Affairs reiterated that facilitating the entry of border security violators into Saudi Arabia, transporting or sheltering them, or providing them with any form of assistance carries penalties of up to 15 years in prison and a fine of up to SR1 million. Penalties also include confiscation of the vehicle used for transportation and public naming. The agency emphasized that the crime is considered as a major offense. It urged the public to report violations of residency, labor, and border security regulations by calling 911 in the regions of Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh, and Eastern Province, or 999 and 996 in all other regions. All reports will be treated with strict confidentiality, and those who report violations will bear no liability, the agency added.

articles.description: Israel menyerang Al- Shifa Hospital membunuh satu setelah enam tewas dalam serangan Nasser sebuah serangan Israel menargetkan Rumah Sakit Gaza-Shifa kota telah membunuh setidaknya satu Palestina dekat gerbang fasilitas, laporan Wafa. Serangan itu datang tak lama setelah sebuah rudal Israel menghancurkan rumah sakit South Gaza, membunuh enam orang, termasuk ahli bedah dan pasien. Wafa juga melaporkan, mengutip sumber-sumber lokal, bahwa pesawat Israel menyerang sekelompok orang Palestina di selatan Khan Younis, sementara yang lain dipecat menuju perahu nelayan di lepas pantai Gaza City juga kamp pengungsi Shati. articles.originalTitle: Israeli strike on al-Shifa Hospital kills one after six killed in Nasser attack
articles.originalDescription: Israeli strike on al-Shifa Hospital kills one after six killed in Nasser attack An Israeli strike targeting Gaza City's al-Shifa Hospital has killed at least one Palestinian near the facility's gate, Wafa reports. The attack comes shortly after an Israeli missile tore through southern Gaza's Nasser Hospital, killing six people, including surgeons and patients. Wafa also reports, citing local sources, that an Israeli drone struck a group of Palestinians in south Khan Younis, while another was fired towards fishing boats off the coast of Gaza City's al-Shati refugee camp. According to the report, medical sources say that a total of nine Palestinians have been killed by Israeli fire since dawn.

articles.originalTitle: Hajj Conference draws over 200,000 visitors, seals 2,553 agreements
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — The sixth Hajj Conference and Exhibition concluded at Jeddah Superdome on Wednesday after four days of activities, bringing together more than 520 entities from the government, private, and nonprofit sectors, with participation from more than 150 countries. The event, held under the patronage of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman, was organized by the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah in cooperation with the Pilgrim Experience Program, one of the Saudi Vision 2030 programs at the Jeddah Superdome. The conference and exhibition, under the theme “From Makkah to the World,” attracted more than 200,000 visitors and saw the signing of 2,553 agreements. **media[2793647]** The conference marked a key milestone in early preparations for the 2027 Hajj season. It brought together Hajj affairs offices, service providers, government, private and nonprofit entities, decision-makers, entrepreneurs, and innovators to complete preparations and contracts, discuss operational and organizational needs, and present solutions and initiatives covering the various stages of the pilgrim journey. The conference’s scientific program featured 45 panel discussions with more than 460 speakers, alongside 71 specialized workshops attended by 3,500 trainees. The sessions and workshops covered three main areas: infrastructure and operational services; empowerment and synergy; and training and development. Related topics included transportation, logistics, accommodation, hospitality, catering, healthcare, media and communications, technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, training, and ways to enrich the pilgrim experience. **media[2793646]** The Hajj Talk was one of the conference’s dialogue platforms, hosting 47 sessions on operational and development issues related to the Hajj services system. articles.originalDescription: More than 50 British MPs demand fresh sanctions on Israel over Gaza aid obstruction Submitted by Imran Mulla on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 12:01 As storms batter Gaza, 150,000 tents in aid lorries remain stuck outside the Palestinian enclave Humanitarian aid trucks at the Rafah border crossing with the Gaza Strip on 4 February 2026 (AFP) Off More than 50 British MPs are supporting a parliamentary motion calling on their government to take "urgent action" on getting aid into Gaza and demanding fresh sanctions on Israel . The motion, which was tabled on Tuesday night by Labour MP Richard Burgon, notes "UN reports that tens of thousands of already displaced families have suffered damage to their shelters" in Gaza . It says this has "been made far worse by Israel's widespread destruction of homes, drainage systems and other essential infrastructure that have left most Palestinians in Gaza displaced". The motion further condemns "Israel's ongoing restrictions on the entry of humanitarian aid, including materials needed to provide shelter, respond to flooding, and aid reconstruction", as well as its "restrictions on bringing humanitarian supplies and international staff into Gaza". Some 65 percent of Gaza’s population, about 1.4 million people, live in tents or makeshift shelters, according to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha). In the last week, torrential rainfall and deadly storms have flooded or destroyed tens of thousands of these tents. Israel continues to bar aid groups from bringing supplies and international staff into the territory. The Norwegian Refugee Council reported last month that Israeli authorities were allowing just 15 trucks carrying dual-use items into Gaza from Jordan once a week. Ramiz Alakbarov, the UN’s humanitarian coordinator for the occupied Palestinian territory, said this week that 150,000 tents in aid lorries were stuck outside Gaza, while stocks of essential shelter and winter items inside the enclave were exhausted. articles.description: Kami kehilangan pasien saya telah merawat ': Perawat Nasser berbicara tentang serangan' menakutkan 'Seorang perawat yang bekerja shift malam di departemen bedah Nasser Hospital ketika ditargetkan oleh serangan udara Israel telah mengatakan bahwa sejumlah pasien mereka merawat tewas dalam serangan itu. Dalam kesaksian yang dibagikan oleh LSM Medical Aid untuk Palestina (MAP), Muhammad Salman menggambarkan serangan terhadap rumah sakit, yang merupakan yang terbesar di Gaza Selatan, sebagai "mengerikan". "Saya melihat pasien terjebak di bawah reruntuhan dan rekan-rekan terluka. Kami kehilangan beberapa pasien saya telah merawat, termasuk setidaknya dua," katanya. "Ketakutan terbesar kami adalah untuk pasien. Kami segera mulai mencoba mengevakuasi mereka dan mendapatkan mereka untuk keselamatan, bekerja bersama tim Pertahanan Sipil dan memindahkan mereka kita bisa menyelamatkan ke departemen lain." Salman mengatakan seorang rekan, dokter bedah Dr Rizq Abu Shaeria, tewas saat dia memeriksa pasien. "Beberapa menit kemudian, semuanya berubah, dan kami kehilangan dia. Sangat menyakitkan kehilangan rekan yang hanya melakukan pekerjaannya dan mendedikasikan dirinya untuk merawat pasien", katanya. articles.originalTitle: 'We lost patients I had been caring for': Nasser nurse speaks of 'terrifying' attack
articles.originalDescription: 'We lost patients I had been caring for': Nasser nurse speaks of 'terrifying' attack A nurse who was working a night shift at Nasser Hospital's surgical department when it was targeted by an Israeli air strike has said that a number of patients they were caring for were killed in the attack. In testimony shared by the NGO Medical Aid for Palestine (MAP), Mohammed Salman described the attack on the hospital, which is the largest in southern Gaza, as "terrifying". "I saw patients trapped under the rubble and colleagues injured. We lost some of the patients I had been caring for, including at least two," he said. "Our greatest fear was for the patients. We immediately started trying to evacuate them and get them to safety, working alongside Civil Defence teams and moving those we could rescue to another department." Salman said a colleague, surgeon Dr Rizq Abu Shaeria, was killed as he was checking on a patient. "A few minutes later, everything changed, and we lost him. It is incredibly painful to lose a colleague who was simply doing his job and dedicating himself to caring for patients," he said. In a statement, the Palestinian Ministry of Health reported that two missiles struck the upper floors of the hospital's Yassin building, which houses the surgical department, at around 00:39 local time, killing six – including surgeons, patients and a child. It added that one of the missiles failed to detonate and remains inside the building, posing an additional threat to patients and medical staff still there. Nasser Hospital is one of the few still able to provide care. According to the UN's OCHA, just 20 of the Strip's 37 hospitals remain partially functional and none are fully functional. The latest assault is the seventh time Israeli forces have targeted Nasser Hospital, according to MAP. articles.title: Arab Saudi menunda 10 Inisiatif Investasi Masa Depan hingga Oktober 2027
articles.description: RIYADH - Edisi ke-10 Inisiatif Investasi Masa Depan (FII10) telah dijadwalkan ulang hingga 25 Oktober 2027, di Riyadh, dari tanggal aslinya dari 26- 29 Oktober 2026, FII Institute diumumkan pada hari Kamis. Diadakan di bawah perlindungan dari Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman bin Abdullah, acara ini akan berlangsung di bawah tema "The Power of Legacy", menandai dekade dialog investasi global, kemitraan dan dampak sambil melihat ke depan sampai dekade berikutnya. * * Media [2793600] * FII Institut CEO Dr Maha bint Mishari menggambarkan edisi ke-10 sebagai tonggak makna global, menandai satu dekade untuk mengumpulkan para pemimpin dunia, investor dan pembuat-keputusan. Dia mengatakan keputusan untuk menunda acara sampai Oktober 2027 mencerminkan komitmen lembaga untuk memastikan tingkat tertinggi partisipasi internasional, kehadiran dan dampak. Lembaga ini akan melanjutkan keterlibatan global di depan FII10 melalui Konferensi PRIORITY FII di Miami, dijadwalkan untuk Maret 31- April 2, 2027, dan FII PRIORITY Asia 2027 Summit, yang tanggal dan lokasinya akan diumumkan nanti.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia postpones 10th Future Investment Initiative to October 2027
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The 10th edition of the Future Investment Initiative (FII10) has been rescheduled to October 25–28, 2027, in Riyadh, from its original dates of October 26–29, 2026, the FII Institute announced on Thursday. Held under the patronage of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz, the event will take place under the theme “The Power of Legacy,” marking a decade of global investment dialogue, partnerships and impact while looking ahead to the next decade. **media[2793600]** FII Institute CEO Princess Dr. Maha bint Mishari described the 10th edition as a milestone of global significance, marking a decade of bringing together world leaders, investors and decision-makers. She said the decision to postpone the event until October 2027 reflects the institute’s commitment to ensuring the highest levels of international participation, attendance and impact. The institute will continue its global engagement ahead of FII10 through the FII PRIORITY Summit in Miami, scheduled for March 31–April 2, 2027, and the FII PRIORITY Asia 2027 Summit, whose date and location will be announced later.

articles.originalDescription: UK mosque defiant after charity watchdog reprimand for sermon condemning 'Zionists' over Gaza Submitted by Imran Mulla on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 10:31 'Solidarity with the oppressed must not become grounds for charitable sanction', the Lewisham Islamic Centre said in response The Lewisham Islamic Centre pictured in south-east London (Screengrab) Off A mosque has been given an official warning by Britain 's charity regulator after its imam discussed Palestinian "suffering at the hands of the oppressors and the Zionists" in a sermon. The Lewisham Islamic Centre in south-east London said it was seeking legal advice "on the most appropriate course of action" after the Charity Commission issued it a warning for hosting what it called "inflammatory, divisive" sermons. Imam Shakeel Begg gave a sermon in October 2023, during Israel's bombardment of Gaza, describing Palestinian "suffering at the hands of the oppressors and the Zionists". He also called the celebrities Justin Bieber and Kylie Jenner "sick" for their vocal support of Israel. The Islamic centre said in an official statement this week: "This is about more than one mosque or one charity. "It is about whether Muslim institutions can discharge their religious and charitable responsibilities without being penalised for expressing solidarity with Palestine, conducting established forms of Islamic worship, or addressing issues of concern to their congregations, including repudiation of Zionism, or denunciation of the Israeli state for war crimes and genocide." The centre added: "Solidarity with the oppressed must not become grounds for charitable sanction. "Should legal action be pursued, we would urge others to come forward and join a united challenge to an overbearing commission in defence of religious freedom." articles.description: Cop31: Turki menandatangani kontrak pinjaman $5.1bn untuk meningkatkan transisi hijau Diberikan oleh Ragip Soylu pada Thu, 11 / 12 / 2026 - 10: 23 Berurusan dengan empat bank pengembangan multilateral akan mendukung aksi iklim, ketahanan infrastruktur dan usaha-usaha kecil Konferensi iklim PBB, Cop31, berlangsung di Antalya, Turki (Ozan Kose / AFP) Off Turki menandatangani 10 perjanjian pinjaman senilai $5.1bn dengan bank pengembangan multilateral pada hari Kamis untuk mempercepat transisi hijaunya. Berbicara di upacara penandatanganan pada sela-sela konferensi iklim PBB Cop31 di Antalya, Departemen Keuangan dan Menteri Keuangan Mehmet Simsek mengatakan tidak ada negara yang bisa membiayai transisi hijau saja. "Tidak ada anggaran negara dapat memenuhi kebutuhan investasi transformasi ini sendiri", katanya. "Itulah mengapa dukungan dari bank pengembangan multilateral sangat penting bagi kami". Perjanjian itu ditandatangani antara pelayanan dan Development Bank Asia (ADB), Bank Investasi Infrastruktur Asia (AIB), Bank Dunia dan Bank Pengembangan Islam (IDB). Simsek mengatakan Ankara telah melakukan pekerjaan rumah dengan benar-benar mempersiapkan proyek dan mengamankan pembiayaan yang diperlukan untuk mengimplementasikan mereka. Proyek-proyek, katanya, akan menciptakan lapangan kerja dan memperkuat perekonomian Turki. Dia menambahkan bahwa Turki telah dijamin sekitar $50bn dalam pembiayaan eksternal dari mitra pengembangan sejak 2023. Turki menandatangani perjanjian pinjaman pertamanya dengan ADB pada bulan November 2025, kata Simsek. articles.originalTitle: Cop31: Turkey signs $5.1bn loan deals to boost green transition
articles.originalDescription: Cop31: Turkey signs $5.1bn loan deals to boost green transition Submitted by Ragip Soylu on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 10:23 Deals with four multilateral development banks will support climate action, infrastructure resilience and small businesses The UN climate conference, Cop31, is taking place in Antalya, Turkey (Ozan Kose/AFP) Off Turkey signed 10 loan agreements worth $5.1bn with multilateral development banks on Thursday to accelerate its green transition. Speaking at the signing ceremony on the sidelines of the UN climate conference Cop31 in Antalya, Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek said no country could finance the green transition alone. "No country's budget can meet the investment needs of this transformation on its own," he said. "That is why support from multilateral development banks is critically important to us." The agreements were signed between the ministry and the Asian Development Bank (ADB), the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), the World Bank and the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB). Simsek said Ankara had done its homework by thoroughly preparing projects and securing the financing needed to implement them. The projects, he said, would create jobs and strengthen the Turkish economy. He added that Turkey had secured approximately $50bn in external financing from its development partners since 2023. Turkey signed its first loan agreement with the ADB in November 2025, Simsek said. articles.title: 160 kontestan untuk bergabung dengan Arab Saudi Al-Qur 'an dan kompetisi Sunnah di Mauritania
articles.description: RIYADH - Edisi kedua Custodian dari Kompetisi Dua Masjid Suci untuk Memanisasi Al-Qur 'an dan Nabi Sunnah untuk Negara Afrika Barat akan berlangsung di Nouakchott, Mauritania, dari 15 November sampai 19, 2026, membawa bersama 160 kontestan dari 16 negara. Diadakan dengan persetujuan dari Penjaga dari Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman, kompetisi diatur oleh Saudi Arab Kementerian Urusan Islam, Dawah dan Bimbingan dalam kerjasama dengan Kementerian Urusan Islam Mauritania dan Pendidikan Asli. Menteri Urusan Islam, Dawah dan Bimbingan Sheikh Dr Abdullatif bin Abdullah Al Al- Sheikh menekankan bahwa melayani Al-Qur' an dan Sunnah telah menjadi prioritas misi Islam Saudi Arab sejak mendirikan. Dia mencatat bahwa Kerajaan terus mendukung kompetisi Qur 'anic, program pendidikan dan inisiatif jangkauan Islam baik domestik maupun internasional, memperkuat hubungan umat Islam dengan Al-Qur' an dan Sunnah sementara mempromosikan moderasi dan keseimbangan. Menteri menekankan bahwa inisiatif ini memperpanjang melampaui menghafal, bertujuan untuk memperkuat kesadaran agama, memelihara Muslim pada dasar-dasar yang sehat dan benar agama keyakinan, dan mendorong generasi muda untuk merangkul dan menerapkan ajaran Al Qur 'an dan Sunnah. Al Al- Sheikh mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota Mohammed bin Salman atas dukungan mereka dari inisiatif didedikasikan untuk melestarikan, mengajar dan menyebarkan Al Qur' an dan Sunnah di seluruh dunia. Dia juga mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Kementerian Urusan Islam Mauritania dan Pendidikan Asli atas kerjasama dan usaha yang berkontribusi untuk keberhasilan edisi pertama kompetisi, serta koordinasi lanjutan dalam hosting kedua. Menteri memuji hubungan lama antara Arab Saudi dan Mauritania dan mereka terus kerjasama dalam pendidikan Islam dan jangkauan agama, menyoroti komitmen mereka bersama untuk melestarikan dan mempromosikan Al-Qur 'an dan Sunnah antara generasi muda.
articles.originalTitle: 160 contestants to join Saudi Qur’an and Sunnah competition in Mauritania
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The second edition of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Competition for Memorization of the Holy Qur’an and the Prophet’s Sunnah for West African Countries will take place in Nouakchott, Mauritania, from November 15 to 19, 2026, bringing together 160 contestants from 16 countries. Held with the approval of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman, the competition is organized by Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance in cooperation with Mauritania’s Ministry of Islamic Affairs and Original Education. Minister of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance Sheikh Dr. Abdullatif bin Abdulaziz Al Al-Sheikh emphasized that serving the Qur’an and Sunnah has been a priority of Saudi Arabia’s Islamic mission since its founding. He noted that the Kingdom continues to support Qur’anic competitions, educational programs and Islamic outreach initiatives both domestically and internationally, strengthening Muslims’ connection to the Qur’an and Sunnah while promoting moderation and balance. The minister stressed that these initiatives extend beyond memorization, aiming to strengthen religious awareness, nurture Muslims on sound scholarly foundations and correct religious beliefs, and encourage younger generations to embrace and apply the teachings of the Qur’an and Sunnah. Al Al-Sheikh expressed his gratitude to King Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman for their continued support of initiatives dedicated to preserving, teaching and spreading the Qur’an and Sunnah worldwide. He also thanked Mauritania’s Ministry of Islamic Affairs and Original Education for its cooperation and efforts that contributed to the success of the competition’s first edition, as well as its continued coordination in hosting the second. Kelompok ini menyediakan tenda kubah. Tapi Hala Sabbah, yang bekerja dengan organisasi, mengatakan bahwa cerita itu jatuh di telinga tuli. "Saya benar-benar frustrasi karena itu tidak dibicarakan", kata Sabbah MEE. articles.originalTitle: In the West, Jewish voices are embracing anti-Zionism. Palestinians must seize this moment
articles.originalDescription: In the West, Jewish voices are embracing anti-Zionism. Palestinians must seize this moment Submitted by Awad Abdelfattah on Mon, 11/09/2026 - 15:53 With Israel's top global sponsor in decline, dramatic shifts in public opinion are taking place across the western world Demonstrators wave a Palestinian flag during a nationwide day of strikes and protests in Milan, northern Italy, on 30 October 2026 (Piero Cruciatti/AFP) Off The publication of Benjamin Moser’s Anti-Zionism: A Jewish History comes at a significant political moment. Alongside the growing anti- genocide movement in the West, and the British Green Party’s recent adoption of a motion supporting a single democratic state in historic Palestine , the book helps to bring a question once marginalised in mainstream western debate into sharper focus: is Zionism an inseparable expression of Jewish identity, or a political ideology that must itself be challenged? Moser, an American Jewish writer and Pulitzer Prize-winning biographer, approaches this question by recovering a largely suppressed tradition of Jewish opposition to Zionism. Through portraits of 12 Jewish figures, including Hannah Arendt, Edwin Montagu, Felicia Langer and Avi Shlaim, he demonstrates that opposition to Zionism is neither new nor alien to Jewish intellectual and political history. The importance of his intervention goes beyond the historical recovery of individual voices. It challenges one of Zionism’s most powerful political claims: that Jewish identity, collective security and national existence necessarily require a state organised around Jewish privilege in Palestine. Moser’s work helps to establish that Jewish identity and opposition to Zionism are not contradictory, and that Jewish political and ethical traditions have also produced alternatives to exclusive nationalism. articles.title: Serangan Israel di rumah sakit Gaza membunuh dokter bedah, anak dan pasien
articles.description: Serangan Israel terhadap Rumah Sakit Gaza membunuh dokter bedah, anak-anak dan pasien Dikirim oleh staf MEE pada Thu, 11 / 12 / 2026 - 07: 53 Menyerang Nasser Hospital di Khan Yoyois mengenai perawatan intensif dan ruang bedah, memaksa suspensi operasi staf rumah sakit dan lainnya memeriksa kerusakan di dalam Rumah Sakit Nasser setelah serangan udara Israel di Khan Younis, di Jalur Gaza Selatan, pada 12 November 2026 (Eyad Baba / AFP) sebuah serangan udara Israel menghantam Nasser Medical Complex di awal hari Kamis, membunuh setidaknya enam orang Palestina, termasuk seorang dokter bedah, anak dan pasien, dan melukai 20 orang lain. Serangan itu menghantam gedung bedah rumah sakit sekitar jam 1 pagi waktu setempat. Kompleks sebagian berfungsi di Khan Younis tetap rumah sakit referensi utama terakhir beroperasi di Gaza selatan, meskipun berada di bawah tekanan ekstrim. Dr. Rizq Abu Shaira, 53, termasuk diantara mereka yang tewas, menurut Departemen Kesehatan Palestina. Dokter bedah merawat pasien ketika serangan terjadi, media lokal melaporkan. Setidaknya satu anak dan pasien cacat juga tewas. Pasien dan staf medis lainnya, termasuk wanita dan anak-anak, terluka. Kementerian Kesehatan Palestina mengutuk serangan itu, menggambarkan itu sebagai pelanggaran hukum internasional. "Target terus-menerus rumah sakit dan fasilitas medis mereka memperburuk penderitaan orang sakit dan terluka, dan mengancam apa yang tersisa dari kemampuan sektor kesehatan untuk menyediakan layanan nya", katanya. Dua rudal menghantam atap gedung, menembus lantai tiga sebelum meledak pada kedua, The New York Times melaporkan. Seorang pejabat rumah sakit mengatakan pemogokan menyebabkan kerusakan yang luas ke perawatan intensif dan bangsal bedah, termasuk kedua departemen laki-laki dan perempuan. Rumah sakit apos; s bangsal bedah sejak dipaksa untuk menangguhkan operasi. Hamas memegang begitu-disebut Dewan Perdamaian bertanggung jawab atas serangan itu, mengatakan itu mencerminkan Israel terus impun
articles.originalTitle: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills surgeon, child and patients
articles.originalDescription: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills surgeon, child and patients Submitted by MEE staff on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 07:53 Attack on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis hits intensive care and surgical wards, forcing suspension of operations Hospital staff and others inspect the damage inside Nasser Hospital following an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis, in the southern Gaza Strip, on 12 November 2026 (Eyad Baba/AFP) Off An Israeli air strike hit Nasser Medical Complex in the Gaza Strip early on Thursday, killing at least six Palestinians , including a surgeon, a child and patients, and wounding 20 others. The strike hit the hospital's surgical buildings at around 1 am local time. The partially functioning complex in Khan Younis remains the last major referral hospital operating in southern Gaza, despite being under extreme strain. Dr Rizq Abu Shaira, 53, was among those killed, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. The surgeon was treating patients when the strike hit, local media reported. At least one child and a disabled patient were also killed. Other patients and medical staff, including women and children, were wounded. The Palestinian Ministry of Health condemned the attack, describing it as a flagrant violation of international law. “The continued targeting of hospitals and their medical facilities exacerbates the suffering of the sick and wounded, and threatens what remains of the ability of the health sector to provide its services,” it said. Two missiles struck the building's roof, penetrating the third floor before exploding on the second, The New York Times reported. A hospital official said the strike caused extensive damage to the intensive care and surgical wards, including both the male and female departments. The hospital's surgical ward has since been forced to suspend operations. Hamas held the so-called Board of Peace responsible for the attack, saying it reflected Israel's continued impunity amid international silence and the failure to stop it

articles.title: Asir mencatat curah hujan tertinggi di 48 mm sebagai hujan hits empat daerah Saudi
articles.description: JEDDAH - Asir mencatat curah hujan tertinggi di 48 mm sebagai Pusat Nasional untuk Meteorologi (NCM) laporan curah hujan di empat daerah Saudi selama 24 jam. NCM mengukur curah hujan di seluruh Kingdom dari 9 pagi pada hari Rabu, 11 November, sampai 9 pagi pada hari Kamis, 12 November, dengan akumulasi tertinggi dicatat di Khamis Mushait Wadi Bin Hashbal di daerah Asir di 48 mm. Di Asir, Rijal Almaa mencatat curah hujan kedua tertinggi pada 33,8 mm, diikuti oleh Abha-Al Sha 'af pada 19,6 mm, Tanorah pada 18.4 mm, Al Namas pada 12.8 mm, dan Al Madha- Tareeb di 12,2 mm. Di daerah Riyadh, Al Thumamah Airport mencatat 25 mm, diikuti oleh Akademi Penerbangan Saudi di 14,8 mm, Raja Abdulavable Reserve- Mulham di 13 mm, Raja Khalid Reserve pada 11.8 mm, dan Imam Abdulatium Reserve pada 10,4 mm. Di daerah Al- Baha, Al- Baha- Al Baher tercatat 17.6 mm, diikuti oleh Al Makhwah di 15,6 mm dan Baljarashi di 11 mm. Di Provinsi Timur, Al Khair desa, Al Duqhayr, tercatat 8,8 mm, diikuti oleh Bandara Internasional Raja Fahd pada 8.5 mm, Al Ahsa Airport di 6.6 mm, dan baik Buqayq dan Ahsa- Al Uqair pada 5.8 mm.
articles.originalTitle: Asir records highest rainfall at 48 mm as rain hits four Saudi regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Asir records highest rainfall at 48 mm as the National Center for Meteorology (NCM) reports precipitation across four Saudi regions over 24 hours. The NCM measured rainfall across the Kingdom from 9 a.m. on Wednesday, November 11, to 9 a.m. on Thursday, November 12, with the highest accumulation recorded in Khamis Mushait’s Wadi Bin Hashbal in the Asir Region at 48 mm. In Asir, Rijal Almaa recorded the second-highest rainfall at 33.8 mm, followed by Abha–Al Sha'af at 19.6 mm, Tanomah at 18.4 mm, Al Namas at 12.8 mm, and Al Madha–Tareeb at 12.2 mm. In the Riyadh Region, Al Thumamah Airport recorded 25 mm, followed by the Saudi Aviation Academy at 14.8 mm, King Abdulaziz Reserve–Mulham at 13 mm, King Khalid Reserve at 11.8 mm, and Imam Abdulaziz Reserve at 10.4 mm. In the Al-Baha Region, Al-Baha–Al Baher recorded 17.6 mm, followed by Al Makhwah at 15.6 mm and Baljurashi at 11 mm. In the Eastern Province, Al Khair village, Al Dughayr, recorded 8.8 mm, followed by King Fahd International Airport at 8.5 mm, Al Ahsa Airport at 6.6 mm, and both Buqayq and Al Ahsa–Al Uqair at 5.8 mm.

articles.title: Badai lebat, banjir kilat diperkirakan di empat daerah Saudi
articles.description: JEDDAH - Moderate ke badai petir berat mampu menyebabkan banjir kilat diramalkan di bagian-bagian Jazan, Asir, Al- Baha dan Mekah pada hari Kamis, menurut National Center for Meteorology (NCM). Hujan diperkirakan disertai hujan es, angin aktif dan debu bertiup. Dalam ramalan cuaca sehari-hari, NCM mengatakan cahaya turun hujan sedang juga diharapkan di bagian-bagian Madinah, Hail, Qassim, Riyadh dan Provinsi Timur. Formasi kabut juga mungkin terjadi di daerah-daerah ini, sebagaimana Tabuk, Al- Jouf dan Wilayah Batas Utara. Di Mekah, sedang untuk badai besar diperkirakan, disertai oleh angin aktif, hujan es dan debu meniup. Kota ini diharapkan untuk mencatat tinggi 31 ° C dan rendah 22 ° C, dengan kelembaban relatif mencapai 85 persen. Jazan juga diharapkan untuk mengalami moderat badai berat, disertai oleh angin aktif, hujan es dan debu bertiup, dengan suhu berkisar dari 27 ° C sampai 31 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Al- Baha diramalkan untuk mengalami moderat badai berat, disertai oleh angin aktif dan debu meniup, dengan suhu berkisar dari 14 ° C sampai 18 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen. Dalam Ibha, moderat untuk badai lebat dan angin aktif diduga, dengan suhu berkisar dari 12 ° C sampai 20 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen. Madinah diharapkan untuk mengalami kabut, hujan-bantalan awan dan angin aktif, dengan suhu berkisar dari 15 ° C sampai 25 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Sementara itu, Riyadh dan Dammam diperkirakan mengalami kabut dan hujan ringan, dengan angin aktif juga diharapkan di Dammam. Jeddah diharapkan untuk mengalami sebagian berawan dengan kondisi berawan, dengan suhu berkisar dari 23 ° C menjadi 32 ° C dan kelembaban relatif mencapai 85 persen.
articles.originalTitle: Heavy thunderstorms, flash floods forecast across four Saudi regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Moderate to heavy thunderstorms capable of causing flash floods are forecast across parts of Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha and Makkah on Thursday, according to the National Center for Meteorology (NCM). The rainfall is expected to be accompanied by hail, active winds and blowing dust. In its daily weather forecast, the NCM said light to moderate rainfall is also expected across parts of Madinah, Hail, Qassim, Riyadh and the Eastern Province. Fog formation is also possible across parts of these regions, as well as Tabuk, Al-Jouf and the Northern Borders Region. In Makkah, moderate to heavy thunderstorms are forecast, accompanied by active winds, hail and blowing dust. The city is expected to record a high of 31°C and a low of 22°C, with relative humidity reaching 85 percent. Jazan is also expected to experience moderate to heavy thunderstorms, accompanied by active winds, hail and blowing dust, with temperatures ranging from 27°C to 31°C and humidity reaching 90 percent. Al-Baha is forecast to experience moderate to heavy thunderstorms, accompanied by active winds and blowing dust, with temperatures ranging from 14°C to 18°C and humidity reaching 95 percent. In Ibha, moderate to heavy thunderstorms and active winds are expected, with temperatures ranging from 12°C to 20°C and humidity reaching 95 percent. Madinah is expected to experience fog, rain-bearing thunderclouds and active winds, with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 25°C and humidity reaching 90 percent. Meanwhile, Riyadh and Dammam are forecast to experience fog and light rainfall, with active winds also expected in Dammam. Jeddah is expected to experience partly cloudy to cloudy conditions, with temperatures ranging from 23°C to 32°C and relative humidity reaching 85 percent.

articles.title: Pertahanan udara Saudi mencegat 9 rudal dan drone sebagai puing jatuh di wilayah Mekah
articles.description: RIYADH - pertahanan udara Saudi dicegat dan menghancurkan sembilan rudal dan drone diluncurkan oleh teroris Houthi milisi ke beberapa daerah dari Kingdom antara Rabu dan Kamis, dengan puing-puing dari dua rudal balistik jatuh di sebuah desa di daerah Ascenn. Menurut laporan yang dikeluarkan oleh Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Malki, juru bicara untuk Coalition untuk mengembalikan Legatimasi di Yaman, ancaman yang dicegat termasuk dua rudal balistik, tiga rudal pesiar dan empat drone menargetkan Riyadh, Mekah, daerah selatan dan timur Arab Saudi. Koalisi pertama mengumumkan penangkapan dan penghancuran tiga rudal pesiar diluncurkan oleh milisi Houthi menuju Riyadh Reseisons pada hari Rabu malam. Kemudian malam itu, koalisi mengumumkan bahwa pertahanan udara dicegat dan menghancurkan dua drone diluncurkan menuju Mekah dan daerah selatan. Koalisi kemudian mengumumkan interception dan penghancuran dua rudal balistik diluncurkan ke arah barat wilayah Rabu malam. Pada jam-jam awal Kamis, koalisi dikonfirmasi bahwa puing-puing dari dua dicegat dan menghancurkan rudal balistik telah jatuh di desa Sabuhah di daerah Mekah. Sekitar periode yang sama, pertahanan udara dicegat dan menghancurkan drone lain di Provinsi Timur. Pengumuman terbaru datang Kamis pagi, ketika koalisi mengkonfirmasi interception dan penghancuran sebuah drone di Riyadh Resection.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi air defenses intercept 9 missiles and drones as debris falls in Makkah Region
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed nine missiles and drones launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward several regions of the Kingdom between Wednesday and Thursday, with debris from two ballistic missiles falling on a village in the Makkah Region. According to statements issued by Major General Turki Al-Malki, spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen, the intercepted threats included two ballistic missiles, three cruise missiles and four drones targeting the Riyadh, Makkah, southern and eastern regions of Saudi Arabia. The coalition first announced the interception and destruction of three cruise missiles launched by the Houthi militia toward the Riyadh Region on Wednesday evening. Later that evening, the coalition announced that air defenses intercepted and destroyed two drones launched toward the Makkah and southern regions. The coalition subsequently announced the interception and destruction of two ballistic missiles launched toward the western region late Wednesday night. In the early hours of Thursday, the coalition confirmed that debris from two intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles had fallen on the village of Sabuhah in the Makkah Region. Around the same period, air defenses intercepted and destroyed another drone in the Eastern Province. The latest announcement came Thursday morning, when the coalition confirmed the interception and destruction of a drone in the Riyadh Region.

articles.description: Keluarga Palestina bersiap untuk pengusiran sebagai pemukim mendirikan pos pos dekat desa Tepi Barat Diserahkan oleh Tamara Davison on Wed, 11 / 11 / 2026 - 13: 13 Bagi orang-orang di Jiftlik, di Jordan Valley, kedatangan pemukim Israel membawa ancaman baru kekerasan, kejang tanah dan penduduk paksa dari setiap kelompok di Sungai Yordan Barat. Tapi energi tiba-tiba bergeser ketika truk pickup menendang debu dan hurtles menuruni lereng bukit: itu pemukim Israel. Dia cepat memanggil tamunya ke arah pintu, menonton cemas sampai mobil melewati ke kejauhan. "Serangan semakin meningkat", kata orang Palestina, anak-anaknya dengan hati-hati mengintip keluar dari pintu rumah keluarganya. "Ada perasaan tidak aman, hidup dalam limbo konstan ini". Sekitar 80 keluarga Palestina bergantung pada bukit berbatu terpencil di lereng timur Tepi Barat, menghadap Sungai Yordan. Al- Suneh adalah salah satu dari empat penduduk cluster di desa pertanian Jiftlik, utara kota Yerikho. Populasi desa ini terdiri dari petani dan pengembara yang mengandalkan ternak untuk hidup mereka. "Dia mengatakan kepada saya... Aku harus pergi ke Eropa, Kanada, atau tempat-tempat seperti itu '- Mohammed, al- Shuneh penduduk Banyak yang lahir di al- Suneh untuk keluarga mengungsi oleh pasukan Israel dekade lalu dari bagian lain Palestina. Namun mata pencaharian mereka telah diubah oleh siksaan yang lambat dan terus menerus: memperpanjang perintah penghancuran Israel dan, baru-baru ini, kedatangan pendatang bermusuhan. Ketika Israel menuju ke TPS pada 27 Oktober untuk pemilihan parlemen, al- Shuneh terganggu oleh melihat tenda baru dan bendera Israel yang dipasang di puncak bukit hanya dua menit dari rumah Mohammed, menambahkan suasana intimidasi yang sudah tumbuh. Kelompok bersenjata memasang kabel air dan listrik dan merilis video menampilkan rekaman drone, wawancara pemukim, dan klip seorang ibu dengan bayi muda di media sosial, mendorong orang lain untuk bergabung dengan mereka. Al-Shuneh is one of the four population clusters in the agricultural village of Jiftlik, north of the city of Jericho. articles.description: Serangan Israel di Selatan Rumah Sakit Nasser Gaza membunuh setidaknya enam orang Palestina dan serangan udara Israel menargetkan kompleks Nasser Medical di Gaza awal hari Kamis telah membunuh setidaknya enam orang Palestina dan melukai lebih dari 20 lainnya. Pemogokan menghantam lantai dua gedung al- Yasin dalam kompleks medis, dengan direktur rumah sakit menunjukkan bahwa hal itu menyebabkan kerusakan yang luas ke perawatan intensif dan bangsal bedah. Sementara Radio Angkatan Darat Israel mengklaim bahwa pemogokan adalah "operasi pembunuhan", korban adalah staf dan pasien, termasuk beberapa orang yang dijadwalkan menjalani operasi hari berikutnya.
articles.originalTitle: Israeli strike on south Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills at least six Palestinians
articles.originalDescription: Israeli strike on south Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills at least six Palestinians An Israeli air strike targeting the Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza early on Thursday has killed at least six Palestinians and injured more than 20 others. The strike hit the second floor of al-Yasin building within the medical complex, with the hospital’s director indicating that it caused extensive damage to the intensive care and surgical wards. While Israeli Army Radio claimed that the strike was an "assassination operation", the casualties were staff and patients, including some people who were scheduled to undergo surgery the following day.
